16.199.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
sarasvatyāstaṭe ramye devaṃ tatra kṛtasmaram .. 1 ..
16.199.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्य दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
सरस्वत्यास्तटे रम्ये देवं तत्र कृतस्मरम् .. 1 ..
16.199.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the god situated to its south, / on the delightful bank of the Sarasvatī, named Kṛtasmara,

16.199.s:
svayaṃbhūtaṃ mahādevi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā jātaṃ mahītale .. 2 ..
16.199.d:
स्वयंभूतं महादेवि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा जातं महीतले .. 2 ..
16.199.m: who is self-manifest, O great goddess, and destroys all sins. / I shall recount his origin, how he appeared on the surface of the earth.

16.199.s:
purā kāmo mayā dagdho yadā tatra varānane ..
tadā ratiḥ samāgamya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā .. 3 ..
16.199.d:
पुरा कामो मया दग्धो यदा तत्र वरानने ..
तदा रतिः समागम्य विललाप सुदुःखिता .. 3 ..
16.199.m: Formerly, O fair-faced one, when Kāma was burned by me there, / then Rati came and, exceedingly grief-stricken, lamented bitterly. // 3

16.199.s:
tāṃ tu śokāturāṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrāhaṃ karuṇānvitaḥ ..
avocaṃ mā rudiṣveti tava bhartā punaḥ śubhe ..
samutthāsyati kālena matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
16.199.d:
तां तु शोकातुरां दृष्ट्वा तत्राहं करुणान्वितः ..
अवोचं मा रुदिष्वेति तव भर्ता पुनः शुभे ..
समुत्थास्यति कालेन मत्प्रसादान्न संशयः .. 4 ..
16.199.m: Seeing her tormented by sorrow, filled with compassion I / said to her: "Do not weep! O auspicious one, your husband / shall rise again in time by my grace, there is no doubt." // 4

16.199.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ sa purā dagdhaḥ kāmadevastvayā vibho ..
kathamāpa punarjanma vistarātkathayasva me .. 5 ..
16.199.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं स पुरा दग्धः कामदेवस्त्वया विभो ..
कथमाप पुनर्जन्म विस्तरात्कथयस्व मे .. 5 ..
16.199.m: The goddess said: / For what reason was Kāmadeva burned formerly by you, O all-pervading lord? / How did he obtain rebirth? Tell me in detail! // 5

16.199.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ babhūva tvatpitā priye ..
śataṃ sutānāṃ jajñe'sya gaurīṇāṃ dīrghacakṣuṣām .. 6 ..
16.199.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
दक्षः प्रजापतिः पूर्वं बभूव त्वत्पिता प्रिये ..
शतं सुतानां जज्ञेऽस्य गौरीणां दीर्घचक्षुषाम् .. 6 ..
16.199.m: The lord said: / Formerly, Dakṣa Prajāpati was your father, O beloved. / A hundred daughters of fair complexion and long eyes were born to him. // 6

16.199.s:
dadau tvāṃ prathamaṃ mahyaṃ satīnāmeti kīrtitām ..
dadau daśa ca dharmāya śraddhā medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā .. 7 ..
16.199.d:
ददौ त्वां प्रथमं मह्यं सतीनामेति कीर्तिताम् ..
ददौ दश च धर्माय श्रद्धा मेधा धृतिः क्षमा .. 7 ..
16.199.m: He gave you first to me, renowned by the name Satī. / He gave ten to Dharma: Śraddhā, Medhā, Dhṛti, Kṣamā, // 7

16.199.s:
anasūyā śucirlajjā smṛtiḥ śaktiḥ śrutistathā ..
dve bhārye kāmadevāya ratiḥ prītistathaiva ca .. 8 ..
16.199.d:
अनसूया शुचिर्लज्जा स्मृतिः शक्तिः श्रुतिस्तथा ..
द्वे भार्ये कामदेवाय रतिः प्रीतिस्तथैव च .. 8 ..
16.199.m: Anasūyā, Śuci, Lajjā, Smṛti, Śakti, and Śruti; / two wives to Kāmadeva: Rati and likewise Prīti; // 8

16.199.s:
ekāṃ svāhāṃ dadau vahneḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca tataḥ svadhām ..
saptaviṃśacchaśāṅkāya aśvinyādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 9 ..
16.199.d:
एकां स्वाहां ददौ वह्नेः पितॄणां च ततः स्वधाम् ..
सप्तविंशच्छशाङ्काय अश्विन्याद्याः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 9 ..
16.199.m: he gave one, Svāhā, to the Fire, and then Svadhā to the ancestors; / twenty-seven to the Moon, traditionally known beginning with Aśvinī. // 9

16.199.s:
tavāpi viditā devi revatyantāstathā jane ..
kaśyapāya dadau devi sa tu kanyāstrayodaśa .. 7.1.199.10 ..
16.199.d:
तवापि विदिता देवि रेवत्यन्तास्तथा जने ..
कश्यपाय ददौ देवि स तु कन्यास्त्रयोदश .. 7.1.199.10 ..
16.199.m: They, ending with Revatī, are known to you as well as among people, O goddess. / He gave thirteen daughters to Kaśyapa, O goddess: // 10

16.199.s:
aditiśca ditiścaiva vinatā kadrureva ca ..
siṃhikā suprabhā caiva ulūkī yā varānane .. 11 ..
16.199.d:
अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव विनता कद्रुरेव च ..
सिंहिका सुप्रभा चैव उलूकी या वरानने .. 11 ..
16.199.m: Aditi, Diti, Vinatā, and Kadru, / Siṃhikā, Suprabhā, and the one who is Ulūkī, O fair-faced one, // 11

16.199.s:
anuviddhā sitā caiva īrṣyā hiṃsā tathā parā ..
māyā niṣkṛtisaṃyuktā dakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ mahāmatiḥ .. 12 ..
16.199.d:
अनुविद्धा सिता चैव ईर्ष्या हिंसा तथा परा ..
माया निष्कृतिसंयुक्ता दक्षः पूर्वं महामतिः .. 12 ..
16.199.m: Anuviddhā, Sitā, Īrṣyā, and the other, Hiṃsā, / Māyā combined with Niṣkṛti. Formerly, the wise Dakṣa— // 12

16.199.s:
gaurī ca suprabhā caiva vārttā sādhvī sumālikā ..
varuṇāya dadau pañca tadā'sau parvatātmaje .. 13 ..
16.199.d:
गौरी च सुप्रभा चैव वार्त्ता साध्वी सुमालिका ..
वरुणाय ददौ पञ्च तदाऽसौ पर्वतात्मजे .. 13 ..
16.199.m: Gaurī, Suprabhā, Vārttā, Sādhvī, and Sumālikā— / he then gave [these] five to Varuṇa, O daughter of the mountain; // 13

16.199.s:
bhadrā ca madirā caiva vidyā dhanyā dhanā śubhā ..
dadau pañca kuberāya patnyarthaṃ parvatātmaje .. 14 ..
16.199.d:
भद्रा च मदिरा चैव विद्या धन्या धना शुभा ..
ददौ पञ्च कुबेराय पत्न्यर्थं पर्वतात्मजे .. 14 ..
16.199.m: Bhadrā, Madirā, Vidyā, Dhanyā, Dhanā, and Śubhā / —he gave five to Kubera as wives, O daughter of the mountain; // 14

16.199.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva madhuspandā irāvatī ..
supriyā janakā kāntā subhadrā dhārmikā śubhā .. 15 ..
16.199.d:
जया च विजया चैव मधुस्पन्दा इरावती ..
सुप्रिया जनका कान्ता सुभद्रा धार्मिका शुभा .. 15 ..
16.199.m: Jayā, Vijayā, Madhuspandā, Irāvatī, / Supriyā, Janakā, Kāntā, Subhadrā, Dhārmikā, and Śubhā— // 15

16.199.s:
rudrāṇāṃ pradadau kanyā daśānāṃ dharmavittadā ..
prabhāvatī subhadrā ca vimalā nirmalā'nṛtā .. 16 ..
16.199.d:
रुद्राणां प्रददौ कन्या दशानां धर्मवित्तदा ..
प्रभावती सुभद्रा च विमला निर्मलाऽनृता .. 16 ..
16.199.m: he, knowing dharma, then gave ten daughters to the Rudras: / Prabhāvatī, Subhadrā, Vimalā, Nirmalā, Anṛtā, // 16

16.199.s:
tīvrā dakṣāruṇā vidyā dhārapālā ca varcasā ..
ādityānāṃ dadau dakṣaḥ kanyādvādaśakaṃ priye .. 17 ..
16.199.d:
तीव्रा दक्षारुणा विद्या धारपाला च वर्चसा ..
आदित्यानां ददौ दक्षः कन्याद्वादशकं प्रिये .. 17 ..
16.199.m: Tīvrā, Dakṣā, Aruṇā, Vidyā, and Dhārapālā with splendor; / Dakṣa gave twelve daughters to the Ādityas, O beloved; // 17

16.199.s:
yoganidrābhibhūtasya saṃsarpā saramā guhā ..
mālā caṃpā tathā jyotsnā sa viśvebhyaśca eva ca .. 18 ..
16.199.d:
योगनिद्राभिभूतस्य संसर्पा सरमा गुहा ..
माला चंपा तथा ज्योत्स्ना स विश्वेभ्यश्च एव च .. 18 ..
16.199.m: overcome by yoganidrā: Saṃsarpā, Saramā, Guhā, / Mālā, Campā, and Jyotsnā, he [gave] to the Viśvedevas; // 18

16.199.s:
aśvibhyāṃ dve tathā kanye suveṣā bhūṣaṇā śubhā ..
ekā kanyā tathā vāyordattā etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. 19 ..
16.199.d:
अश्विभ्यां द्वे तथा कन्ये सुवेषा भूषणा शुभा ..
एका कन्या तथा वायोर्दत्ता एताः प्रकीर्तिताः .. 19 ..
16.199.m: likewise two daughters to the Aśvins: Suveṣā and the auspicious Bhūṣaṇā; / and one daughter was given to Vāyu. These have been declared. // 19

16.199.s:
sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe prādāllakṣmīṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya sa īje dakṣiṇāvatā .. 7.1.199.20 ..
16.199.d:
सावित्रीं ब्रह्मणे प्रादाल्लक्ष्मीं विष्णोर्महात्मनः ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य स ईजे दक्षिणावता .. 7.1.199.20 ..
16.199.m: He gave Sāvitrī to Brahmā, and Lakṣmī to the great-souled Viṣṇu. / Then, after some time, he performed a sacrifice rich in priestly gifts // 20

16.199.s:
yajñena parvatasute himavante mahāgirau ..
yajñavāṭo hyabhūttasya sarvakāmasamṛddhimān .. 21 ..
16.199.d:
यज्ञेन पर्वतसुते हिमवन्ते महागिरौ ..
यज्ञवाटो ह्यभूत्तस्य सर्वकामसमृद्धिमान् .. 21 ..
16.199.m: on the great mountain Himavat, O daughter of the mountain. / His sacrificial enclosure was indeed abundant with all desired things. // 21

16.199.s:
tasminyajñe samāyātā ādityā vasava stathā ..
viśvedevāśca maruto lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ .. 22 ..
16.199.d:
तस्मिन्यज्ञे समायाता आदित्या वसव स्तथा ..
विश्वेदेवाश्च मरुतो लोकपालाश्च सर्वशः .. 22 ..
16.199.m: To that sacrifice came the Ādityas as well as the Vasus, / the Viśvedevas, the Maruts, and the world-guardians from all quarters; // 22

16.199.s:
brahmā viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣo vāruṇo yama eva ca ..
dhanadaśca kumāraśca tathā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ .. .. 23 ..
16.199.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुः सहस्राक्षो वारुणो यम एव च ..
धनदश्च कुमारश्च तथा नद्यश्च सागराः .. .. 23 ..
16.199.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the thousand-eyed [Indra], Varuṇa, and Yama, / Dhanada, Kumāra, and likewise the rivers and the oceans, // 23

16.199.s:
vāpyaḥ kūpāstathā caiva taḍāgāḥ palvalāni ca ..
suparṇaścātha ye nāgāḥ sarve mūrtā vyavasthitāḥ .. 24 ..
16.199.d:
वाप्यः कूपास्तथा चैव तडागाः पल्वलानि च ..
सुपर्णश्चाथ ये नागाः सर्वे मूर्ता व्यवस्थिताः .. 24 ..
16.199.m: reservoirs, wells, pools, and ponds, / Suparṇa, and whichever serpents there were, all assembled in bodily form; // 24

16.199.s:
dānavāpsarasaścaiva yakṣāḥ kinnaraguhyakāḥ ..
sānugāste sabhāryāśca vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ .. 25 ..
16.199.d:
दानवाप्सरसश्चैव यक्षाः किन्नरगुह्यकाः ..
सानुगास्ते सभार्याश्च वेदवेदांगपारगाः .. 25 ..
16.199.m: Dānavas and apsarases, yakṣas, kinnaras, and guhyakas, / with their followers and their wives, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, // 25

16.199.s:
maharṣayo mahābhāgāstathā devarṣayaśca ye ..
te bhāryāsahitāstatra vasaṃti ca varānane ..26..
16.199.d:
महर्षयो महाभागास्तथा देवर्षयश्च ये ..
ते भार्यासहितास्तत्र वसंति च वरानने ..26..
16.199.m: great seers of great fortune, and whichever divine seers there were— / they dwell there along with their wives, O fair-faced one. // 26

16.199.s:
kapālamālābharaṇaścitābhasma bibharti yaḥ ..
apavitratayā śaṃbhurnāhūtastu tathāvidhaḥ .. 27 ..
16.199.d:
कपालमालाभरणश्चिताभस्म बिभर्ति यः ..
अपवित्रतया शंभुर्नाहूतस्तु तथाविधः .. 27 ..
16.199.m: He who wears a garland of skulls as an ornament and bears funeral ashes— / Śaṃbhu, being of such a kind, was not invited because of impurity. // 27

16.199.s:
yatastataḥ samāyātāḥ kailāse parvatottame ..
aśvinyādyā bhaginyastāstvāṃ pratīdaṃ vaco'buvan .. 28 ..
16.199.d:
यतस्ततः समायाताः कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे ..
अश्विन्याद्या भगिन्यस्तास्त्वां प्रतीदं वचोऽबुवन् .. 28 ..
16.199.m: From here and there, those sisters beginning with Aśvinī came / to the excellent mountain Kailāsa and spoke these words to you: // 28

16.199.s:
kiṃ tuṣṭeva ca kalyāṇi tiṣṭhasi tvaṃ sumadhyame ..
vayaṃ ca prasthitāḥ sarvāḥ pituryajñe sabhartṛkāḥ..29..
16.199.d:
किं तुष्टेव च कल्याणि तिष्ठसि त्वं सुमध्यमे ..
वयं च प्रस्थिताः सर्वाः पितुर्यज्ञे सभर्तृकाः..29..
16.199.m: "Why do you stay as if contented, O auspicious one of slender waist? / We are all departing for our father's sacrifice together with our husbands. // 29

16.199.s:
vayamākāritāstena sutāḥ sarvā yaśasvini ..
na tvāmāhūtavāndakṣastrapate śaṃkarādyataḥ..7.1.199.30..
16.199.d:
वयमाकारितास्तेन सुताः सर्वा यशस्विनि ..
न त्वामाहूतवान्दक्षस्त्रपते शंकराद्यतः..7.1.199.30..
16.199.m: All of us daughters have been invited by him, O glorious one; / Dakṣa did not invite you, since he is ashamed because of Śaṃkara." // 30

16.199.s:
tāsāṃ vacanamākarṇya satī prāha krudhānvitā..
hā dhigdakṣa durācāra kiṃ vadiṣye maheśvaram ..31..
16.199.d:
तासां वचनमाकर्ण्य सती प्राह क्रुधान्विता..
हा धिग्दक्ष दुराचार किं वदिष्ये महेश्वरम् ..31..
16.199.m: Hearing their words, Satī, filled with rage, said: / "Ah, shame on Dakṣa of evil conduct! What shall I say to Maheśvara? // 31

16.199.s:
kathaṃ saṃdarśaye vaktramityuktvā''tmānamātmanā ..
visasarja tapoyogātsasmārānyanna kiñcana ..32..
16.199.d:
कथं संदर्शये वक्त्रमित्युक्त्वा'ऽत्मानमात्मना ..
विससर्ज तपोयोगात्सस्मारान्यन्न किञ्चन ..32..
16.199.m: How can I show my face?" Having said this, by the power of yoga / she discarded herself by herself and remembered nothing else. // 32

16.199.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā mahādevaḥ satīṃ prāṇairvinā sthitām ..
avamānāttathā''tmānaṃ tyaktvā matvā kapālinam ..33..
16.199.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा महादेवः सतीं प्राणैर्विना स्थिताम् ..
अवमानात्तथा'ऽत्मानं त्यक्त्वा मत्वा कपालिनम् ..33..
16.199.m: Then Mahādeva, seeing Satī deprived of her vital breaths / through insult, and knowing himself to be [despised as] the skull-bearer, // 33

16.199.s:
gaṇānsaṃpreṣayāmāsa yajñavidhvaṃsanāya ca ..
te gatāśca gaṇā raudrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 34 ..
16.199.d:
गणान्संप्रेषयामास यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च ..
ते गताश्च गणा रौद्राः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 34 ..
16.199.m: dispatched his gaṇas for the destruction of the sacrifice. / And those fierce gaṇas went, by hundreds and by thousands, // 34

16.199.s:
vikṛtā vikṛtākārā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ ..
rudreṇa preritāndṛṣṭvā vīrabhadrapurogamān ..35..
16.199.d:
विकृता विकृताकारा असंख्याता महाबलाः ..
रुद्रेण प्रेरितान्दृष्ट्वा वीरभद्रपुरोगमान् ..35..
16.199.m: deformed, hideous in appearance, innumerable, of great strength. / Seeing those dispatched by Rudra, led by Vīrabhadra, // 35

16.199.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve vasavaḥ saha bhāskaraiḥ ..
viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca dhanurhastā mahābalāḥ .. 36 ..
16.199.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे वसवः सह भास्करैः ..
विश्वेदेवाश्च साध्याश्च धनुर्हस्ता महाबलाः .. 36 ..
16.199.m: then all the hosts of gods, the Vasus together with the suns, / the Viśvedevas, and the Sādhyas, bows in hand, of great strength, // 36

16.199.s:
yuddhāya ca viniṣkrāntā muñcantaḥ sāyakāñchitān ..
te sametya tato'nyonyaṃ pramathā vibudhaiḥ saha .. 37 ..
16.199.d:
युद्धाय च विनिष्क्रान्ता मुञ्चन्तः सायकाञ्छितान् ..
ते समेत्य ततोऽन्योन्यं प्रमथा विबुधैः सह .. 37 ..
16.199.m: came forth to battle, releasing sharpened arrows. / Then, engaging with one another, the pramathas together with the gods // 37

16.199.s:
mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāridhārāṃ yathā ghanāḥ ..
teṣāṃ hastī gaṇenātha śūlena hṛdi bheditaḥ .. 38 ..
16.199.d:
मुमुचुः शरवर्षाणि वारिधारां यथा घनाः ..
तेषां हस्ती गणेनाथ शूलेन हृदि भेदितः .. 38 ..
16.199.m: discharged showers of arrows, like clouds pouring torrents of rain. / Then an elephant belonging to them was pierced in the heart with a trident by a gaṇa. // 38

16.199.s:
sa tu tena prahāreṇa visaṃjño niṣasāda ha ..
atha muṣṭyā hataḥ kumbhe nāga airāvaṇastadā .. 39 ..
16.199.d:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण विसंज्ञो निषसाद ह ..
अथ मुष्ट्या हतः कुम्भे नाग ऐरावणस्तदा .. 39 ..
16.199.m: From that blow, it indeed collapsed senseless. / Then the elephant Airāvaṇa was struck on the frontal globes with a fist; // 39

16.199.s:
sahasā sa hatastena vāraṇo bhairavānravān..
vinadañjavamāsthāya yajñavāṭamupādravat .. 7.1.199.40 ..
16.199.d:
सहसा स हतस्तेन वारणो भैरवान्रवान्..
विनदञ्जवमास्थाय यज्ञवाटमुपाद्रवत् .. 7.1.199.40 ..
16.199.m: suddenly struck by him, that elephant, uttering dreadful roars, / making noise and taking to flight, rushed into the sacrificial enclosure. // 40

16.199.s:
viśvedevā nirucchvāsāḥ kṛtā raudrairmahāśaraiḥ ..
cakarṣa sa dhanuṣyeṇa vasumānbalavataraḥ .. .. 41 ..
16.199.d:
विश्वेदेवा निरुच्छ्वासाः कृता रौद्रैर्महाशरैः ..
चकर्ष स धनुष्येण वसुमान्बलवतरः .. .. 41 ..
16.199.m: The Viśvedevas were left breathless by fierce, great arrows. / The very powerful Vasumat drew his bow; // 41

16.199.s:
nistejasastadādityāḥ kṛtāstena raṇājire ..
etasminnantare devāḥ kṛtāstena parāṅmukhāḥ .. 42 ..
16.199.d:
निस्तेजसस्तदादित्याः कृतास्तेन रणाजिरे ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः कृतास्तेन पराङ्मुखाः .. 42 ..
16.199.m: then the Ādityas were rendered lusterless by him on the battleground. / Meanwhile, the gods were put to flight by him. // 42

16.199.s:
tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurviṣṇuṃ tatra ca saṃsthitam ..
tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo viṣṇurdevānsavāsavān .. 43 ..
16.199.d:
ततस्ते शरणं जग्मुर्विष्णुं तत्र च संस्थितम् ..
ततः कोपसमाविष्टो विष्णुर्देवान्सवासवान् .. 43 ..
16.199.m: Then they went for refuge to Viṣṇu who was staying there. / Then Viṣṇu, overcome with anger, seeing all the gods // 43

16.199.s:
dṛṣṭvā vidrāvitānsarvānmumocāśu sudarśanam ..
tamāpatantaṃ vegena viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam .. 44 ..
16.199.d:
दृष्ट्वा विद्रावितान्सर्वान्मुमोचाशु सुदर्शनम् ..
तमापतन्तं वेगेन विष्णोश्चक्रं सुदर्शनम् .. 44 ..
16.199.m: with Indra routed, quickly released the Sudarśana [discus]. / As that Sudarśana discus of Viṣṇu was flying swiftly, // 44

16.199.s:
prasārya vaktraṃ sahasā udarasthaṃ cakāra ha ..
tasmiṃścakre tadā graste amoghe parvatātmaje .. 45 ..
16.199.d:
प्रसार्य वक्त्रं सहसा उदरस्थं चकार ह ..
तस्मिंश्चक्रे तदा ग्रस्ते अमोघे पर्वतात्मजे .. 45 ..
16.199.m: suddenly opening his mouth, he took it into his belly! / When that unerring discus was thus swallowed, O daughter of the mountain, // 45

16.199.s:
cukopa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śārṅgahasto 'bhyadhāvata ..
sa hatvā daśabhistīkṣṇairnaṃdiṃ bhṛṅgiṃ śatena ca .. 46 ..
16.199.d:
चुकोप भगवान्विष्णुः शार्ङ्गहस्तो ऽभ्यधावत ..
स हत्वा दशभिस्तीक्ष्णैर्नंदिं भृङ्गिं शतेन च .. 46 ..
16.199.m: the blessed Viṣṇu grew furious and ran forward, bow in hand. / Having struck Nandin with ten sharp arrows and Bhṛṅgin with a hundred, // 46

16.199.s:
mahākālaṃ sahasreṇa hyayutena gaṇādhipam ..
bāṇānāmayutairbhittvā vīrabhadramupādravat .. 47 ..
16.199.d:
महाकालं सहस्रेण ह्ययुतेन गणाधिपम् ..
बाणानामयुतैर्भित्त्वा वीरभद्रमुपाद्रवत् .. 47 ..
16.199.m: [striking] Mahākāla with a thousand, and the lord of Gaṇas with ten thousand, / having pierced Vīrabhadra with tens of thousands of arrows, he rushed upon him.

16.199.s:
taṃ hatvā gadayā viṣṇurvihvalaṃ rudhirokṣitam ..
gṛhītvā pādayorbhūmau nijaghānātiroṣitaḥ .. 48 ..
16.199.d:
तं हत्वा गदया विष्णुर्विह्वलं रुधिरोक्षितम् ..
गृहीत्वा पादयोर्भूमौ निजघानातिरोषितः .. 48 ..
16.199.m: Striking him with his mace, Viṣṇu, extremely enraged, / seized him by the feet, distressed and drenched in blood, and dashed him to the ground.

16.199.s:
hanyamānasya tasyātha bhūmau cakraṃ sudarśanam..
rudhirodgārasaṃyuktaṃ prahāramakaronna tu ..49..
16.199.d:
हन्यमानस्य तस्याथ भूमौ चक्रं सुदर्शनम्..
रुधिरोद्गारसंयुक्तं प्रहारमकरोन्न तु ..49..
16.199.m: As he was being struck down upon the earth, the Sudarśana discus / was covered with blood that surged forth, but did not strike [again].

16.199.s:
rudralabdhavaro devi vīrabhadro gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
yanna pañcatvamāpanno gadayā pīḍito'pi saḥ .. 7.1.199.50 ..
16.199.d:
रुद्रलब्धवरो देवि वीरभद्रो गणेश्वरः ..
यन्न पञ्चत्वमापन्नो गदया पीडितोऽपि सः .. 7.1.199.50 ..
16.199.m: Vīrabhadra, the lord of Gaṇas, had obtained boons from Rudra, O goddess; / therefore, even though oppressed by the mace, he did not meet his demise.

16.199.s:
patitaṃ vīkṣya taṃ sarve viṣṇutejobalārditāḥ ..
vidrutāḥ sarvato yātā yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 51 ..
16.199.d:
पतितं वीक्ष्य तं सर्वे विष्णुतेजोबलार्दिताः ..
विद्रुताः सर्वतो याता यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 51 ..
16.199.m: Seeing him fallen, all [the Gaṇas], afflicted by the power of Viṣṇu's splendor, / fled and went in all directions to where the god Maheśvara was.

16.199.s:
tasmai sarvaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ samācakhyuḥ parābhavam ..
vikramaṃ vīrabhadrasya tataḥ kruddho maheśvaraḥ .. 52 ..
16.199.d:
तस्मै सर्वं तथा वृत्तं समाचख्युः पराभवम् ..
विक्रमं वीरभद्रस्य ततः क्रुद्धो महेश्वरः .. 52 ..
16.199.m: They reported to him everything that had happened: the defeat, / and the prowess of Vīrabhadra. Thereupon Maheśvara became enraged.

16.199.s:
pragṛhya sahasā śūlaṃ prasthitaḥ svagaṇaiḥ saha ..
yajñavāṭaṃ tu dakṣasya parābhavabhavaṃ tataḥ ..
vikramanvīrabhadreṇa yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..53..
16.199.d:
प्रगृह्य सहसा शूलं प्रस्थितः स्वगणैः सह ..
यज्ञवाटं तु दक्षस्य पराभवभवं ततः ..
विक्रमन्वीरभद्रेण यत्र विष्णुः स्वयं स्थितः ..53..
16.199.m: Quickly seizing his trident, he set out along with his own Gaṇas / towards Dakṣa's sacrificial enclosure, the source of the defeat, / where Vīrabhadra had displayed his prowess, and where Viṣṇu himself was stationed.

16.199.s:
tamāyāntaṃ samālokya kopayuktaṃ maheśvaram ..
saṃgrāme so'jayaṃ matvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ..54..
16.199.d:
तमायान्तं समालोक्य कोपयुक्तं महेश्वरम् ..
संग्रामे सोऽजयं मत्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..54..
16.199.m: Seeing Maheśvara arriving full of wrath, / and knowing him to be invincible in battle, [Viṣṇu] vanished right there.

16.199.s:
marudbhiḥ sārdhamindro'pi vasubhiḥ saha kinnaraiḥ ..
śivaḥ krodhaparītātmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..55..
16.199.d:
मरुद्भिः सार्धमिन्द्रोऽपि वसुभिः सह किन्नरैः ..
शिवः क्रोधपरीतात्मा ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..55..
16.199.m: Indra along with the Maruts, the Vasus, and the Kinnaras / [also vanished]; and Śiva, his soul possessed by wrath, then became invisible [to them].

16.199.s:
kevalaṃ brāhmaṇāstatra sthitāḥ sadasi bhāmini ..
te dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraṃ prāptaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanam .. 56 ..
16.199.d:
केवलं ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्थिताः सदसि भामिनि ..
ते दृष्ट्वा शंकरं प्राप्तं कोपसंरक्तलोचनम् .. 56 ..
16.199.m: Only the brahmins remained there in the assembly, O lovely lady; / seeing Śaṃkara arrived, with eyes reddened by anger,

16.199.s:
homaṃ cakrustato bhītā rudramaṃtraiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
anye trāsasamāyuktāḥ palāyaṃte diśo daśa .. 57 ..
16.199.d:
होमं चक्रुस्ततो भीता रुद्रमंत्रैः समंततः ..
अन्ये त्राससमायुक्ताः पलायंते दिशो दश .. 57 ..
16.199.m: terrified, they then offered oblations all around with Rudra mantras; / others, seized with terror, fled into the ten directions.

16.199.s:
athāgatya mahādevo dṛṣṭvā tānbrāhmaṇottamān ..
apaśyamāno vibudhāṃstatra yajñaṃ jaghāna saḥ .. 58 ..
16.199.d:
अथागत्य महादेवो दृष्ट्वा तान्ब्राह्मणोत्तमान् ..
अपश्यमानो विबुधांस्तत्र यज्ञं जघान सः .. 58 ..
16.199.m: Then, having arrived and seen those excellent brahmins, / not seeing the gods, Mahādeva struck down the sacrifice there.

16.199.s:
sa ca mṛgavapurbhūtvā praṇaṣṭaḥ śivabhītitaḥ ..
pṛṣṭhatastu dhanuṣpāṇirjagāma bhagavāñchivaḥ ..
adyāpi dṛśyate vyomni tārārūpo maheśvari .. 59 ..
16.199.d:
स च मृगवपुर्भूत्वा प्रणष्टः शिवभीतितः ..
पृष्ठतस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्जगाम भगवाञ्छिवः ..
अद्यापि दृश्यते व्योम्नि तारारूपो महेश्वरि .. 59 ..
16.199.m: And it, having assumed the form of a deer, fled out of fear of Śiva; / but behind it went the Lord Śiva, bow in hand. / Even today he is seen in the sky in the form of a constellation, O Maheśvarī.

16.199.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsanonāma navanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 199 ..
16.199.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसनोनाम नवनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 199 ..
16.199.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-ninth chapter, named 'The Destruction of Dakṣa’s Sacrifice', in the first [sub-section], 'The Greatness of the Prabhāsa Sacred Field', of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.200.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ vidhvaṃsite yajñe gatāste brāhmaṇā gṛham ..
aprāptakāmanā devi ye cānye tatra vai gatāḥ .. 1 ..
16.200.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं विध्वंसिते यज्ञे गतास्ते ब्राह्मणा गृहम् ..
अप्राप्तकामना देवि ये चान्ये तत्र वै गताः .. 1 ..
16.200.m: Īśvara said: / The sacrifice having thus been destroyed, those brahmins returned home, / their desires unfulfilled, O goddess, as did whatever others had gone there.

16.200.s: haro'pi vigatāmarṣaḥ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ .. 2 ..
16.200.d: हरोऽपि विगतामर्षः कैलासं पर्वतं गतः .. 2 ..
16.200.m: Hara too, his anger gone, departed for Mount Kailāsa.

16.200.s:
etasminneva kāle tu tārakonāma dānavaḥ ..
utpannaḥ sa mahābāhurdevānāṃ baladarpahā .. 3 ..
16.200.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तारकोनाम दानवः ..
उत्पन्नः स महाबाहुर्देवानां बलदर्पहा .. 3 ..
16.200.m: At that very time, a Dānava named Tāraka / was born, mighty-armed, the destroyer of the strength and pride of the gods.

16.200.s:
tena indrādikānsarvānsurāñjitvā mahāhave ..
svargaḥ svairvyāpito devi brahmalokaṃ tato gatāḥ ..
ūcuḥ surā duḥkhayuktā brahmāṇaṃ parvatātmaje .. 4 ..
16.200.d:
तेन इन्द्रादिकान्सर्वान्सुराञ्जित्वा महाहवे ..
स्वर्गः स्वैर्व्यापितो देवि ब्रह्मलोकं ततो गताः ..
ऊचुः सुरा दुःखयुक्ता ब्रह्माणं पर्वतात्मजे .. 4 ..
16.200.m: Having conquered in a great battle all the gods headed by Indra, / heaven was occupied by his own people, O goddess. Then the sorrowful gods / went to the world of Brahmā and spoke to Brahmā, O daughter of the mountain:

16.200.s:
tārakeṇa suraśreṣṭha svargānnirvāsitā vayam ..
svayamindraḥ samabhavadvasavo'nye tathā kṛtāḥ .. 5 ..
16.200.d:
तारकेण सुरश्रेष्ठ स्वर्गान्निर्वासिता वयम् ..
स्वयमिन्द्रः समभवद्वसवोऽन्ये तथा कृताः .. 5 ..
16.200.m: 'We have been expelled from heaven by Tāraka, O best of the gods! / He himself has become Indra, and other [demons] have been made the Vasus,

16.200.s:
rudrāḥ sādhyāstathā viśve aśvinau marutastathā ..
ādityāśca vadhopāyaṃ tasmādvada pitāmaha .. 6 ..
16.200.d:
रुद्राः साध्यास्तथा विश्वे अश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ..
आदित्याश्च वधोपायं तस्माद्वद पितामह .. 6 ..
16.200.m: the Rudras, the Sādhyas, the Viśvedevas, the two Aśvins, the Maruts, / and the Ādityas. Therefore tell us the means of his slaying, O Grandfather!'

16.200.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
avadhyaḥ sa tu sarveṣāṃ devānāmiti me matiḥ ..
ṛte tu śāṃkaraṃ tejo nānyena vinipātyate ..
tasmādgacchata bhadraṃ vo devadevaṃ maheśvaram .. 7 ..
16.200.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अवध्यः स तु सर्वेषां देवानामिति मे मतिः ..
ऋते तु शांकरं तेजो नान्येन विनिपात्यते ..
तस्माद्गच्छत भद्रं वो देवदेवं महेश्वरम् .. 7 ..
16.200.m: Brahmā said: / 'He cannot be slain by all the gods; this is my opinion. / Except for the splendor of Śaṃkara, he cannot be brought down by any other. / Therefore, go—may good betide you—to Maheśvara, the god of gods.

16.200.s:
tasya bhāryā mṛtā pūrvaṃ jātā himavato gṛhe ..
tasyāṃ ca jāyate putraḥ sa haniṣyati tārakam ..
tasmātprasādayadhvaṃ vai tadarthaṃ śūlapāṇinam .. 8 ..
16.200.d:
तस्य भार्या मृता पूर्वं जाता हिमवतो गृहे ..
तस्यां च जायते पुत्रः स हनिष्यति तारकम् ..
तस्मात्प्रसादयध्वं वै तदर्थं शूलपाणिनम् .. 8 ..
16.200.m: His wife, who died previously, has been born in the house of Himavat. / And a son born of her will slay Tāraka. / Therefore, propitiate the trident-handed [god] for that purpose.'

16.200.s:
tato devaiḥ samādiṣṭaḥ kāmadevo varānane ..
mṛtabhāryaṃ haraṃ gatvā tataḥ pīḍaya sāyakaiḥ .. 9 ..
yenāsau kāmasaṃtapto bhāryārthaṃ yatnavānbhavet ..6
16.200.d:
ततो देवैः समादिष्टः कामदेवो वरानने ..
मृतभार्यं हरं गत्वा ततः पीडय सायकैः .. 9 ..
येनासौ कामसंतप्तो भार्यार्थं यत्नवान्भवेत् ..6
16.200.m:
Then Kāmadeva was commanded by the gods, O fair-faced lady: / 'Go to Hara, whose wife is dead, and then afflict him with arrows,
so that he, tormented by love, may make an effort to take a wife.

16.200.s: ayaṃ gacchatu te bhrātā vasaṃtaśca manoharaḥ .. 7.1.200.10 ..
16.200.d: अयं गच्छतु ते भ्राता वसंतश्च मनोहरः .. 7.1.200.10 ..
16.200.m: Let your charming brother Vasanta go along [with you].'

16.200.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ ..
tato dṛṣṭvā mahādevaḥ kāmadevaṃ dhṛtāyudham .. 11 ..
16.200.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय कैलासं पर्वतं गतः ..
ततो दृष्ट्वा महादेवः कामदेवं धृतायुधम् .. 11 ..
16.200.m: Consenting with 'So be it,' he went to Mount Kailāsa. / Then Mahādeva, seeing Kāmadeva holding his weapon,

16.200.s:
vasantasahitaṃ devi rudro'ndhakaniṣūdanaḥ ..
gaṃgādvāramanuprāpya apaśyadyāvadagrataḥ .. 12 ..
16.200.d:
वसन्तसहितं देवि रुद्रोऽन्धकनिषूदनः ..
गंगाद्वारमनुप्राप्य अपश्यद्यावदग्रतः .. 12 ..
16.200.m: accompanied by Vasanta, O goddess, Rudra, the slayer of Andhaka, / reached Gaṅgādvāra and as soon as he saw [him] in front,

16.200.s:
dattāyudhaṃ kāmadevaṃ dudruve sa bhayātpunaḥ ..
tato vārāṇasīṃ gatvā naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā .. 13 ..
16.200.d:
दत्तायुधं कामदेवं दुद्रुवे स भयात्पुनः ..
ततो वाराणसीं गत्वा नैमिषं पुष्करं तथा .. 13 ..
16.200.m: fled again out of fear of Kāmadeva whose weapon was poised. / Then, having gone to Vārāṇasī, to Naimiṣa, and likewise Puṣkara,

16.200.s:
śrīkaṃṭhaṃ rudrakoṭiṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ tathā ..
jvālāmārgaṃ prayāgaṃ ca viśālāmarbudaṃ śubham .. 14 ..
16.200.d:
श्रीकंठं रुद्रकोटिं च कुरुक्षेत्रं गयां तथा ..
ज्वालामार्गं प्रयागं च विशालामर्बुदं शुभम् .. 14 ..
16.200.m: to Śrīkaṇṭha, Rudrakoṭi, Kurukṣetra, and likewise Gayā, / Jvālāmārga, Prayāga, Viśālā, and the auspicious Arbuda,

16.200.s:
bahūnvarṣagaṇānevaṃ bhramansa dharaṇītale ..
kāmadevabhayāddevi devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 15 ..
16.200.d:
बहून्वर्षगणानेवं भ्रमन्स धरणीतले ..
कामदेवभयाद्देवि देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 15 ..
16.200.m: wandering thus upon the earth for many groups of years / out of fear of Kāmadeva, O goddess, Maheśvara, the god of gods,

16.200.s:
avaikṣata tadā kāmaṃ visphārya nayanaṃ tadā ..
tṛtīyaṃ devadeveśi devadevastrilocanaḥ .. 16 ..
16.200.d:
अवैक्षत तदा कामं विस्फार्य नयनं तदा ..
तृतीयं देवदेवेशि देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः .. 16 ..
16.200.m: then opened his third eye and looked at Kāma, / O ruler of the gods, the three-eyed god of gods.

16.200.s:
tasya taṃ vīkṣamāṇasya saṃjātāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ ..
tābhiḥ sa dhanuṣā yukto bhasmasātsamapadyata .. 17 ..
16.200.d:
तस्य तं वीक्षमाणस्य संजाताः पावकार्चिषः ..
ताभिः स धनुषा युक्तो भस्मसात्समपद्यत .. 17 ..
16.200.m: As he looked at him, flames of fire were produced; / by them, [Kāmadeva], together with his bow, was reduced to ashes.

16.200.s:
taṃ dagdhvā bhagavāñchaṃbhurgatvā roṣasya nirṇayam ..
nivāsamakarottatra kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe .. 18 ..
16.200.d:
तं दग्ध्वा भगवाञ्छंभुर्गत्वा रोषस्य निर्णयम् ..
निवासमकरोत्तत्र क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे .. 18 ..
16.200.m: Having burned him and reached an end to his wrath, the Lord Śambhu / made his dwelling there in the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.200.s:
tasmindagdhe tadā kāme ratiḥ śokaparāyaṇā ..
vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā patibhaktiparāyaṇā .. 19 ..
16.200.d:
तस्मिन्दग्धे तदा कामे रतिः शोकपरायणा ..
विललाप सुदुःखार्ता पतिभक्तिपरायणा .. 19 ..
16.200.m: When Kāma was thus burned, Rati, overcome with grief, / afflicted with intense sorrow, devoted to the worship of her husband, lamented:

16.200.s:
hā nāthanātha bhoḥ svāminkiṃ jahāsi pativratām ..
pativratāṃ patiprāṇāṃ kasmānmāṃ tyajasi prabho .. 7.1.200.20 ..
16.200.d:
हा नाथनाथ भोः स्वामिन्किं जहासि पतिव्रताम् ..
पतिव्रतां पतिप्राणां कस्मान्मां त्यजसि प्रभो .. 7.1.200.20 ..
16.200.m: 'Ah, Lord! Lord! O master, why do you abandon your faithful wife? / Why do you forsake me, O lord, whose life is her husband, a devoted wife?'

16.200.s:
evaṃ vilapatīṃ tāṃ tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
mā tvaṃ ruda viśālākṣi punareva patistava .. 21 ..
16.200.d:
एवं विलपतीं तां तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
मा त्वं रुद विशालाक्षि पुनरेव पतिस्तव .. 21 ..
16.200.m: To her who was thus lamenting, an incorporeal voice spoke: / 'Do not weep, O large-eyed lady! Your husband again

16.200.s:
prasādāddevadevasya ucchvāsyati śivasya tu ..
etāṃ vācaṃ ratiḥ śrutvā tataḥ svasthā babhūva ha .. 22 ..
16.200.d:
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य उच्छ्वास्यति शिवस्य तु ..
एतां वाचं रतिः श्रुत्वा ततः स्वस्था बभूव ह .. 22 ..
16.200.m: shall breathe [anew] through the grace of Śiva, the god of gods.' / Hearing these words, Rati then regained her composure.

16.200.s:
tato devāḥ śivaṃ natvā prārthayāmāsurīśvari ..
kalatrasaṃgrahaṃ deva kuru kāryārthasaṃgrahe .. 23 ..
16.200.d:
ततो देवाः शिवं नत्वा प्रार्थयामासुरीश्वरि ..
कलत्रसंग्रहं देव कुरु कार्यार्थसंग्रहे .. 23 ..
16.200.m: Then the gods bowed down to Śiva and besought him, O Īśvarī: / 'Accept a wife, O God, to accomplish our purpose.

16.200.s:
eṣa kāmastvayā dagdhaḥ krodhena mahatā svayam ..
vinā tena vibho naṣṭā sṛṣṭirvai dharaṇītale .. 24 ..
16.200.d:
एष कामस्त्वया दग्धः क्रोधेन महता स्वयम् ..
विना तेन विभो नष्टा सृष्टिर्वै धरणीतले .. 24 ..
16.200.m: This Kāma has been burned by you yourself in great anger. / Without him, O Lord, creation on the surface of the earth has perished.'

16.200.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
eṣa kāmo mayā dagdhaḥ krodhena surasattamāḥ ..
tasmādanaṃga evaiṣa prajāsu pracariṣyati ..
tadvīryastatprabhāvaśca vinā dehaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
16.200.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
एष कामो मया दग्धः क्रोधेन सुरसत्तमाः ..
तस्मादनंग एवैष प्रजासु प्रचरिष्यति ..
तद्वीर्यस्तत्प्रभावश्च विना देहं भविष्यति .. 25 ..
16.200.m: The Lord said: / 'This Kāma was burned by me in anger, O best of gods; / therefore, as the Bodiless One (Anaṅga), he shall wander among living beings. / His virility and his power shall exist without a body.'

16.200.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavankuru pūrvaṃ tvaṃ saṃsmarasva ratīśvaram ..
hitāya sarva lokānāṃ yathā naḥ pratyayo bhavet .. 26 ..
16.200.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
भगवन्कुरु पूर्वं त्वं संस्मरस्व रतीश्वरम् ..
हिताय सर्व लोकानां यथा नः प्रत्ययो भवेत् .. 26 ..
16.200.m: The gods said: / 'O Lord, first revive Rati's lord / for the benefit of all worlds, so that we may have confidence.'

16.200.s:
tataḥ sa smṛtavānkāmaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ ..
tatastacchāśvataṃ liṃgaṃ samuttasthau mahītale .. 27 ..
16.200.d:
ततः स स्मृतवान्कामं स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः ..
ततस्तच्छाश्वतं लिंगं समुत्तस्थौ महीतले .. 27 ..
16.200.m: Then the lord Maheśvara himself called Kāma to mind; / thereupon that eternal liṅga arose upon the earth's surface.

16.200.s:
kṛtasmaraḥ punastatra anaṃgo balavāṃstathā ..
tenoḍhā śailajā tena śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā .. 28 ..
16.200.d:
कृतस्मरः पुनस्तत्र अनंगो बलवांस्तथा ..
तेनोढा शैलजा तेन शंकरेण महात्मना .. 28 ..
16.200.m: Kāma was restored there once again, bodiless yet strong; / by that means the great-souled Śaṃkara wed the daughter of the mountain.

16.200.s:
jātaḥ skandaḥ suraśreṣṭhastārako yena sūditaḥ ..
patitenaiva liṃgena yasmāccaiva kṛtasmaraḥ .. 29 ..
16.200.d:
जातः स्कन्दः सुरश्रेष्ठस्तारको येन सूदितः ..
पतितेनैव लिंगेन यस्माच्चैव कृतस्मरः .. 29 ..
16.200.m: Skanda was born, best among the gods, by whom Tāraka was slain; / and because he was remembered and restored through the fallen liṅga,

16.200.s:
tasmātkṛtasmaro loke kīrtyate sa mahītale ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāṃdho nāsukhī na ca durbhagaḥ ..
jāyate tu kadā martyo na daridro na rogavān .. 7.1.200.30 ..
16.200.d:
तस्मात्कृतस्मरो लोके कीर्त्यते स महीतले ..
तं दृष्ट्वा न जडो नांधो नासुखी न च दुर्भगः ..
जायते तु कदा मर्त्यो न दरिद्रो न रोगवान् .. 7.1.200.30 ..
16.200.m: therefore he is celebrated in the world upon the earth's surface as Kṛtasmara. / Having seen him, a mortal never becomes dull, blind, unhappy, or ill-fated, / nor ever poor, nor diseased.

16.200.s:
evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
dagdho yathā smaraḥ pūrvaṃ punarvīryānvitaḥ sthitaḥ .. 31 ..
16.200.d:
एवं ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
दग्धो यथा स्मरः पूर्वं पुनर्वीर्यान्वितः स्थितः .. 31 ..
16.200.m: Thus everything has been related to you that you asked of me: / how Smara was formerly burned, and how he stood again endowed with vigor.

16.200.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇena kṛtasmarāt ..
kāmakuṃḍeti vai nāma yatrodbhūtaḥ punaḥ smaraḥ .. 32 ..
16.200.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं कुण्डं दक्षिणेन कृतस्मरात् ..
कामकुंडेति वै नाम यत्रोद्भूतः पुनः स्मरः .. 32 ..
16.200.m: Īśvara said: / Right there is situated a pool to the south of Kṛtasmara, / named indeed Kāmakuṇḍa, where Smara was born again.

16.200.s:
anaṃgarūpī devyatra snānādvai rūpavānbhavet ..
ikṣavastatra vai deyāḥ suvarṇaṃ gāstathaiva ca ..
vastrāṇi caiva vidhivadbrāhmaṇe vedapārage ..33..
16.200.d:
अनंगरूपी देव्यत्र स्नानाद्वै रूपवान्भवेत् ..
इक्षवस्तत्र वै देयाः सुवर्णं गास्तथैव च ..
वस्त्राणि चैव विधिवद्ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..33..
16.200.m: A woman who is shapeless becomes beautiful, O goddess, by bathing here. / Sugarcane should indeed be given there, as well as gold and cows, / and garments too, according to rule, to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas.

16.200.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kāmakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 200 ..
16.200.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कामकुण्डमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 200 ..
16.200.m: Thus ends the two hundredth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Kāmakuṇḍa', in the First [Part], the Glory of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, of the Seventh Section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.201.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasminsthāne mahādevi smaśānaṃ kālabhairavam ..
brahmakuṇḍaṃ varārohe yāvaddevaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ..1..
16.201.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मिन्स्थाने महादेवि स्मशानं कालभैरवम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डं वरारोहे यावद्देवः कृतस्मरः..1..
16.201.m: Īśvara said: / In that place, O great goddess, is the cremation ground Kālabhairava, / [extending] from Brahmakuṇḍa, O fair-hipped one, as far as the deity Kṛtasmara.

16.201.s:
tatra ye prāṇino dagdhā mṛtāḥ kālaviparyayāt ..
te sarve muktimāyāṃti mahāpātakino'pi vā ..2..
16.201.d:
तत्र ये प्राणिनो दग्धा मृताः कालविपर्ययात् ..
ते सर्वे मुक्तिमायांति महापातकिनोऽपि वा ..2..
16.201.m: Whatever living beings are burned there, or die through the vicissitude of time, / all of them attain liberation, even if they are guilty of great sins.

16.201.s:
kṛtasmarānmahādevi yāvanmaṃkīśvaraḥ sthitaḥ ..
mahāsmaśānaṃ taddevi apunarbhavadāyakam ..3..
16.201.d:
कृतस्मरान्महादेवि यावन्मंकीश्वरः स्थितः ..
महास्मशानं तद्देवि अपुनर्भवदायकम् ..3..
16.201.m: From Kṛtasmara, O great goddess, as far as Maṅkīśvara stands, / that, O goddess, is the great cremation ground that bestows freedom from rebirth.

16.201.s:
tasminsthāne vahedyatra viṣuvaṃ prāṇināṃ priye ..
tatroṣaraṃ smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ tanme priyataraṃ sadā ..4..
16.201.d:
तस्मिन्स्थाने वहेद्यत्र विषुवं प्राणिनां प्रिये ..
तत्रोषरं स्मृतं क्षेत्रं तन्मे प्रियतरं सदा ..4..
16.201.m: In that place where the breath of living beings flows equally, O beloved, / there the kṣetra is known as saline soil; it is ever dearer to me.
Even at the end of an eon I do not abandon it; it is dearer to me [even] than Avimukta.

16.201.s:
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kālabhairavasmaśānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 201 ..
vahedyatra viṣuvaṃ prāṇināṃ priye -- etena - tanmahāsmaśānaparīkṣā procyate - yasminsthāne sthitānāṃ prāṇināṃ viṣuvaṃ vahet - nāsāpuṭadvayāt samānatayā śvāsocchvāsanirgamanaṃ bhavati arthāt suṣumnāsamudbhavo bhavati - tanmahāsmaśānamapunarbhavadāyakam ityartho bodhyaḥ.- skandapurāṇe ṭīkā.
16.201.d:
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कालभैरवस्मशानमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 201 ..
वहेद्यत्र विषुवं प्राणिनां प्रिये -- एतेन - तन्महास्मशानपरीक्षा प्रोच्यते - यस्मिन्स्थाने स्थितानां प्राणिनां विषुवं वहेत् - नासापुटद्वयात् समानतया श्वासोच्छ्वासनिर्गमनं भवति अर्थात् सुषुम्नासमुद्भवो भवति - तन्महास्मशानमपुनर्भवदायकम् इत्यर्थो बोध्यः.- स्कन्दपुराणे टीका.
16.201.m:
Thus ends the two hundred and first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Kālabhairava Cremation Ground', in the First [Part], the Glory of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, of the Seventh Section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
'Where the breath of living beings flows equally, O beloved'—by this the examination of that great cremation ground is stated: in which place the viṣuva flows for living beings residing there—namely, the outflow of exhalation and inhalation happens equally from both nostrils, meaning the arising of suṣumnā occurs—that great cremation ground bestows freedom from rebirth; this is the meaning to be understood. —Commentary on the Skandapurāṇa.

16.202.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi rāmeśvaramanuttamam ..
maṃkīśāddakṣiṇe bhāge āgneye tu kṛtasmarāt ..
pūrvatastu sarasvatyā balabhadrapratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.202.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रामेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
मंकीशाद्दक्षिणे भागे आग्नेये तु कृतस्मरात् ..
पूर्वतस्तु सरस्वत्या बलभद्रप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.202.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Rāmeśvara, / to the south of Maṅkīśa and to the southeast of Kṛtasmara, / but to the east of the Sarasvatī, consecrated by Balabhadra,

16.202.s:
yatra mukto'bhavaddevi rāmo brahmavadhātkila ..
pātakātpratilomāṃ tāmagāhata sarasvatīm .. 2 ..
16.202.d:
यत्र मुक्तोऽभवद्देवि रामो ब्रह्मवधात्किल ..
पातकात्प्रतिलोमां तामगाहत सरस्वतीम् .. 2 ..
16.202.m: where Rāma, indeed, was freed from the killing of a brahmin, O goddess; / from that sin he plunged into the Sarasvatī flowing upstream.

16.202.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ sa pātakānmuktaḥ kathaṃ pāpamabhūtpurā ..
kathaṃ tatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kiṃprabhāvaṃ vadasva me .. 3 .. ..
16.202.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं स पातकान्मुक्तः कथं पापमभूत्पुरा ..
कथं तत्स्थापितं लिंगं किंप्रभावं वदस्व मे .. 3 .. ..
16.202.m: The goddess said: / How was he freed from the sin? How did the sin occur formerly? / How was that liṅga installed, and what is its power? Tell me.

16.202.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mānavo devi muktaḥ saṃsārasāgarāt ..
sarvānkāmānsa labhate satataṃ manasi priyān .. 4 ..
16.202.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मानवो देवि मुक्तः संसारसागरात् ..
सर्वान्कामान्स लभते सततं मनसि प्रियान् .. 4 ..
16.202.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall tell the story that destroys sin, / hearing which, O goddess, a mortal is freed from the ocean of worldly existence, / and constantly obtains all desires dear to his heart.

16.202.s:
rāmaḥ pūrvaṃ parāṃ prītiṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya lāṃgalī ..
cintayāmāsa bahudhā kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet .. 5 ..
16.202.d:
रामः पूर्वं परां प्रीतिं कृत्वा कृष्णस्य लांगली ..
चिन्तयामास बहुधा किं कृतं सुकृतं भवेत् .. 5 ..
16.202.m: Formerly Rāma, the plow-wielder, having shown supreme affection to Kṛṣṇa, / thought in many ways: 'What good deed could be performed?

16.202.s:
kṛṣṇena hi vinā nāhaṃ yāsye duryodhanāntikam ..
pāṇḍavānvā samāśritya kathaṃ duryodhanaṃ nṛpam .. 6 ..
16.202.d:
कृष्णेन हि विना नाहं यास्ये दुर्योधनान्तिकम् ..
पाण्डवान्वा समाश्रित्य कथं दुर्योधनं नृपम् .. 6 ..
16.202.m: Without Kṛṣṇa I will not go to Duryodhana; / or, taking refuge with the Pāṇḍavas, how [could I go against] King Duryodhana?

16.202.s:
jāmātaraṃ tathā śiṣyaṃ ghātayiṣye nareśvaram ..
tasmānna pārthaṃ yāsyāmi nāpi duryodhanaṃ nṛpam .. 7 ..
16.202.d:
जामातरं तथा शिष्यं घातयिष्ये नरेश्वरम् ..
तस्मान्न पार्थं यास्यामि नापि दुर्योधनं नृपम् .. 7 ..
16.202.m: How shall I cause the king to be slain, my son-in-law and likewise my disciple? / Therefore I will not go to Pārtha, nor to King Duryodhana.

16.202.s:
tīrtheṣvāplāvayiṣyāmi tāvadātmānamātmanā ..
kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yāvadaṃtāya kalpate .. .. 8 ..
16.202.d:
तीर्थेष्वाप्लावयिष्यामि तावदात्मानमात्मना ..
कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च यावदंताय कल्पते .. .. 8 ..
16.202.m: I shall bathe myself in tīrthas by my own self, / so long as it tends toward the destruction of the Kurus and Pāṇḍavas.'

16.202.s:
ityādiśya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pārthaduryodhanāvapi ..
jagāma dvārakāṃ śauriḥ svasainyaiśca parīvṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
16.202.d:
इत्यादिश्य हृषीकेशं पार्थदुर्योधनावपि ..
जगाम द्वारकां शौरिः स्वसैन्यैश्च परीवृतः .. 9 ..
16.202.m: Having thus instructed Hṛṣīkeśa, and Pārtha and Duryodhana as well, / Śauri went to Dvārakā, surrounded by his own troops.

16.202.s:
gatvā dvārāvatīṃ rāmo hṛṣṭatuṣṭajanākulām ..
svairantaḥpuragaiḥ sārdhaṃ papau pānaṃ halāyudhaḥ .. 7.1.202.10 ..
16.202.d:
गत्वा द्वारावतीं रामो हृष्टतुष्टजनाकुलाम् ..
स्वैरन्तःपुरगैः सार्धं पपौ पानं हलायुधः .. 7.1.202.10 ..
16.202.m: Having arrived at Dvārāvatī, filled with glad and contented people, / the weapon-of-a-plow-wielder drank wine along with the women of his own inner apartments.

16.202.s:
pītapāno jagāmātha raivatodyānamṛddhimat ..
haste gṛhītvā sa gadāṃ revatyādibhiranvitaḥ .. 11 ..
16.202.d:
पीतपानो जगामाथ रैवतोद्यानमृद्धिमत् ..
हस्ते गृहीत्वा स गदां रेवत्यादिभिरन्वितः .. 11 ..
16.202.m: Having drunk the liquor, he then went to the flourishing Raivata garden, / taking his mace in hand, accompanied by Revatī and others.

16.202.s:
strīkadaṃbakamadhyastho yayau mattavadāskhalan ..
dadarśa ca vanaṃ vīro ramaṇīyamanuttamam .. 12 ..
16.202.d:
स्त्रीकदंबकमध्यस्थो ययौ मत्तवदास्खलन् ..
ददर्श च वनं वीरो रमणीयमनुत्तमम् .. 12 ..
16.202.m: Standing in the midst of a multitude of women, he walked, stumbling like one intoxicated; / and the hero beheld the forest, delightful and unsurpassed,

16.202.s:
sarvatra tarupuṣpāḍhyaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇākulam ..
puṣpa padmavanopetaṃ sapalvalamahāvanam .. 13 ..
16.202.d:
सर्वत्र तरुपुष्पाढ्यं शाखामृगगणाकुलम् ..
पुष्प पद्मवनोपेतं सपल्वलमहावनम् .. 13 ..
16.202.m: abounding everywhere with flowering trees, teeming with troops of monkeys, / endowed with groves of flowers and lotuses, a great forest with pools,

16.202.s:
sa śṛṇvanprītijanakānvanyānmadakalāñchubhān ..
śrotraramyānsumadhurāñchabdānkhagasukheritān .. 14 ..
16.202.d:
स शृण्वन्प्रीतिजनकान्वन्यान्मदकलाञ्छुभान् ..
श्रोत्ररम्यान्सुमधुराञ्छब्दान्खगसुखेरितान् .. 14 ..
16.202.m: hearing wild, charmingly melodious, auspicious sounds / that produced pleasure, delightful to the ear, and very sweet, uttered by happy birds.

16.202.s:
sarvataḥ phalaratnāḍhyānsarvataḥ kusumojjvalān ..
apaśyatpādapāṃścaiva vihagairanumoditān .. 15 ..
16.202.d:
सर्वतः फलरत्नाढ्यान्सर्वतः कुसुमोज्ज्वलान् ..
अपश्यत्पादपांश्चैव विहगैरनुमोदितान् .. 15 ..
16.202.m: He saw trees rich in precious fruits on every side, / bright with blossoms on every side, celebrated by birds:

16.202.s:
āmrānāgrātakānbhavyānnālikerānsatiṃdukān ..
ābalvanāṃsthā pītāndāḍimānbījapūrakān..
panasām̐llakucānmocāṃstāpāṃścāpi manoharān ..
pālevatānkusaṃkullānnalinānatha vetasān .. 17 ..
16.202.d:
आम्रानाग्रातकान्भव्यान्नालिकेरान्सतिंदुकान् ..
आबल्वनांस्था पीतान्दाडिमान्बीजपूरकान्..
पनसाम्̐ल्लकुचान्मोचांस्तापांश्चापि मनोहरान् ..
पालेवतान्कुसंकुल्लान्नलिनानथ वेतसान् .. 17 ..
16.202.m: mangoes, āmrātakas, bhavya trees, coconuts with tindukas, / ābalvanas, and pītas, pomegranates, bījapūrakas, / jackfruits, lakucas, plantains, and lovely tāpas, / pālevatas, kusaṅkullas, nalinas, and canes,

16.202.s:
bhallātakānāmalakīṃstindukāṃśca mahāphalān ..
iṃgudānkaramardāṃśca harītakabibhītakān .. 18 ..
16.202.d:
भल्लातकानामलकींस्तिन्दुकांश्च महाफलान् ..
इंगुदान्करमर्दांश्च हरीतकबिभीतकान् .. 18 ..
16.202.m: marking-nut trees, myrobalans, and large-fruited tindukas, / ingudas, karamardas, and harītakas and vibhītakas.

16.202.s:
etānanyāṃśca sa tarūndadarśa yadunandanaḥ ..
tathaivāśokapunnāgaketakībakulāṃstathā .. 19 ..
16.202.d:
एतानन्यांश्च स तरून्ददर्श यदुनन्दनः ..
तथैवाशोकपुन्नागकेतकीबकुलांस्तथा .. 19 ..
16.202.m: These and other trees the son of the Yadus saw, / and likewise aśoka, punnāga, ketakī, and bakula,

16.202.s:
caṃpakānsaptaparṇāṃśca karṇikārānsumālatīḥ ..
pārijātānkovidārā nmandārendīvarāṃstathā .. 7.1.202.20 ..
16.202.d:
चंपकान्सप्तपर्णांश्च कर्णिकारान्सुमालतीः ..
पारिजातान्कोविदारा न्मन्दारेन्दीवरांस्तथा .. 7.1.202.20 ..
16.202.m: campakas, saptaparṇas, karṇikāras, fine mālati creepers, / pārijātas, kovidāras, mandāras, and blue water-lilies,

16.202.s:
pāṭalānpuṣpitānrambhāndevadārudrumāṃstathā ..
śālāṃstālāṃśca stamālāṃniculānvañjulāṃstathā .. 21 ..
16.202.d:
पाटलान्पुष्पितान्रम्भान्देवदारुद्रुमांस्तथा ..
शालांस्तालांश्च स्तमालांनिचुलान्वञ्जुलांस्तथा .. 21 ..
16.202.m: flowering trumpet-flower trees, plantains, and devadāru trees, / sāl trees, palmyras, tamālas, niculas, and vañjulas,

16.202.s:
cakoraiḥ śatapatraiśca bhṛṃgarājaiḥ samāvṛtān ..
kokilaiḥ kalaviṃkaiśca hārītairjīvajīvakaiḥ .. 22 ..
16.202.d:
चकोरैः शतपत्रैश्च भृंगराजैः समावृतान् ..
कोकिलैः कलविंकैश्च हारीतैर्जीवजीवकैः .. 22 ..
16.202.m: covered with cakoras, hundred-feathered woodpeckers, and bhṛṅgarājas, / with cuckoos, sparrows, green pigeons, and jīvañjīvaka birds,

16.202.s:
priyaputraiścātakaiśca śukairanyairvihaṃgamaiḥ ..
śrotraramyaṃ sumadhuraṃ kūja dbhiścāpyadhiṣṭhitaiḥ .. 23 ..
16.202.d:
प्रियपुत्रैश्चातकैश्च शुकैरन्यैर्विहंगमैः ..
श्रोत्ररम्यं सुमधुरं कूज द्भिश्चाप्यधिष्ठितैः .. 23 ..
16.202.m: occupied by priyaputras, cātakas, parrots, and other birds / that cooed delightfully to the ear and very sweetly,

16.202.s:
sarāṃsi ca sapadmāni manojñasalilāni ca ..
kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tathā rocanakotpalaiḥ .. 24 ..
16.202.d:
सरांसि च सपद्मानि मनोज्ञसलिलानि च ..
कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश्च तथा रोचनकोत्पलैः .. 24 ..
16.202.m: and lakes with lotus blossoms and delightful water, / with white water-lilies, puṇḍarīka lotuses, and bright blue utpalas.

16.202.s:
kahlāraiḥ kamalaiścāpi carcitāni samaṃtataḥ ..
kadaṃbaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ .. 25 ..
16.202.d:
कह्लारैः कमलैश्चापि चर्चितानि समंततः ..
कदंबैश्चक्रवाकैश्च तथैव जलकुक्कुटैः .. 25 ..
16.202.m: Covered all around with kahlāra and lotus flowers, / and likewise with kadamba birds, cakravākas, and waterfowls,

16.202.s:
kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavairhaṃsaiḥ kūrmairmaṃḍubhireva ca ..
etairanyaiśca kīrṇāni tathānyairjalavā sibhiḥ .. 26 ..
16.202.d:
कारण्डवैः प्लवैर्हंसैः कूर्मैर्मंडुभिरेव च ..
एतैरन्यैश्च कीर्णानि तथान्यैर्जलवा सिभिः .. 26 ..
16.202.m: teeming with kāraṇḍavas, plavas, swans, tortoises, and frogs, / as well as other [creatures] and various aquatic animals.

16.202.s:
krameṇa saṃcaranrāmaḥ prekṣamāṇo manoramam ..
jagāmānugataḥ strībhirlatāgṛhamanuttamam .. 27 ..
16.202.d:
क्रमेण संचरन्रामः प्रेक्षमाणो मनोरमम् ..
जगामानुगतः स्त्रीभिर्लतागृहमनुत्तमम् .. 27 ..
16.202.m: Moving about by degrees and beholding the delightful [scene], / Rāma, followed by women, reached an unsurpassed bower of creepers.

16.202.s:
sa dadarśa dvijāṃstatra vedavedāṃgapāra gān ..
kauśikānbhārgavāṃścaiva bhāradvājāṃśca gautamān .. 28 ..
16.202.d:
स ददर्श द्विजांस्तत्र वेदवेदांगपार गान् ..
कौशिकान्भार्गवांश्चैव भारद्वाजांश्च गौतमान् .. 28 ..
16.202.m: There he saw twice-borns who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas: / Kauśikas, Bhārgavas, Bhāradvājas, and Gautamas,

16.202.s:
vividheṣu ca saṃbhūtānvaṃśeṣu dvijasattamān ..
kathāśravaṇasotkaṇṭhānupaviṣṭānmahā tmanaḥ .. 29 ..
16.202.d:
विविधेषु च संभूतान्वंशेषु द्विजसत्तमान् ..
कथाश्रवणसोत्कण्ठानुपविष्टान्महा त्मनः .. 29 ..
16.202.m: the best of twice-borns, born in various lineages, / sitting eager to hear stories, high-souled,

16.202.s:
kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṣu kūrceṣu ca vṛsīṣu ca ..
sūte ca teṣāṃ madhyasthaṃ kathayānaṃ kathāḥ śubhāḥ .. 7.1.202.30 ..
16.202.d:
कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयेषु कूर्चेषु च वृसीषु च ..
सूते च तेषां मध्यस्थं कथयानं कथाः शुभाः .. 7.1.202.30 ..
16.202.m: on black antelopeskins used as upper cloths, on grass seats, and on cushions; / and, in their midst, Sūta narrating auspicious tales,

16.202.s:
paurāṇikāḥ surarṣīṇāmā dyānāṃ caritakriyāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ dvijāḥ sarve madhupānāruṇekṣaṇam .. 31 ..
16.202.d:
पौराणिकाः सुरर्षीणामा द्यानां चरितक्रियाः ..
दृष्ट्वा रामं द्विजाः सर्वे मधुपानारुणेक्षणम् .. 31 ..
16.202.m: the ancient deeds and actions of the primordial divine seers. / Seeing Rāma with eyes reddened from drinking wine,

16.202.s:
matto'yamiti manvānāḥ samuttasthustvarānvitāḥ ..
pūjayanto haladharaṃ tamṛte sūtavaṃśajam .. 32 ..
16.202.d:
मत्तोऽयमिति मन्वानाः समुत्तस्थुस्त्वरान्विताः ..
पूजयन्तो हलधरं तमृते सूतवंशजम् .. 32 ..
16.202.m: thinking, "He is intoxicated," all the twice-borns rose up in haste, / paying homage to the wielder of the plough, except for that descendant of the Sūta lineage.

16.202.s:
tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo halī sūtaṃ mahābalaḥ ..
nijaghāna vivṛttākṣaḥ kṣobhitāśeṣadānavaḥ .. 33 ..
16.202.d:
ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो हली सूतं महाबलः ..
निजघान विवृत्ताक्षः क्षोभिताशेषदानवः .. 33 ..
16.202.m: Then, overwhelmed with anger, the mighty plough-bearer, / with rolling eyes, having agitated all Dānavas, struck Sūta dead.

16.202.s:
anvāsite padaṃ brāhmyaṃ tasminsūte nipātite ..
niṣkrāntāste dvijāḥ sarve vanātkṛṣṇājināṃbarāḥ .. 34 ..
16.202.d:
अन्वासिते पदं ब्राह्म्यं तस्मिन्सूते निपातिते ..
निष्क्रान्तास्ते द्विजाः सर्वे वनात्कृष्णाजिनांबराः .. 34 ..
16.202.m: When that Sūta, who occupied the seat of a brahmin, was struck down, / all those twice-borns wearing black antelopeskins departed from the forest.

16.202.s:
avadhūtaṃ tathātmānaṃ manyamāno halāyudhaḥ ..
cintayāmāsa sumahanmayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam .. 35 ..
16.202.d:
अवधूतं तथात्मानं मन्यमानो हलायुधः ..
चिन्तयामास सुमहन्मया पापमिदं कृतम् .. 35 ..
16.202.m: Deeming himself thus humiliated, the wielder of the plough / reflected: "A very great sin has been committed by me!

16.202.s:
brahmāsanagato hyeṣa yaḥ sūto vinipātitaḥ..
tathā hyete dvijāḥ sarve māmavekṣya vinirgatāḥ .. 36 ..
16.202.d:
ब्रह्मासनगतो ह्येष यः सूतो विनिपातितः..
तथा ह्येते द्विजाः सर्वे मामवेक्ष्य विनिर्गताः .. 36 ..
16.202.m: For it was one seated on the seat of a brahmin, Sūta, who was struck down! / And indeed, seeing me, all these twice-borns have departed!

16.202.s:
śarīrasya ca me gandho lohasyevāsukhāvahaḥ ..
ātmānaṃ cāvagacchāmi brahmaghnamiti kutsitam .. 37 ..
16.202.d:
शरीरस्य च मे गन्धो लोहस्येवासुखावहः ..
आत्मानं चावगच्छामि ब्रह्मघ्नमिति कुत्सितम् .. 37 ..
16.202.m: And the smell of my body is unpleasant like that of iron; / and I realize that I am vile, a slayer of a brahmin!

16.202.s:
dhiṅmamārthaṃ tathā madyaṃ mahimānamakīrtidam ..
yenā viṣṭena sumahanmayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam..38..
16.202.d:
धिङ्ममार्थं तथा मद्यं महिमानमकीर्तिदम् ..
येना विष्टेन सुमहन्मया पापमिदं कृतम्..38..
16.202.m: Fie on my wealth, on wine, and on renown that brings no fame, / possessed by which such a great sin was committed by me!

16.202.s:
smṛtyuktaṃ te kariṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi..
uktamastyeva manunā prāyaścittādikaṃ kramāt..39..
japaḥ pracchannapāpānāṃ manastāpa eva ca..
bhūtātmanastapovidye buddherjñānaṃ viśodhanam..7.1.202.4..
16.202.d:
स्मृत्युक्तं ते करिष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तं यथाविधि..
उक्तमस्त्येव मनुना प्रायश्चित्तादिकं क्रमात्..39..
जपः प्रच्छन्नपापानां मनस्ताप एव च..
भूतात्मनस्तपोविद्ये बुद्धेर्ज्ञानं विशोधनम्..7.1.202.4..
16.202.m:
I shall perform for you an expiation as prescribed by the legal treatises in accordance with rule; / indeed, Manu has declared expiation and the rest in proper order:
'Japa and remorse are the purifier of hidden sins; / austerity and knowledge of the inner self; spiritual knowledge of the intellect.'

16.202.s:
kṣetreśvarasya vijñānādviśuddhiḥ paramā matā..
śarīrasya viśuddhistu prāyaścittaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ.. 41..
16.202.d:
क्षेत्रेश्वरस्य विज्ञानाद्विशुद्धिः परमा मता..
शरीरस्य विशुद्धिस्तु प्रायश्चित्तैः पृथग्विधैः.. 41..
16.202.m: Purification is deemed supreme from the direct knowledge of the lord of the field; / but purification of the body is by various kinds of expiations.

16.202.s:
tato'dyataḥ kariṣyāmi vrataṃ dvādaśavārṣikam..
svakarmakhyāpanaṃ kurvanprāyaścittamanuttamam..42..
16.202.d:
ततोऽद्यतः करिष्यामि व्रतं द्वादशवार्षिकम्..
स्वकर्मख्यापनं कुर्वन्प्रायश्चित्तमनुत्तमम्..42..
16.202.m: Therefore, from today I shall undertake a twelve-year vow, / proclaiming my own deed, performing unsurpassed expiation.

16.202.s:
iyaṃ viśuddhirajñānāddhatvā cākāmato dvijam ..
kāmato brāhmaṇavadhe niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate .. 43 ..
16.202.d:
इयं विशुद्धिरज्ञानाद्धत्वा चाकामतो द्विजम् ..
कामतो ब्राह्मणवधे निष्कृतिर्न विधीयते .. 43 ..
16.202.m: This purification is for one who unintentionally strikes a twice-born out of ignorance; / for intentionally killing a brahmin, no expiation is prescribed.

16.202.s:
yaḥ kāmato mahāpāpaṃ naraḥ kurynātkathaṃcana ..
na tasya niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā bhṛgvagnipatanādṛte .. 44 ..
16.202.d:
यः कामतो महापापं नरः कुर्य्नात्कथंचन ..
न तस्य निष्कृतिर्दृष्टा भृग्वग्निपतनादृते .. 44 ..
16.202.m: If a man should intentionally commit a great sin in any way, / no expiation is seen for him except throwing oneself from a cliff or into fire.

16.202.s:
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ..
kāmakārakṛte'pyāhureke śrutinidarśanāt .. 45 ..
16.202.d:
अकामतः कृते पापे प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः ..
कामकारकृतेऽप्याहुरेके श्रुतिनिदर्शनात् .. 45 ..
16.202.m: The wise know of expiation when a sin is committed unintentionally; / some say it is valid even when done intentionally, on the evidence of Vedic revelation.

16.202.s:
vidhiḥ prāthamikastasmāddvitīye dviguṇaṃ caret ..
tṛtīye triguṇaṃ proktaṃ caturthe nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ .. 46 ..
16.202.d:
विधिः प्राथमिकस्तस्माद्द्वितीये द्विगुणं चरेत् ..
तृतीये त्रिगुणं प्रोक्तं चतुर्थे नास्ति निष्कृतिः .. 46 ..
16.202.m: That is the rule for the first time; for a second time, one should perform twice as much; / for a third time, threefold is declared; for a fourth time, there is no expiation.

16.202.s:
auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ dadadgobrāhmaṇādiṣu ..
dīyamāne vipattiḥ syānna sa pāpena lipyate .. 47 ..
16.202.d:
औषधं स्नेहमाहारं ददद्गोब्राह्मणादिषु ..
दीयमाने विपत्तिः स्यान्न स पापेन लिप्यते .. 47 ..
16.202.m: One who gives medicine, oil, or food to cows, brahmins, and others, / if death should occur while it is being given, he is not tainted by sin.

16.202.s:
akāraṇaṃ tu yaḥ kaściddvijaḥ prāṇānparityajet ..
tasyaiva tatra doṣaḥ syānna tu yo'smai dadāti tat .. 48 ..
16.202.d:
अकारणं तु यः कश्चिद्द्विजः प्राणान्परित्यजेत् ..
तस्यैव तत्र दोषः स्यान्न तु योऽस्मै ददाति तत् .. 48 ..
16.202.m: If any twice-born should give up his life without cause, / the fault would belong only to him, not to the one who gives it to him.

16.202.s:
pariṣkṛto yadā vipro hatvā''tmānaṃ mṛto yadi ..
nirguṇaḥ sahasā krodhādgṛhakṣetrādikāraṇāt .. 49 ..
16.202.d:
परिष्कृतो यदा विप्रो हत्वा'ऽत्मानं मृतो यदि ..
निर्गुणः सहसा क्रोधाद्गृहक्षेत्रादिकारणात् .. 49 ..
16.202.m: When a qualified brahmin, having struck himself, dies / without merit, suddenly out of anger on account of a house, land, and the like,

16.202.s:
trivārṣikaṃ vrataṃ kuryā tpratilomāṃ sarasvatīm ..
gacchedvāpi viśuddhyarthaṃ tatpāpasyeti niścitam .. 7.1.202.50 ..
16.202.d:
त्रिवार्षिकं व्रतं कुर्या त्प्रतिलोमां सरस्वतीम् ..
गच्छेद्वापि विशुद्ध्यर्थं तत्पापस्येति निश्चितम् .. 7.1.202.50 ..
16.202.m: one should observe a three-year vow, or go to Sarasvatī flowing upstream / for the sake of purification from that sin; this is determined.

16.202.s:
uddiśya kupito hatvā toṣitaṃ vāsayetpunaḥ ..
tasminmṛte na doṣo'sti dvayorucchrāvaṇe kṛte .. 51 ..
16.202.d:
उद्दिश्य कुपितो हत्वा तोषितं वासयेत्पुनः ..
तस्मिन्मृते न दोषोऽस्ति द्वयोरुच्छ्रावणे कृते .. 51 ..
16.202.m: Having struck [him] out of anger with an intention, if one placates him and allows him to dwell again, / if he dies after mutual proclamation is made, there is no fault.

16.202.s:
ṣaṇḍhaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret ..
bahūnāmekakāryāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastradhāriṇām .. 52 ..
16.202.d:
षण्ढं तु ब्राह्मणं हत्वा शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् ..
बहूनामेककार्याणां सर्वेषां शस्त्रधारिणाम् .. 52 ..
16.202.m: If one kills an impotent brahmin, one should observe the vow for killing a śūdra. / When many bearing weapons have a common purpose,

16.202.s:
yadyeko ghātayettatra sarve te ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
prāyaścitte vyavasite yadi kartā vipadyate .. 53 ..
16.202.d:
यद्येको घातयेत्तत्र सर्वे ते घातकाः स्मृताः ..
प्रायश्चित्ते व्यवसिते यदि कर्ता विपद्यते .. 53 ..
16.202.m: if one among them kills, they are all remembered as killers. / When an expiation is resolved upon, if the doer should die,

16.202.s:
enastatprāpnuyādenamiha loke paratra ca ..
tadahaṃ kiṃ karomyeṣa kva gacchāmi durātmavān .. 54 ..
16.202.d:
एनस्तत्प्राप्नुयादेनमिह लोके परत्र च ..
तदहं किं करोम्येष क्व गच्छामि दुरात्मवान् .. 54 ..
16.202.m: sin would attach to him in this world and in the next. / What then shall I do, vile-souled as I am? Where shall I go?

16.202.s: dhiṅmāṃ ca pāpacaritaṃ mahāduṣkṛtakarmiṇam .. 55 ..
16.202.d: धिङ्मां च पापचरितं महादुष्कृतकर्मिणम् .. 55 ..
16.202.m: Fie on me of sinful conduct, a committer of great evil deeds!"

16.202.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ityevaṃ vilapanyāvacchokā kulitamānasaḥ ..
tāvadākāśasaṃbhūtā vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 56 ..
16.202.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्येवं विलपन्यावच्छोका कुलितमानसः ..
तावदाकाशसंभूता वागुवाचाशरीरिणी .. 56 ..
16.202.m: Īśvara said: / While he was lamenting in this manner, his mind agitated by sorrow, / an incorporeal voice arisen from the sky spoke:

16.202.s:
bhobho rāma na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ..
gaccha prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra devī sarasvatī .. 57 ..
16.202.d:
भोभो राम न संतापस्त्वया कार्यः कथंचन ..
गच्छ प्राभासिकं क्षेत्रं यत्र देवी सरस्वती .. 57 ..
16.202.m: "O Rāma! You must not feel anguish in any way! / Go to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, where the goddess Sarasvatī resides.

16.202.s:
pañcasrotāḥ sthitā tatra pañcapātakanāśanī ..
nadīnāṃ pravarā sā tu brahmabhūtā sarasvatī .. 58 ..
16.202.d:
पञ्चस्रोताः स्थिता तत्र पञ्चपातकनाशनी ..
नदीनां प्रवरा सा तु ब्रह्मभूता सरस्वती .. 58 ..
16.202.m: Having five streams, she is present there, the destroyer of the five great sins; / she is the foremost of rivers, Sarasvatī identical with Brahman.

16.202.s:
ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni brahmāṇḍe sacarācare ..
gaṃgādīni naraśreṣṭha teṣāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī .. 59 ..
16.202.d:
एकतः सर्वतीर्थानि ब्रह्माण्डे सचराचरे ..
गंगादीनि नरश्रेष्ठ तेषां पुण्या सरस्वती .. 59 ..
16.202.m: On the one side are all the sacred fords in the cosmic egg containing the moving and unmoving, / such as the Gaṅgā, O best of men; yet holy is Sarasvatī beyond them!

16.202.s:
tāvadgarjaṃti pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
yāvanna dṛśyate devī prabhāsasthā sara svatī .. 7.1.202.60 ..
16.202.d:
तावद्गर्जंति पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ..
यावन्न दृश्यते देवी प्रभासस्था सर स्वती .. 7.1.202.60 ..
16.202.m: Sins such as killing a brahmin roar only so long / as the goddess Sarasvatī situated at Prabhāsa is not seen.

16.202.s:
tasmāttatraiva gaccha tvaṃ yatra devī sarasvatī ..
nānyaistīrthaiḥ sahasraistvaṃ kartuṃ śakyo vikalmaṣaḥ .. 61 ..
16.202.d:
तस्मात्तत्रैव गच्छ त्वं यत्र देवी सरस्वती ..
नान्यैस्तीर्थैः सहस्रैस्त्वं कर्तुं शक्यो विकल्मषः .. 61 ..
16.202.m: Therefore, go to that very place where the goddess Sarasvatī is; / you cannot be made free of sin by thousands of other sacred fords!

16.202.s:
tanmā kārṣīrvilaṃbaṃ tvaṃ gaccha tīraṃ mahodadheḥ ..
prābhāsike mahādevīṃ pratilomāṃ vigāhaya .. 62 ..
16.202.d:
तन्मा कार्षीर्विलंबं त्वं गच्छ तीरं महोदधेः ..
प्राभासिके महादेवीं प्रतिलोमां विगाहय .. 62 ..
16.202.m: So do not delay; go to the shore of the great ocean; / in Prabhāsa, plunge into the great goddess flowing upstream!

16.202.s:
tatraivārādhaya vibhuṃ liṃgarūpiṇamīśvaram ..
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāpāpācchārī rāttvaṃ vimokṣyasi .. 63 ..
16.202.d:
तत्रैवाराधय विभुं लिंगरूपिणमीश्वरम् ..
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महापापाच्छारी रात्त्वं विमोक्ष्यसि .. 63 ..
16.202.m: Worship the all-pervading Lord Īśvara there in the form of a liṅga; / having installed [him], you will be released from the great bodily sin."

16.202.s:
iti śrutvā vaco rāmaḥ paramānaṃdapūritaḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetragamane matiṃ cakre mahāmanāḥ .. 64 ..
16.202.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो रामः परमानंदपूरितः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रगमने मतिं चक्रे महामनाः .. 64 ..
16.202.m: Having heard these words, Rāma, filled with supreme bliss, / noble-minded, set his mind upon going to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.202.s:
tataḥ svasainyasaṃyukto dravyopaskarasaṃyutaḥ ..
ājagāma mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam .. 65 ..
16.202.d:
ततः स्वसैन्यसंयुक्तो द्रव्योपस्करसंयुतः ..
आजगाम महाक्षेत्रं प्रभासमिति विश्रुतम् .. 65 ..
16.202.m: Then, accompanied by his own army and equipped with materials and provisions, / he came to the great sacred field known as Prabhāsa.

16.202.s:
dṛṣṭvā manorama tīrthaṃ sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame ..
cakāra hṛdi saṃkalpaṃ prati lomāvagāhane .. 66 ..
16.202.d:
दृष्ट्वा मनोरम तीर्थं सरस्वत्यब्धिसंगमे ..
चकार हृदि संकल्पं प्रति लोमावगाहने .. 66 ..
16.202.m: Beholding the charming sacred ford at the confluence of Sarasvatī and the ocean, / he formed the resolve in his heart to bathe [in her waters] flowing upstream.

16.202.s:
āhūya brāhmaṇāṃstatra prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ ..
samyagyātrāvidhānena yātrāṃ tatrākarodvibhuḥ .. 67 ..
16.202.d:
आहूय ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनः ..
सम्यग्यात्राविधानेन यात्रां तत्राकरोद्विभुः .. 67 ..
16.202.m: Having summoned the brahmins dwelling in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / the powerful lord made a pilgrimage there according to the proper rules of pilgrimage.

16.202.s:
yāni prābhāsike kṣetre tīrthāni vividhāni tu ..
raviyojanasaṃsthāni teṣu yātrāṃ cakāra saḥ .. 68 ..
16.202.d:
यानि प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे तीर्थानि विविधानि तु ..
रवियोजनसंस्थानि तेषु यात्रां चकार सः .. 68 ..
16.202.m: To whichever various sacred fords there were in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / situated within twelve yojanas, he made a pilgrimage to them.

16.202.s:
pratyekaṃ ca dadau teṣu dānāni vividhāni tu ..
tathā'dhaḥ sthāpa yāmāsa sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame .. 69 ..
16.202.d:
प्रत्येकं च ददौ तेषु दानानि विविधानि तु ..
तथाऽधः स्थाप यामास सरस्वत्यब्धिसंगमे .. 69 ..
16.202.m: And at each of them he gave various gifts; / likewise, down at the confluence of Sarasvatī and the ocean, he set [his camp].

16.202.s:
pūrvabhāge mahāliṃgaṃ kṛtvā yajñavidhikriyām ..
evaṃ kṛte mahādevi vimuktaḥ pātakairabhūt .. 7.1.202.70 ..
16.202.d:
पूर्वभागे महालिंगं कृत्वा यज्ञविधिक्रियाम् ..
एवं कृते महादेवि विमुक्तः पातकैरभूत् .. 7.1.202.70 ..
16.202.m: having performed the ritual rites of sacrifice before the great liṅga in the eastern part. / When this was done, O great goddess, he became freed from sins.

16.202.s:
nirmarlāṃgastato devi dināni daśa saṃsthitaḥ ..
tatastāṃ caiva sa snātvā pratilomāṃ kramādyayau ..
plakṣāvaharaṇaṃ yāvatsamudrācca himāhvayam .. .. 71 ..
16.202.d:
निर्मर्लांगस्ततो देवि दिनानि दश संस्थितः ..
ततस्तां चैव स स्नात्वा प्रतिलोमां क्रमाद्ययौ ..
प्लक्षावहरणं यावत्समुद्राच्च हिमाह्वयम् .. .. 71 ..
16.202.m: His body purified, O goddess, he then stayed for ten days. / Then, having bathed in her, he went upstream by degrees, / from the ocean up to the Plakṣā descent called Hima.

16.202.s:
evaṃ muktaḥ sa pāpaughai rāmo'bhūtprathitaḥ priye ..
tasya liṃgasya māhātmyātsarasvatyāḥ prasādataḥ .. 72 ..
16.202.d:
एवं मुक्तः स पापौघै रामोऽभूत्प्रथितः प्रिये ..
तस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्यात्सरस्वत्याः प्रसादतः .. 72 ..
16.202.m: Thus freed from the flood of sins, Rāma became famous, O beloved, / by the power of that liṅga and through the grace of the Sarasvatī.

16.202.s:
yastatpūjayate devi liṃgaṃ pāpabhayāpaham ..
rāmeśvareti kathitaṃ so'pi mucyeta pātakāt .. 73 ..
16.202.d:
यस्तत्पूजयते देवि लिंगं पापभयापहम् ..
रामेश्वरेति कथितं सोऽपि मुच्येत पातकात् .. 73 ..
16.202.m: Whoever worships that liṅga which removes the fear of sin, O goddess, / called Rāmeśvara, he too is freed from sin.

16.202.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa brahmakūrcavidhānataḥ ..
yastatra kurute devi so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 74 ..
16.202.d:
अष्टम्यां च विशेषेण ब्रह्मकूर्चविधानतः ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते देवि सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 74 ..
16.202.m: Especially on the eighth day, according to the rule of brahmakūrca, / whoever does [so] there, O goddess, obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.202.s:
snātvā tatra varārohe sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame ..
rāmeśvaretināmānaṃ tataḥ saṃpūjya śaṃkaram ..
godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 75 ..
16.202.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र वरारोहे सरस्वत्यब्धिसंगमे ..
रामेश्वरेतिनामानं ततः संपूज्य शंकरम् ..
गोदानं तत्र देयं तु सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 75 ..
16.202.m: Having bathed there, O woman of fair hips, at the confluence of the Sarasvatī and the ocean, / and then fully worshipping Śaṃkara named Rāmeśvara, / the gift of a cow should be given there by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.202.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi rāmeśvaramahodayam ..
yacchrutvā mānavaḥ samyakchraddhāvānprāpnuyāddivam .. 76 ..
16.202.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि रामेश्वरमहोदयम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवः सम्यक्छ्रद्धावान्प्राप्नुयाद्दिवम् .. 76 ..
16.202.m: Thus has the great majesty of Rāmeśvara been told, O goddess; / hearing this with faith, a man attains heaven.

16.202.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 202 .. .. cha ..
16.202.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रामेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 202 .. .. छ ..
16.202.m: Thus ends the two hundred and second chapter, named 'Description of the Rāmeśvarakṣetra-māhātmya', in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.203.s:
..īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi maṃkīśvara mahālayam ..
rāmeśāduttare bhāge devamātuḥ samīpagam .. 1 ..
16.203.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मंकीश्वर महालयम् ..
रामेशादुत्तरे भागे देवमातुः समीपगम् .. 1 ..
16.203.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the great shrine of Maṅkīśvara, / to the north of Rāmeśa, near the mother of the gods,

16.203.s:
arkasthalāttato yāmye pūrvataśca kṛtasmarāt ..
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu maṃkinā sthāpitaṃ purā .. 2 ..
16.203.d:
अर्कस्थलात्ततो याम्ये पूर्वतश्च कृतस्मरात् ..
लिंगं महाप्रभावं तु मंकिना स्थापितं पुरा .. 2 ..
16.203.m: and to the south of Arkasthala, and east of Kṛtasmara. / The liṅga of great power was installed long ago by Maṅki.

16.203.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyagaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
16.203.d: तं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सम्यगश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 3 ..
16.203.m: Having seen it, a man properly obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

16.203.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
ko'sau maṃkirmahādeva kathaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
kiṃ prabhāvaṃ ca talliṃgametanme vada vistarāt .. 4 ..
16.203.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कोऽसौ मंकिर्महादेव कथं लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
किं प्रभावं च तल्लिंगमेतन्मे वद विस्तरात् .. 4 ..
16.203.m: The goddess said: / Who was this Maṅki, O Mahādeva? How was the liṅga established? / And what is the power of that liṅga? Tell me this in detail.

16.203.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
maṃkirnāmābhavatpūrvaṃ kubjakāyo dvijottamaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādyatapastepe mahattamam .. 5 ..
16.203.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
मंकिर्नामाभवत्पूर्वं कुब्जकायो द्विजोत्तमः ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्यतपस्तेपे महत्तमम् .. 5 ..
16.203.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly there was an excellent twice-born named Maṅki, who had a hunchbacked body. / Having reached the Prabhāsa kṣetra, he performed the greatest austerity.

16.203.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
na tutoṣa harastasya vahuvarṣagaṇārcitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.203.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महादेवं शिवभक्तिपरायणः ..
न तुतोष हरस्तस्य वहुवर्षगणार्चितः .. 6 ..
16.203.m: Having installed Mahādeva, devoted to the worship of Śiva, / Hara was not pleased with him, though worshipped for many groups of years.

16.203.s:
tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya siddhiṃ prāptā hyanekaśaḥ ..
tatrārādhya mahādevaṃ svargalokamito gatāḥ .. 7 ..
16.203.d:
तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य सिद्धिं प्राप्ता ह्यनेकशः ..
तत्राराध्य महादेवं स्वर्गलोकमितो गताः .. 7 ..
16.203.m: While he was thus performing austerity, many indeed attained perfection; / having worshipped Mahādeva there, they departed from here to the heavenly world.

16.203.s:
tato duḥkhaṃ samabhavanmaṃkestatra varānane ..
kasmānme bhagavāṃstuṣṭiṃ na gacchati maheśvaraḥ .. 8 ..
16.203.d:
ततो दुःखं समभवन्मंकेस्तत्र वरानने ..
कस्मान्मे भगवांस्तुष्टिं न गच्छति महेश्वरः .. 8 ..
16.203.m: Then sorrow arose for Maṅki there, O fair-faced one: / 'Why does the blessed Maheśvara not take pleasure in me?'

16.203.s:
tatastīvraratiṃ cakre kṛtvā tīvranivartanam ..
evaṃ vṛddhatvamāpanno japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 9 ..
16.203.d:
ततस्तीव्ररतिं चक्रे कृत्वा तीव्रनिवर्तनम् ..
एवं वृद्धत्वमापन्नो जपध्यानपरायणः .. 9 ..
16.203.m: Then he conceived an intense devotion, practicing intense cessation [of worldly thought]; / thus he reached old age, intent on repetition [of mantras] and meditation.

16.203.s:
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo vayaso'nte varaṃ dadau ..
parituṣṭo'smi te maṃke brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te .. 7.1.203.10 ..
16.203.d:
तस्य तुष्टो महादेवो वयसोऽन्ते वरं ददौ ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते मंके ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते .. 7.1.203.10 ..
16.203.m: At the end of his life, Mahādeva, pleased with him, granted a boon: / 'I am well pleased with you, O Maṅki; speak, what shall I do for you?'

16.203.s:
.. maṃkiruvāca .. ..
kiṃ vareṇa suraśreṣṭha mama vṛddhasya sāṃpratam ..
kiñcinme paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ sthitasyātra paraṃ prabho .. 11 ..
16.203.d:
.. मंकिरुवाच .. ..
किं वरेण सुरश्रेष्ठ मम वृद्धस्य सांप्रतम् ..
किञ्चिन्मे परमं दुःखं स्थितस्यात्र परं प्रभो .. 11 ..
16.203.m: Maṅki said: / 'What use is a boon to me now, O best of gods, when I am old? / Yet, O Lord, I have had a certain supreme sorrow while remaining here.'

16.203.s:
.. śiva uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu yatkāraṇaṃ tatra teṣāṃ tava tapasvinām ..
vratacaryāptaye viprāḥ pūjayantyadhikaṃ hi te ..12..
16.203.d:
.. शिव उवाच .. ..
शृणु यत्कारणं तत्र तेषां तव तपस्विनाम् ..
व्रतचर्याप्तये विप्राः पूजयन्त्यधिकं हि ते ..12..
16.203.m: Śiva said: / 'Hear the reason for that, O ascetic, concerning them and you: / to attain the practice of vows, those brahmins worship excessively.

16.203.s:
te puṣpāṇi samānīya nānāvarṇāni sarvaśaḥ ..
vṛkṣāṇāmatigaṃdhīni na teṣāṃ harṣakāraṇam .. 13 ..
16.203.d:
ते पुष्पाणि समानीय नानावर्णानि सर्वशः ..
वृक्षाणामतिगंधीनि न तेषां हर्षकारणम् .. 13 ..
16.203.m: They bring flowers of various colors from all around, / of great fragrance from trees; [flowers] are not a cause of joy for them [merely for pleasure].

16.203.s:
tvaṃ punaḥ kubjarūpaśca yajñapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ..
na ca prāpnoṣi vṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāgrāṇyatiyatnavān .. 14 ..
16.203.d:
त्वं पुनः कुब्जरूपश्च यज्ञपूजापरायणः ..
न च प्राप्नोषि वृक्षाणां शाखाग्राण्यतियत्नवान् .. 14 ..
16.203.m: You, however, are hunchbacked, though devoted to sacrificial worship, / and despite great effort you cannot reach the tips of the branches of the trees.

16.203.s:
ekenāpi pradattena puṣpeṇa dvijasattama ..
bhaktyā śirasi liṃgasya labhyate yājñikaṃ phalam.. 15 ..
16.203.d:
एकेनापि प्रदत्तेन पुष्पेण द्विजसत्तम ..
भक्त्या शिरसि लिंगस्य लभ्यते याज्ञिकं फलम्.. 15 ..
16.203.m: Even with a single flower offered with devotion, O best of the twice-born, / upon the head of the liṅga, the fruit of a sacrificer is obtained.

16.203.s:
liṃgasya dakṣiṇe brahmā svayameva vyavasthitaḥ ..
vāme ca bhagavānviṣṇurmadhyehaṃ vai pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 16 ..
16.203.d:
लिंगस्य दक्षिणे ब्रह्मा स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः ..
वामे च भगवान्विष्णुर्मध्येहं वै प्रतिष्ठितः .. 16 ..
16.203.m: Brahmā himself resides on the right of the liṅga, / the blessed Viṣṇu on the left, and I myself am established in the middle.

16.203.s: trayo'pi pūjitāstena yena liṃgaṃ prapūjitam .. 17 ..
16.203.d: त्रयोऽपि पूजितास्तेन येन लिंगं प्रपूजितम् .. 17 ..
16.203.m: All three have been worshipped by him by whom the liṅga has been worshipped.

16.203.s:
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ karavīraṃ ca mālatīm ..
unmattakaṃ campakaṃ ca sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ bhavet .. 18 ..
16.203.d:
बिल्वपत्रं शमीपत्रं करवीरं च मालतीम् ..
उन्मत्तकं चम्पकं च सद्यः प्रीतिकरं भवेत् .. 18 ..
16.203.m: A bilva leaf, a śamī leaf, karavīra, and mālatī, / unmattaka, and campaka bring immediate pleasure.

16.203.s:
caṃpakāśoka kahlāraiḥ karavīraistathā mama ..
pūjeṣṭā dvijaśārdūla ye cānye vahugaṃdhinaḥ ..
etairhi pūjito nityaṃ śīghraṃ tuṣṭiṃ prayāmyaham .. 19 .. ..
16.203.d:
चंपकाशोक कह्लारैः करवीरैस्तथा मम ..
पूजेष्टा द्विजशार्दूल ये चान्ये वहुगंधिनः ..
एतैर्हि पूजितो नित्यं शीघ्रं तुष्टिं प्रयाम्यहम् .. 19 .. ..
16.203.m: Worship with campaka, aśoka, kahlāra, and likewise karavīra, / and whatever other fragrant [flowers] there are, is dear to me, O tiger among the twice-born; / worshipped constantly with these, I quickly attain pleasure.'

16.203.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama ..
ihāgatya naraḥ snātvā yo jalenāpi siñcati .. 7.1.203.20 ..
16.203.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम ..
इहागत्य नरः स्नात्वा यो जलेनापि सिञ्चति .. 7.1.203.20 ..
16.203.m: The brāhmaṇa said: / 'If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be given to me: / a man who comes here, bathes, and sprinkles with water alone

16.203.s:
liṃgametaddhi sarvāsāṃ pūjānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt ..
adyaprabhṛti ye vṛkṣā daivikāḥ pārthivāśca ye ..
teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatrāstu prasādāttava śaṃkara .. 21 ..
16.203.d:
लिंगमेतद्धि सर्वासां पूजानां फलमाप्नुयात् ..
अद्यप्रभृति ये वृक्षा दैविकाः पार्थिवाश्च ये ..
तेषां सान्निध्यमत्रास्तु प्रसादात्तव शंकर .. 21 ..
16.203.m: this liṅga, may he obtain the fruit of all worships! / From this day forward, whatever trees there are, celestial and earthly, / let their presence be here, by your grace, O Śaṃkara!'

16.203.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
salilenāpi yaḥ pūjāmasmim̐lliṃge vidhāsyati ..
tasya pūjāphalaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati dvijottama .. .. 22 ..
16.203.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
सलिलेनापि यः पूजामस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे विधास्यति ..
तस्य पूजाफलं सर्वं भविष्यति द्विजोत्तम .. .. 22 ..
16.203.m: The Lord said: / 'Whoever will perform worship with water alone on this liṅga, / to him shall accrue all the fruit of worship, O best of the twice-born.

16.203.s:
vṛkṣāṇāmatrasānnidhyaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati ..
adyaprabhṛti nāmnaitannāgasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
16.203.d:
वृक्षाणामत्रसान्निध्यं सर्वेषां च भविष्यति ..
अद्यप्रभृति नाम्नैतन्नागस्थानं भविष्यति .. 23 ..
16.203.m: And the presence of all trees shall be here. / From this day forward, this will be known by name as Nāgasthāna,

16.203.s:
yatastu sarvanāgānāṃ sāṃnidhya matra saṃsthitam .
tvamapi dvijaśārdūla prayāsyasi mamāntikam .. 24 ..
16.203.d:
यतस्तु सर्वनागानां सांनिध्य मत्र संस्थितम् .
त्वमपि द्विजशार्दूल प्रयास्यसि ममान्तिकम् .. 24 ..
16.203.m: because the presence of all serpents is established here. / You too, O tiger among the twice-born, shall go to my presence.'

16.203.s:
evamuktvā tu bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ..
maṃkistu dehamutsajya śivalokaṃ tato gataḥ .. 25 ..
16.203.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..
मंकिस्तु देहमुत्सज्य शिवलोकं ततो गतः .. 25 ..
16.203.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord vanished right there. / And Maṅki, having cast off his body, then went to Śiva's world.

16.203.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi maṃkīśodbhavamuttamam ..
śrutaṃ harati pāpāni samyakchraddhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 26 ..
16.203.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि मंकीशोद्भवमुत्तमम् ..
श्रुतं हरति पापानि सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितैः .. 26 ..
16.203.m: Thus, O goddess, the excellent origin of Maṅkīśa has been told. / Heard by those endowed with full faith, it removes sins.

16.203.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 203 ..
16.203.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मंकीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 203 ..
16.203.m: Thus ends the two hundred and third chapter, named 'Description of the Maṅkīśvara-māhātmya', in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.204.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ vistarātkathayasva me .. 1 ..
16.204.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश संसारार्णवतारक ..
सरस्वत्याश्च माहात्म्यं विस्तरात्कथयस्व मे .. 1 ..
16.204.m: The goddess said: / O Lord, Lord of the gods of gods, Savior from the ocean of worldly existence, / tell me in detail the māhātmya of the Sarasvatī.

16.204.s:
yātrāgatānāṃ deveśi puruṣāṇāṃ jitātmanām..
mukhadvāre tu kiṃ puṇyaṃ snānadāne ca śaṃkara .. 2 ..
16.204.d:
यात्रागतानां देवेशि पुरुषाणां जितात्मनाम्..
मुखद्वारे तु किं पुण्यं स्नानदाने च शंकर .. 2 ..
16.204.m: What is the merit for men of restrained self who have come on pilgrimage, O Śaṃkara, / in bathing and making gifts at the mouth?

16.204.s:
avagāhanena cānyatra phalaṃ kiṃsvitprajāyate ..
śrāddhasya kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu ke maṃtrāstatra ke dvijāḥ .. 3 ..
16.204.d:
अवगाहनेन चान्यत्र फलं किंस्वित्प्रजायते ..
श्राद्धस्य किं विधानं तु के मंत्रास्तत्र के द्विजाः .. 3 ..
16.204.m: And what fruit is produced by bathing elsewhere? / What is the rule for the ancestral offering, what are the mantras there, and what brahmins [should be invited]?

16.204.s:
kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiñca bhoktavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ..
kāni dānāni deyāni nṛbhiryātrā phalepsubhiḥ .. 4 ..
16.204.d:
किं ग्राह्यं किञ्च भोक्तव्यं ब्राह्मणैः श्राद्धकर्मणि ..
कानि दानानि देयानि नृभिर्यात्रा फलेप्सुभिः .. 4 ..
16.204.m: What is to be received and what is to be eaten by the brahmins in the rite of ancestral offerings? / What gifts are to be given by men desiring the fruit of the pilgrimage?

16.204.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devipravakṣyāmi dānaśrāddhavidhikramam ..
sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ nibodha me .. 5 ..
16.204.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देविप्रवक्ष्यामि दानश्राद्धविधिक्रमम् ..
सरस्वत्याश्च माहात्म्यं कीर्त्यमानं निबोध मे .. 5 ..
16.204.m:
Īśvara said:
Listen, O goddess, I shall explain the proper order of the rites of giving and śrāddha; / and learn from me the māhātmya of the Sarasvatī being proclaimed.

16.204.s:
puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ yatra tatrāvagāhyate ..
sāgareṇa tu saṃmiśraṃ devānāmapi durlabham .. 6 ..
16.204.d:
पुण्यं सारस्वतं तोयं यत्र तत्रावगाह्यते ..
