सागरेण तु संमिश्रं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् .. 6 ..
16.204.m: Meritorious is the water of the Sarasvatī wherever one immerses oneself; / but when mingled with the ocean, it is difficult to attain even for the gods.

16.204.s:
sarasvatī sarvanadīṣu puṇyā sarasvatī lokasukhāvagāhā ..
sarasvatīṃ prāpya na duḥkhitā narāḥ sadā na śocaṃti paratra ceha vā .. 7 ..
16.204.d:
सरस्वती सर्वनदीषु पुण्या सरस्वती लोकसुखावगाहा ..
सरस्वतीं प्राप्य न दुःखिता नराः सदा न शोचंति परत्र चेह वा .. 7 ..
16.204.m: The Sarasvatī is the most meritorious among all rivers; the Sarasvatī offers pleasant immersion for people. / Having reached the Sarasvatī, men are not afflicted; they never grieve, either in this world or the next.

16.204.s:
puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyakṛllabhate naraḥ ..
durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vaiśākhyā somaparvaṇi. .. 8 ..
16.204.d:
पुण्यं सारस्वतं तीर्थं पुण्यकृल्लभते नरः ..
दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु वैशाख्या सोमपर्वणि. .. 8 ..
16.204.m: A man who performs meritorious deeds obtains the sacred ford of the Sarasvatī; / on the full-moon day of Vaiśākha or on an occasion involving the Moon, it is rare to attain in the three worlds.

16.204.s:
amā somena saṃyuktā yadi tatraiva labhyate ..
tatra kiṃ kriyate devi parvakoṭiśatairapi .. 9 ..
16.204.d:
अमा सोमेन संयुक्ता यदि तत्रैव लभ्यते ..
तत्र किं क्रियते देवि पर्वकोटिशतैरपि .. 9 ..
16.204.m: If a new moon joined with Monday is attained right there, / what need is there, O goddess, of hundreds of millions of other sacred occasions?

16.204.s:
cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi mahāsāṃ tapanāni ca ..
prāyaścittāni dīyante yatra nāsti sarasvatī ..7.1.204.10..
16.204.d:
चान्द्रायणानि कृच्छ्राणि महासां तपनानि च ..
प्रायश्चित्तानि दीयन्ते यत्र नास्ति सरस्वती ..7.1.204.10..
16.204.m: The Cāndrāyaṇa penances, the Kṛcchra penances, and the Mahāsāṃtapana penances / are assigned as expiations where the Sarasvatī is absent.

16.204.s:
yāvadasthi śarīrasya tiṣṭhetsārasvate jale ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke vase nnaraḥ ..
jātyandhaiste samā jñeyā mṛtaiḥ paṃgubhireva ca .. 11 ..
16.204.d:
यावदस्थि शरीरस्य तिष्ठेत्सारस्वते जले ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि विष्णुलोके वसे न्नरः ..
जात्यन्धैस्ते समा ज्ञेया मृतैः पंगुभिरेव च .. 11 ..
16.204.m: As long as a bone of one's body rests in the water of the Sarasvatī, / for that many thousands of years a man resides in Viṣṇu's world. / Those who are able, yet do not look upon

16.204.s:
samarthā ye na paśyanti prabhāsasthāṃ sarasvatīm ..
te deśāstāni tīrthāni āśramāste ca parvatāḥ .. 12 ..
16.204.d:
समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति प्रभासस्थां सरस्वतीम् ..
ते देशास्तानि तीर्थानि आश्रमास्ते च पर्वताः .. 12 ..
16.204.m: the Sarasvatī situated at Prabhāsa, are to be regarded as equal to the blind from birth, to the dead, and to the crippled. / Those regions, those sacred fords, those hermitages, and those mountains,

16.204.s:
yeṣāṃ sarasvatī devī madhye yāti saridvarā ..
trailokyapāvanīṃ puṇyāṃ saṃśritā ye sarasvatīm ..
saṃsārakardamāmodamājighranti na te punaḥ .. 13 ..
16.204.d:
येषां सरस्वती देवी मध्ये याति सरिद्वरा ..
त्रैलोक्यपावनीं पुण्यां संश्रिता ये सरस्वतीम् ..
संसारकर्दमामोदमाजिघ्रन्ति न ते पुनः .. 13 ..
16.204.m: through the midst of which the goddess Sarasvatī, the best of rivers, flows, [are blessed]. / Those who take refuge in the holy Sarasvatī, the purifier of the three worlds, / never inhale the stench of the mire of worldly existence again.

16.204.s:
śabdavidyeva vistīrṇā mataiva jagataḥ priyā ..
satāṃ matiriva svacchā ramaṇīyā sarasvatī .. 14 ..
16.204.d:
शब्दविद्येव विस्तीर्णा मतैव जगतः प्रिया ..
सतां मतिरिव स्वच्छा रमणीया सरस्वती .. 14 ..
16.204.m: Vast as the science of grammar, dear to the world like a mother, / and pure as the intellect of the virtuous, delightful is the Sarasvatī.

16.204.s:
trailokyaśobhitāṃ devīṃ divya toyāṃ sunirmalām..
sa nīco yaḥ pumānetāṃ na vandeta sarasvatīm .. 15 ..
16.204.d:
त्रैलोक्यशोभितां देवीं दिव्य तोयां सुनिर्मलाम्..
स नीचो यः पुमानेतां न वन्देत सरस्वतीम् .. 15 ..
16.204.m: The goddess who adorns the three worlds, whose waters are divine and exceedingly pure— / vile is the man who does not bow down to this Sarasvatī.

16.204.s:
svarganiśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī ..
nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī .. 16 ..
16.204.d:
स्वर्गनिश्रेणिसंभूता प्रभासे तु सरस्वती ..
नापुण्यवद्भिः संप्राप्तुं पुंभिः शक्या महानदी .. 16 ..
16.204.m: The Sarasvatī at Prabhāsa has become a ladder to heaven; / this great river cannot be attained by men devoid of merit.

16.204.s:
candrabhāgā ca gaṃgā ca tathā yatra sarasvatī ..
devāste na manuṣyāste tisro nadyaḥ pibanti ye ..17..
16.204.d:
चन्द्रभागा च गंगा च तथा यत्र सरस्वती ..
देवास्ते न मनुष्यास्ते तिस्रो नद्यः पिबन्ति ये ..17..
16.204.m: Where the Candrabhāgā, the Gaṅgā, and the Sarasvatī are present, / those who drink from those three rivers are gods, not human beings.

16.204.s:
satyameva mayā devi jāhnavī śirasā dhṛtā ..
yāḥ kāścitsarito loke tāsāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī .. 18..
16.204.d:
सत्यमेव मया देवि जाह्नवी शिरसा धृता ..
याः काश्चित्सरितो लोके तासां पुण्या सरस्वती .. 18..
16.204.m: Truly, O goddess, the Gaṅgā was borne on my head; / yet among whatever rivers exist in the world, the Sarasvatī is the most meritorious.

16.204.s:
darśanena sarasvatyā rājasūyo na rājate ..
gaṃḍūṣaścāśvamedhādvai sarva kratuvaraṃ payaḥ ..19..
bhasmāsthicarmatoyāni nakhakeśādikāni ca ..
vātairapi dhutānyeva tathā sārasvate jale ..7.1.204.2...
16.204.d:
दर्शनेन सरस्वत्या राजसूयो न राजते ..
गंडूषश्चाश्वमेधाद्वै सर्व क्रतुवरं पयः ..19..
भस्मास्थिचर्मतोयानि नखकेशादिकानि च ..
वातैरपि धुतान्येव तथा सारस्वते जले ..7.1.204.2...
16.204.m:
In comparison with the darśana of the Sarasvatī, the Rājasūya sacrifice does not shine; / indeed, a mouthful of its water surpasses the Aśvamedha; its water is superior to all sacrifices.
Whose ash, bones, skin, fluids, / and nails, hair, and the like, / shaken even by the winds, are carried in due course

16.204.s:
vahanti yeṣāṃ kālena te na kāla vaśā narāḥ ..
devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥpunaḥ..
sarasvatyāḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ..21..
16.204.d:
वहन्ति येषां कालेन ते न काल वशा नराः ..
देवि किं बहुनोक्तेन वर्णितेन पुनःपुनः..
सरस्वत्याः परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति ..21..
16.204.m: into the water of the Sarasvatī, those men do not fall under the power of Death. / O goddess, what is the use of speaking much, of describing it again and again? / There has never been, nor will there ever be, a sacred ford superior to the Sarasvatī.

16.204.s:
tatraiva durlabhaṃ snānaṃ yatra sāgarasaṃgamaḥ ..
tatra snānena dānena koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet ..22..
16.204.d:
तत्रैव दुर्लभं स्नानं यत्र सागरसंगमः ..
तत्र स्नानेन दानेन कोटियज्ञफलं लभेत् ..22..
16.204.m: Rarest of all is the bath taken right where it joins the ocean; / by bathing and giving there, one obtains the fruit of ten million sacrifices.

16.204.s:
yatra sārasvataṃ toyaṃ sāgarormisamākulam ..
tatra snāsyaṃti ye martyā bhāgyavanto yugeyuge ..23..
16.204.d:
यत्र सारस्वतं तोयं सागरोर्मिसमाकुलम् ..
तत्र स्नास्यंति ये मर्त्या भाग्यवन्तो युगेयुगे ..23..
16.204.m: Where the water of the Sarasvatī is churned by the waves of the ocean, / those mortals who bathe there in age after age are fortunate.

16.204.s:
te dhanyāste namaskāryāsteṣāṃ sphītataraṃ yaśaḥ ..
yeṣāṃ kalevaraṃ nṝṇāṃ siktaṃ sārasvatairjalaiḥ .. 24 ..
16.204.d:
ते धन्यास्ते नमस्कार्यास्तेषां स्फीततरं यशः ..
येषां कलेवरं नॄणां सिक्तं सारस्वतैर्जलैः .. 24 ..
16.204.m: They are blessed, they are worthy of veneration, their renown is most abundant, / the bodies of which men are sprinkled with the waters of the Sarasvatī.

16.204.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatīsaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 204 .. cha ..
16.204.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सरस्वतीसंगममाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुरुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 204 .. छ ..
16.204.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Confluence of the Sarasvatī', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of the Prabhāsakṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.205.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
bhagandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
brūhi śrāddhavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ vistarājjagatāṃpate .. 1 ..
16.205.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भगन्देवदेवेश संसारार्णवतारक ..
ब्रूहि श्राद्धविधिं पुण्यं विस्तराज्जगतांपते .. 1 ..
16.205.m:
The goddess said:
O Lord, Lord of the gods of gods, O redeemer across the ocean of worldly existence, / O Lord of the worlds, explain in detail the holy procedure of śrāddha.

16.205.s:
kasminvāsarabhāge tu śrāddhakṛcchrāddhamācaret ..
asminsarasvatī tīrthe prabhāsakṣetra uttame .. 2 ..
16.205.d:
कस्मिन्वासरभागे तु श्राद्धकृच्छ्राद्धमाचरेत् ..
अस्मिन्सरस्वती तीर्थे प्रभासक्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 2 ..
16.205.m: At which portion of the day should the performer of śrāddha perform the śrāddha / at this sacred ford of the Sarasvatī, in the supreme sacred field of Prabhāsa?

16.205.s:
kasmiṃstīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ bahupuṇyaphalaṃ bhavet ..
etatsarvaṃ mahādeva yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 3 ..
16.205.d:
कस्मिंस्तीर्थे कृतं श्राद्धं बहुपुण्यफलं भवेत् ..
एतत्सर्वं महादेव यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 3 ..
16.205.m: At which sacred ford does the śrāddha performed yield great meritorious fruit? / You ought to explain all this properly, O Mahādeva.

16.205.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
prātaḥkāle muhūtāṃstrīnsaṃgavastāvadeva tu ..
madhyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syādaparāhṇastataḥ param .. 4 ..
16.205.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
प्रातःकाले मुहूतांस्त्रीन्संगवस्तावदेव तु ..
मध्याह्नस्त्रिमुहूर्तः स्यादपराह्णस्ततः परम् .. 4 ..
16.205.m:
Īśvara said:
The morning time lasts three muhūrtas; the forenoon is just as long; / midday lasts three muhūrtas, and the afternoon comes after that.

16.205.s:
sāyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syācchrāddhaṃ tatra na kārayet ..
rākṣasīnāma sā velā garhitā sarvakarmasu .. 5 ..
16.205.d:
सायाह्नस्त्रिमुहूर्तः स्याच्छ्राद्धं तत्र न कारयेत् ..
राक्षसीनाम सा वेला गर्हिता सर्वकर्मसु .. 5 ..
16.205.m: Evening time lasts three muhūrtas; one should not perform a śrāddha then; / that time belongs to demonesses and is condemned in all rites.

16.205.s:
ahno muhūrtā vikhyātā daśapaṃca ca sarvadā ..
tatrāṣṭamo muhūrto yaḥ sa kālaḥ kutapaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
16.205.d:
अह्नो मुहूर्ता विख्याता दशपंच च सर्वदा ..
तत्राष्टमो मुहूर्तो यः स कालः कुतपः स्मृतः .. 6 ..
16.205.m: The muhūrtas of the day are always known to be fifteen; / among them, the eighth muhūrta is considered the time called kutapa.

16.205.s:
madhyāhne sarvadā yasmānmandībhavati bhāskaraḥ ..
tasmādanaṃtaphaladastadārambho bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
16.205.d:
मध्याह्ने सर्वदा यस्मान्मन्दीभवति भास्करः ..
तस्मादनंतफलदस्तदारम्भो भविष्यति .. 7 ..
16.205.m: Since the sun's motion always slows down at midday, / therefore an undertaking begun then yields endless fruit.

16.205.s:
madhyāhnaḥ khaḍgapātraṃ tu tathānye kālakambalāḥ ...
rūpyaṃ darbhāṃstilā gāvo dauhitraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 8 ..
16.205.d:
मध्याह्नः खड्गपात्रं तु तथान्ये कालकम्बलाः ...
रूप्यं दर्भांस्तिला गावो दौहित्रश्चाष्टमः स्मृतः .. 8 ..
16.205.m: Midday, a rhinoceros-horn vessel, and similarly black blankets, / silver, darbha grass, sesame seeds, cows, and a daughter's son is recorded as the eighth.

16.205.s:
pāpaṃ kutsitamityāhustasya santāpakāriṇaḥ ..
aṣṭa caivaṃ matāstasmātkutapā iti viśrutāḥ. .. 9 ..
16.205.d:
पापं कुत्सितमित्याहुस्तस्य सन्तापकारिणः ..
अष्ट चैवं मतास्तस्मात्कुतपा इति विश्रुताः. .. 9 ..
16.205.m: They declare sin to be 'kutsi' (vile); because they torment (tap) it, / these eight are considered thus and are known as 'kutapas'.

16.205.s:
ūrdhvaṃ muhūrtātkutapādyanmuhūrtacatuṣṭayam ..
muhūrtapañcakaṃ caiva svadhābhavanamiṣyate .. 7.1.205.10 ..
16.205.d:
ऊर्ध्वं मुहूर्तात्कुतपाद्यन्मुहूर्तचतुष्टयम् ..
मुहूर्तपञ्चकं चैव स्वधाभवनमिष्यते .. 7.1.205.10 ..
16.205.m: The period of four muhūrtas following the kutapa muhūrta, / and indeed that span of five muhūrtas, is held to be the time for the svadhā offering.

16.205.s:
viṣṇordehasamudbhūtāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇāstilāstathā ...
śrāddhasya rakṣaṇārthāya etatprāhurdivaukasaḥ .. 11 ..
16.205.d:
विष्णोर्देहसमुद्भूताः कुशाः कृष्णास्तिलास्तथा ...
श्राद्धस्य रक्षणार्थाय एतत्प्राहुर्दिवौकसः .. 11 ..
16.205.m: Kuśa grass and black sesame seeds arose from the body of Viṣṇu / for the protection of the śrāddha; so say the gods.

16.205.s:
tilodakāñjalirdeyo jalasthaistīrthavāsibhiḥ ..
sadarbhahastenaikena śrāddhasevanamiṣyate .. 12 ..
16.205.d:
तिलोदकाञ्जलिर्देयो जलस्थैस्तीर्थवासिभिः ..
सदर्भहस्तेनैकेन श्राद्धसेवनमिष्यते .. 12 ..
16.205.m: An añjali of sesame water is to be offered by dwellers at the sacred ford standing in the water; / performance of the śrāddha is prescribed with one hand holding darbha grass.

16.205.s:
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapastilāḥ ..
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śuddhimakrodhamatvarām .. 13 ..
16.205.d:
त्रीणि श्राद्धे पवित्राणि दौहित्रः कुतपस्तिलाः ..
त्रीणि चात्र प्रशंसंति शुद्धिमक्रोधमत्वराम् .. 13 ..
16.205.m: Three things are purifying in a śrāddha: a daughter's son, the kutapa period, and sesame seeds; / and here they praise three things: purity, absence of anger, and lack of haste.

16.205.s:
dauhitraṃ khaḍgamityuktaṃ lalāṭe śṛṅgamasti yat ..
tasya śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ taddauhitramiti smṛtam .. 14 ..
16.205.d:
दौहित्रं खड्गमित्युक्तं ललाटे शृङ्गमस्ति यत् ..
तस्य शृंगस्य यत्पात्रं तद्दौहित्रमिति स्मृतम् .. 14 ..
16.205.m: The rhinoceros horn is called 'dauhitra'—that horn which is on its forehead; / whatever vessel is made of that horn is known as 'dauhitra'.

16.205.s:
kṣīriṇī vāpi citrā gaustatkṣīrāyadghṛtaṃ bhavet ..
taddauhitramiti proktaṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi .. 15 ..
16.205.d:
क्षीरिणी वापि चित्रा गौस्तत्क्षीरायद्घृतं भवेत् ..
तद्दौहित्रमिति प्रोक्तं दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि .. 15 ..
16.205.m: Or a milch cow with variegated colors: whatever ghee is made from her milk, / that is declared to be 'dauhitra' in rites for gods and ancestors.

16.205.s:
darbhāgraṃ daivamityuktaṃ samūlāgraṃ tu paitṛkam ..
tatrāvalaṃbino ye tu kuśāste kutapāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 16 ..
16.205.d:
दर्भाग्रं दैवमित्युक्तं समूलाग्रं तु पैतृकम् ..
तत्रावलंबिनो ये तु कुशास्ते कुतपाः स्मृताः .. 16 ..
16.205.m: The tip of darbha grass is designated for the gods, but that with root and tip is for the ancestors; / those kuśa blades that hang downwards there are known as kutapas.

16.205.s:
śarīradravyadārābhūmanomaṃtradvi janmanām ..
śuddhiḥ saptasu vijñeyā śrāddhakāle viśeṣataḥ..17..
16.205.d:
शरीरद्रव्यदाराभूमनोमंत्रद्वि जन्मनाम् ..
शुद्धिः सप्तसु विज्ञेया श्राद्धकाले विशेषतः..17..
16.205.m: Body, material wealth, wife, ground, mind, mantra, and twice-born brahmins— / purity in these seven should be recognized, especially at the time of a śrāddha.

16.205.s: saptadhā dravyaśuddhistu sottamā madhyamā'dhamā ..18..
16.205.d: सप्तधा द्रव्यशुद्धिस्तु सोत्तमा मध्यमाऽधमा ..18..
16.205.m: The purity of materials is sevenfold, classified as superior, middling, and inferior:

16.205.s:
śrutaṃ śauryaṃ tapaḥ kanyā śiṣyādyaṃ cānvayāgatam ..
dhanaṃ saptavidhaṃ śuklamupāyopyasya tādṛśaḥ .. 19 ..
16.205.d:
श्रुतं शौर्यं तपः कन्या शिष्याद्यं चान्वयागतम् ..
धनं सप्तविधं शुक्लमुपायोप्यस्य तादृशः .. 19 ..
16.205.m: Sacred learning, valor, austerity, a maiden, beginning with a disciple, and inherited through lineage— / such wealth is sevenfold white (pure), and the means [to acquire it] are likewise so.

16.205.s:
kutsitaṃ kṛṣivāṇijyaṃ śuklaṃ śilpānuvṛttibhiḥ ..
kṛtopakārādāptaṃ ca śaṃbalaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 7.1.205.20 ..
16.205.d:
कुत्सितं कृषिवाणिज्यं शुक्लं शिल्पानुवृत्तिभिः ..
कृतोपकारादाप्तं च शंबलं समुदाहृतम् .. 7.1.205.20 ..
16.205.m: Agriculture and trade are vile; wealth obtained through craft professions is pure; / and what is obtained from a service rendered is called provisions for the path.

16.205.s:
utkocataśca yatprāptaṃ yatprāptaṃ caiva sāhasāt ..
vyājenopārjitaṃ yacca tatkṛṣṇaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 21 ..
16.205.d:
उत्कोचतश्च यत्प्राप्तं यत्प्राप्तं चैव साहसात् ..
व्याजेनोपार्जितं यच्च तत्कृष्णं समुदाहृतम् .. 21 ..
16.205.m: And whatever is obtained through bribery, and whatever is obtained through violence, / and whatever is acquired by deceit—that is declared to be black wealth. // 21

16.205.s:
anyāyopārjitairdravyai ryacchrāddhaṃ kriyate naraiḥ ..
tṛpyaṃti tena caṇḍālāḥ puṣkasādyāsu yoniṣu .. 22 ..
16.205.d:
अन्यायोपार्जितैर्द्रव्यै र्यच्छ्राद्धं क्रियते नरैः ..
तृप्यंति तेन चण्डालाः पुष्कसाद्यासु योनिषु .. 22 ..
16.205.m: When men perform a śrāddha with wealth acquired unlawfully, / through that, caṇḍālas born into Puṣkasa and other [low] wombs are satiated. // 22

16.205.s:
annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi ..
tena tṛptimupāyāṃti ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ .. 23 ..
16.205.d:
अन्नप्रकिरणं यत्तु मनुष्यैः क्रियते भुवि ..
तेन तृप्तिमुपायांति ये पिशाचत्वमागताः .. 23 ..
16.205.m: And the scattering of food that is done on the ground by men— / through that, those who have attained the state of piśācas find satisfaction. // 23

16.205.s:
yatpayaḥ snānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati putraka ..
tena ye tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃtṛptiḥ prajāyate .. 24 ..
16.205.d:
यत्पयः स्नानवस्त्रोत्थं भूमौ पतति पुत्रक ..
तेन ये तरुतां प्राप्तास्तेषांतृप्तिः प्रजायते .. 24 ..
16.205.m: The water that drops onto the earth from bathing garments, O son— / through that, satisfaction arises for those who have become trees. // 24

16.205.s:
yāstu gaṃdhāṃbukaṇikāḥ pataṃti dharaṇītale ..
tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye devatvamupāgatāḥ .. 25 ..
16.205.d:
यास्तु गंधांबुकणिकाः पतंति धरणीतले ..
ताभिराप्यायनं तेषां ये देवत्वमुपागताः .. 25 ..
16.205.m: The drops of fragrant water that fall onto the surface of the earth— / through them comes the nourishment of those who have attained godhood. // 25

16.205.s:
uddhṛteṣvapi piṇḍeṣu yāścānnakaṇikā bhuvi ..
tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ tiryaktvaṃ ca kule gatāḥ ..26..
16.205.d:
उद्धृतेष्वपि पिण्डेषु याश्चान्नकणिका भुवि ..
ताभिराप्यायनं तेषां तिर्यक्त्वं च कुले गताः ..26..
16.205.m: Even after the piṇḍas are removed, whatever particles of food remain on the ground— / through them comes the nourishment of those in the family who have become animals. // 26

16.205.s:
ye cādagdhāḥ kule bālāḥ striyo yāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ ..
vipannāste tu vikirasaṃmārjanasulālasāḥ ..27..
16.205.d:
ये चादग्धाः कुले बालाः स्त्रियो याश्चाप्यसंस्कृताः ..
विपन्नास्ते तु विकिरसंमार्जनसुलालसाः ..27..
16.205.m: And the children in the family who were uncremated, and the women who died without the rites— / they eagerly crave the scattered [food] and the sweepings. // 27

16.205.s:
bhuktvā vā bhramate yacca jalaṃ yaccāhni sevate ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathānnena tena tṛptiṃ prayāṃti te .. 28 ..
16.205.d:
भुक्त्वा वा भ्रमते यच्च जलं यच्चाह्नि सेवते ..
ब्राह्मणानां तथान्नेन तेन तृप्तिं प्रयांति ते .. 28 ..
16.205.m: And whatever water is stirred around after eating, and whatever water is used by day, / as well as through the food of the brahmins—through that they attain satisfaction, // 28

16.205.s:
piśācatvamanuprāptāḥ kṛmikīṭatvameva ye ..
atha kālānpravakṣyāmi kathyamā nānnibodha me .. 29 ..
16.205.d:
पिशाचत्वमनुप्राप्ताः कृमिकीटत्वमेव ये ..
अथ कालान्प्रवक्ष्यामि कथ्यमा नान्निबोध मे .. 29 ..
16.205.m: those who have attained the state of piśācas, or that of worms and insects. / Now I will proclaim the proper times; listen to me as they are declared: // 29

16.205.s:
śrāddhaṃ kāryamamāvāsyāṃ māsimāsīṃdusaṃkṣaye ..
tathāṣṭakāsu viprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe tathā .. 7.1.205.30 ..
16.205.d:
श्राद्धं कार्यममावास्यां मासिमासींदुसंक्षये ..
तथाष्टकासु विप्राप्तौ सूर्येन्दुग्रहणे तथा .. 7.1.205.30 ..
16.205.m: A śrāddha should be performed on the new moon day, month by month, at the waning of the moon, / likewise on the arrival of the aṣṭakā days, and during an eclipse of the sun or moon; // 30

16.205.s:
ayane viṣuve yugme sāmānye cārkasaṃkrame ..
amāvāsyāṣṭakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
16.205.d:
अयने विषुवे युग्मे सामान्ये चार्कसंक्रमे ..
अमावास्याष्टकायां च कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः .. 31 ..
16.205.m: at the solstices, the pair of equinoxes, and ordinary solar transits, / on the new moon, on the aṣṭakā day, and especially during the dark fortnight; // 31

16.205.s:
ārdrāmaghārohiṇīṣu dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃgame ..
gajacchāyāvyatīpāte viṣṭivaidhṛti vāsare .. 32 ..
16.205.d:
आर्द्रामघारोहिणीषु द्रव्यब्राह्मणसंगमे ..
गजच्छायाव्यतीपाते विष्टिवैधृति वासरे .. 32 ..
16.205.m: under the asterisms Ārdrā, Maghā, and Rohiṇī; when wealth and brahmins are assembled; / during a gajacchāyā conjunction, at vyatīpāta, on a viṣṭi [karaṇa], and on a vaidhṛti day; // 32

16.205.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ kārttikasya ca ..
paṃcadaśyāṃ tu māghasya nabhasye ca trayodaśī .. 33 ..
16.205.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां नवम्यां कार्त्तिकस्य च ..
पंचदश्यां तु माघस्य नभस्ये च त्रयोदशी .. 33 ..
16.205.m: on the third day of Vaiśākha, and on the ninth of Kārttika, / on the fifteenth of Māgha, and the thirteenth of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada). // 33

16.205.s: yugādayaḥ smṛtā etā datta syākṣayakārikāḥ .. 34 ..
16.205.d: युगादयः स्मृता एता दत्त स्याक्षयकारिकाः .. 34 ..
16.205.m: These are remembered as the yugādis (beginnings of yugas), rendering what is offered imperishable. // 34

16.205.s:
yasya manvantarasyādau rathārūḍho divākaraḥ ..
māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ sā tu syādrathasaptamī .. 35 ..
16.205.d:
यस्य मन्वन्तरस्यादौ रथारूढो दिवाकरः ..
माघमासस्य सप्तम्यां सा तु स्याद्रथसप्तमी .. 35 ..
16.205.m: At the beginning of that Manvantara when the Sun mounted his chariot / on the seventh day of the month of Māgha—that day is Rathasaptamī. // 35

16.205.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ phālgunasya ca ..
paṃcamī caitramāsasya tasyaivāntyā tathāparā .. 36 ..
16.205.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां कृष्णायां फाल्गुनस्य च ..
पंचमी चैत्रमासस्य तस्यैवान्त्या तथापरा .. 36 ..
16.205.m: On the third day of Vaiśākha, and in the dark fortnight of Phālguna, / on the fifth of the month of Caitra, and likewise another on its last day, // 36

16.205.s:
śuklatrayodaśī māghe kārttikasya ca saptamī ..
kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśīti ca ..
manvantarāḥ smṛtā hyetā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ .. 37 ..
16.205.d:
शुक्लत्रयोदशी माघे कार्त्तिकस्य च सप्तमी ..
कार्त्तिकी फाल्गुनी चैत्री ज्यैष्ठी पञ्चदशीति च ..
मन्वन्तराः स्मृता ह्येता दत्तस्याक्षयकारिकाः .. 37 ..
16.205.m: the bright thirteenth in Māgha, and the seventh of Kārttika; / the full-moon days of Kārttika, Phālguna, Caitra, and Jyaiṣṭha— / these are remembered as the Manvantara days, rendering what is offered imperishable. // 37

16.205.s:
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā ..
kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tithiḥ .. 38 ..
16.205.d:
श्रावणस्याष्टमी कृष्णा तथाषाढी च पूर्णिमा ..
कार्त्तिकी फाल्गुनी चैत्री ज्यैष्ठी पञ्चदशी तिथिः .. 38 ..
16.205.m: The dark eighth of Śrāvaṇa, and likewise the full-moon day of Āṣāḍha; / the fifteenth lunar day of Kārttika, Phālguna, Caitra, and Jyaiṣṭha— // 38

16.205.s:
manvādayaḥ smṛtāścaitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ..
navamī mārgaśīrṣasya saptaitāḥ saṃsmarā myaham .. 39 ..
16.205.d:
मन्वादयः स्मृताश्चैता दत्तस्याक्षयकारिकाः ..
नवमी मार्गशीर्षस्य सप्तैताः संस्मरा म्यहम् .. 39 ..
16.205.m: these are remembered as the manvādis (beginnings of Manvantaras), rendering what is offered imperishable; / and the ninth of Mārgaśīrṣa: these seven I recall. // 39

16.205.s:
kalpanāmādayo devi dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ..
tathā manvantarasyādau dvādaśaiva varānane .. 7.1.205.40 ..
16.205.d:
कल्पनामादयो देवि दत्तस्याक्षयकारिकाः ..
तथा मन्वन्तरस्यादौ द्वादशैव वरानने .. 7.1.205.40 ..
16.205.m: These beginning times, O goddess, render what is offered imperishable, / and likewise twelve at the start of a Manvantara, O fair-faced lady. // 40

16.205.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhi śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ..
pārvaṇaṃ cātivijñānaṃ goṣṭhaṃ śuddhyarthamuttamam .. 41 ..
16.205.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं वृद्धि श्राद्धं सपिण्डकम् ..
पार्वणं चातिविज्ञानं गोष्ठं शुद्ध्यर्थमुत्तमम् .. 41 ..
16.205.m: The daily (nitya), the occasional (naimittika), the optional (kāmya), the prosperity-śrāddha (vṛddhi), the sapiṇḍana, / the pārvaṇa, that with superior wisdom, the goṣṭha, and the excellent one for purification; // 41

16.205.s:
karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ daivakaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam ..
ekādaśaṃ kṣayāhaṃ tu puṣṭyarthe dvādaśaṃ smṛtam .. 42 ..
16.205.d:
कर्मांगं नवमं प्रोक्तं दैवकं दशमं स्मृतम् ..
एकादशं क्षयाहं तु पुष्ट्यर्थे द्वादशं स्मृतम् .. 42 ..
16.205.m: the subordinate rite (karmāṅga) is declared the ninth, that for the gods (daivika) is recalled as the tenth, / the anniversary of death (kṣayāha) is the eleventh, and the twelfth is for nourishment (puṣṭi). // 42

16.205.s:
sarveṣāmeva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ smṛtam ..
ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ nityaṃ tatparikīrtitam .. 43 ..
16.205.d:
सर्वेषामेव श्राद्धानां श्रेष्ठं सांवत्सरं स्मृतम् ..
अहन्यहनि यच्छ्राद्धं नित्यं तत्परिकीर्तितम् .. 43 ..
16.205.m: Among all śrāddhas, the annual rite is recalled as best. / The śrāddha that is performed day by day is proclaimed as nitya. // 43

16.205.s:
vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu ..
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate .. 44 ..
16.205.d:
वैश्वदेवविहीनं तु अशक्तावुदकेन तु ..
एकोद्दिष्टं तु यच्छ्राद्धं तन्नैमित्तिकमुच्यते .. 44 ..
16.205.m: Deceiving no one, it is done without the Vaiśvadeva rite, or with just water if incapable. / The śrāddha offered to one deceased person (ekoddiṣṭa) is called naimittika. // 44

16.205.s:
kāmena vihitaṃ kāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye ..
vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhi śrāddhaṃ taducyate .. 45 ..
16.205.d:
कामेन विहितं काम्यमभिप्रेतार्थसिद्धये ..
वृद्धौ यत्क्रियते श्राद्धं वृद्धि श्राद्धं तदुच्यते .. 45 ..
16.205.m: That which is performed out of desire for the attainment of a longed-for goal is kāmya. / The śrāddha that is performed at an auspicious event (vṛddhi) is called vṛddhi-śrāddha. // 45

16.205.s:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetacchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍanam ..
amāvāsyāṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam .. 46 ..
16.205.d:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यामेतच्छ्राद्धं सपिण्डनम् ..
अमावास्यां तु यच्छ्राद्धं तत्पार्वणमुदाहृतम् .. 46 ..
16.205.m: With the two verses beginning 'ye samānāḥ', this śrāddha is the sapiṇḍana. / The śrāddha that is performed on the new moon day is proclaimed as pārvaṇa. // 46

16.205.s:
goṣṭhyāṃ yatkri yate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhīśrāddhamucyate ..
kriyate pāpaśuddhyarthaṃ śuddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate .. 47 ..
16.205.d:
गोष्ठ्यां यत्क्रि यते श्राद्धं तद्गोष्ठीश्राद्धमुच्यते ..
क्रियते पापशुद्ध्यर्थं शुद्धिश्राद्धं तदुच्यते .. 47 ..
16.205.m: The śrāddha performed in an assembly (goṣṭhī) is called goṣṭhī-śrāddha. / That which is performed for purification from sin is called śuddhi-śrāddha. // 47

16.205.s:
niṣekakāle some ca sīmantonnayane tathā ..
tathā puṃsavane caiva śrāddhaṃ karmāṃgameva ca .. 48 ..
16.205.d:
निषेककाले सोमे च सीमन्तोन्नयने तथा ..
तथा पुंसवने चैव श्राद्धं कर्मांगमेव च .. 48 ..
16.205.m: At the time of insemination, at the Soma sacrifice, at the parting of the hair, / and at the rite for securing a male child, the śrāddha is an auxiliary part of the ritual (karmāṅga). // 48

16.205.s:
devamuddiśya kriyate yattaddaivakamucyate ..
gaccheddeśāntaraṃ yastu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tu sarpiṣā .. 49 ..
16.205.d:
देवमुद्दिश्य क्रियते यत्तद्दैवकमुच्यते ..
गच्छेद्देशान्तरं यस्तु श्राद्धं कार्यं तु सर्पिषा .. 49 ..
16.205.m: That which is performed directed towards a deity is called daivaka. / When one is about to travel to another country, a śrāddha should be performed with clarified butter; // 49

16.205.s:
puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyaṃ kṣayāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ smṛtam ..
mṛte'hani pituryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt .. 7.1.205.50 ..
16.205.d:
पुष्ट्यर्थमेतद्विज्ञेयं क्षयाहं द्वादशं स्मृतम् ..
मृतेऽहनि पितुर्यस्तु न कुर्याच्छ्राद्धमादरात् .. 7.1.205.50 ..
16.205.m: this should be known as being for nourishment (puṣṭyartha); and the twelfth is remembered as the anniversary of death. / A person who, out of negligence, does not perform a śrāddha on the day his father died, // 50

16.205.s:
mātuścaiva varārohe vatsarānte mṛte'hani ..
nāhaṃ tasya mahādevi pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ .. 51 ..
16.205.d:
मातुश्चैव वरारोहे वत्सरान्ते मृतेऽहनि ..
नाहं तस्य महादेवि पूजां गृह्णामि नो हरिः .. 51 ..
16.205.m: or his mother, O lady of fair limbs, at the end of the year on the day of death— / I do not accept his worship, O great goddess, nor does Hari. // 51

16.205.s:
mṛtāharyo na jānāti mānavo yadi vā kvacit ..
tena kāryamamāvāsyāṃ śrāddhaṃ māghe'tha mārgake .. 52 ..
16.205.d:
मृताहर्यो न जानाति मानवो यदि वा क्वचित् ..
तेन कार्यममावास्यां श्राद्धं माघेऽथ मार्गके .. 52 ..
16.205.m: If a man does not know the day of death at any time, / by him a śrāddha should be performed on the new moon in Māgha or Mārgaśīrṣa. // 52

16.205.s:
atha viprānpravakṣyāmi śrāddhe ye kecana kṣamāḥ ..
viśiṣṭaḥ śrotriyo yogī vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ .. 53 ..
16.205.d:
अथ विप्रान्प्रवक्ष्यामि श्राद्धे ये केचन क्षमाः ..
विशिष्टः श्रोत्रियो योगी वेदविद्यासमन्वितः .. 53 ..
16.205.m: Now I will proclaim the brahmins who are worthy in a śrāddha: / an eminent man, learned in the Veda, a yogin, endowed with Vedic learning, // 53

16.205.s:
triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit ..
dauhitrakastu jāmātā svasrīyaḥ śvaśurastathā .. 54 ..
16.205.d:
त्रिणाचिकेतस्त्रिमधुस्त्रिसुपर्णः षडंगवित् ..
दौहित्रकस्तु जामाता स्वस्रीयः श्वशुरस्तथा .. 54 ..
16.205.m: one who has kept the Triṇāciketa fire, one who knows the Trimadhu hymns, one who recites the Trisuparṇa, one who knows the six Vedāṅgas, / a daughter's son, a son-in-law, a sister's son, and a father-in-law; // 54

16.205.s:
pañcāgnikarmaniṣṭhaśca taponiṣṭhaśca mātulaḥ ..
pitṛmātṛparaścaiva śiṣyasaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavaḥ .. 55 ..
16.205.d:
पञ्चाग्निकर्मनिष्ठश्च तपोनिष्ठश्च मातुलः ..
पितृमातृपरश्चैव शिष्यसंबंधिबांधवः .. 55 ..
16.205.m: one devoted to the rites of the five fires, one devoted to austerity, a maternal uncle, / one devoted to his father and mother, a disciple, a relative, an affine; // 55

16.205.s:
vedārthavitpravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasradaḥ ..
saṃbaṃdhinaṃ tathā saṃtaṃ dauhitraṃ duhituḥ patim .. 56 ..
16.205.d:
वेदार्थवित्प्रवक्ता च ब्रह्मचारी सहस्रदः ..
संबंधिनं तथा संतं दौहित्रं दुहितुः पतिम् .. 56 ..
16.205.m: one who knows the meaning of the Veda and expounds it, a celibate student, one who gives thousands, / an affine, a virtuous person, a daughter's son, a daughter's husband, // 56

16.205.s:
bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā bandhugaṇānapi ..
nātikramennarastvetānmūrkhānapi varānane .. 57 ..
16.205.d:
भागिनेयं विशेषेण तथा बन्धुगणानपि ..
नातिक्रमेन्नरस्त्वेतान्मूर्खानपि वरानने .. 57 ..
16.205.m: especially a sister's son, and likewise the host of kinsmen— / a man should not bypass these, even if they are unlearned, O fair-faced lady. // 57

16.205.s:
na brāhmaṇānparīkṣeta devakarmaṇyupa sthite ..
paitrakarmaṇi saṃprāpte parīkṣeta prayatnataḥ .. 58 ..
16.205.d:
न ब्राह्मणान्परीक्षेत देवकर्मण्युप स्थिते ..
पैत्रकर्मणि संप्राप्ते परीक्षेत प्रयत्नतः .. 58 ..
16.205.m: One should not examine brahmins when a rite for the gods is undertaken; / but when a ancestral rite has arrived, one should examine them with effort. // 58

16.205.s:
ye stenāḥ patitāḥ klībā ye ca nāstikavṛttayaḥ ..
tānhavyakavyayorviprānanarhānmanura bravīt .. 59 ..
16.205.d:
ये स्तेनाः पतिताः क्लीबा ये च नास्तिकवृत्तयः ..
तान्हव्यकव्ययोर्विप्राननर्हान्मनुर ब्रवीत् .. 59 ..
16.205.m: Those who are thieves, outcasts, eunuchs, and those whose conduct is atheistic— / these brahmins Manu declared unfit for offerings to gods and ancestors. // 59

16.205.s:
jaṭilaṃ cānadhīyānaṃ durbalaṃ kitavaṃ tathā ..
yājayaṃti ca ye śūdrāṃstāṃśca śrāddhe na pūjayet .. 7.1.205.60 ..
16.205.d:
जटिलं चानधीयानं दुर्बलं कितवं तथा ..
याजयंति च ये शूद्रांस्तांश्च श्राद्धे न पूजयेत् .. 7.1.205.60 ..
16.205.m: One with matted hair who does not study, one who is sickly, a gambler, / and those who officiate for śūdras—these one should not honor in a śrāddha. // 60

16.205.s:
cikitsakāndevalakānmāṃsa vikrayiṇastathā ..
vipaṇaiḥ pīrajīvaṃto varjyāḥ syurhavyakavyayoḥ .. 61 ..
16.205.d:
चिकित्सकान्देवलकान्मांस विक्रयिणस्तथा ..
विपणैः पीरजीवंतो वर्ज्याः स्युर्हव्यकव्ययोः .. 61 ..
16.205.m: Physicians, temple-priests (devalakas), sellers of meat, / and those who live by market trade—they should be avoided in offerings to gods and ancestors; // 61

16.205.s:
preṣyo grāmyaśca rājñaśca kunakhī śyāvadaṃtakaḥ ..
pratiroddhā guroścaiva tyaktā gnirvārdhuṣistathā .. 62 ..
16.205.d:
प्रेष्यो ग्राम्यश्च राज्ञश्च कुनखी श्यावदंतकः ..
प्रतिरोद्धा गुरोश्चैव त्यक्ता ग्निर्वार्धुषिस्तथा .. 62 ..
16.205.m: a servant of the village or of the king, one with diseased nails, one with black teeth, / one who opposes his guru, one who has abandoned his sacred fire, a usurer, // 62

16.205.s:
yakṣmī ca paśupālaśca parivettā nirākṛtiḥ ..
brahmadhrukparivittiśca gaṇābhyantara eva ca .. 63 ..
16.205.d:
यक्ष्मी च पशुपालश्च परिवेत्ता निराकृतिः ..
ब्रह्मध्रुक्परिवित्तिश्च गणाभ्यन्तर एव च .. 63 ..
16.205.m: a consumptive, a herdsman, one married before his elder brother, one who neglects Vedic duties, / a persecutor of brahmins, an unmarried elder brother whose younger brother has married, a member of a guild, // 63

16.205.s:
kuśīlaścaiva kāṇaśca vṛṣalīpatireva ca ..
paunarbhavaśca kānīnaḥ kitavo madyapastathā .. 64 ..
16.205.d:
कुशीलश्चैव काणश्च वृषलीपतिरेव च ..
पौनर्भवश्च कानीनः कितवो मद्यपस्तथा .. 64 ..
16.205.m: an actor, a one-eyed man, the husband of a śūdra woman, / the son of a remarried woman, the son of an unmarried woman, a gambler, and an imbiber of liquor. // 64

16.205.s:
pāparogyabhiśastaśca dāṃbhiko rasavikrayī ..
dhanuḥśarāṇāṃ karttā ca yaśca syāddidhiṣūpatiḥ .. 65 ..
16.205.d:
पापरोग्यभिशस्तश्च दांभिको रसविक्रयी ..
धनुःशराणां कर्त्ता च यश्च स्याद्दिधिषूपतिः .. 65 ..
16.205.m: one afflicted with a sinful disease, an accused person, a hypocrite, a seller of juices [or liquors], / a maker of bows and arrows, and one who marries a remarried woman [or younger sister married before the elder];

16.205.s:
mitradhruḍdūtavṛttiśca putrācāryastathaiva ca ..
bhramarī maṇḍapālī ca citrāṃgaḥ piśunastathā .. 66 ..
16.205.d:
मित्रध्रुड्दूतवृत्तिश्च पुत्राचार्यस्तथैव च ..
भ्रमरी मण्डपाली च चित्रांगः पिशुनस्तथा .. 66 ..
16.205.m: a betrayer of friends, one who lives by the trade of a messenger, a teacher taught by his son, / one suffering from epilepsy, an attendant at an inn [or pavilion keeper], a leper [with variegated body], and a slanderer;

16.205.s:
unmattoṃ'dhaśca badhiro vedanindaka eva ca ..
hayago'śvoṣṭradamako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvati .. 67 ..
16.205.d:
उन्मत्तोंऽधश्च बधिरो वेदनिन्दक एव च ..
हयगोऽश्वोष्ट्रदमको नक्षत्रैर्यश्च जीवति .. 67 ..
16.205.m: an insane person, a blind man, a deaf man, a despiser of the Vedas, / a trainer of horses, cattle, and camels, and one who lives by astrology;

16.205.s:
pakṣiṇāṃ poṣako yaśca yuddhācāryastathaiva ca ..
srotaḥsaṃbhedako yaśca veśyānāṃ poṣaṇe rataḥ .. 68 ..
16.205.d:
पक्षिणां पोषको यश्च युद्धाचार्यस्तथैव च ..
स्रोतःसंभेदको यश्च वेश्यानां पोषणे रतः .. 68 ..
16.205.m: one who keeps birds, an instructor in warfare, / one who diverts watercourses, and one devoted to maintaining courtesans;

16.205.s:
gṛhasaṃveśako dūtaḥ kṛṣyāropaka eva ca ..
ākheṭī śyenajīvī ca kanyādūṣaka eva ca .. 69 ..
16.205.d:
गृहसंवेशको दूतः कृष्यारोपक एव च ..
आखेटी श्येनजीवी च कन्यादूषक एव च .. 69 ..
16.205.m: a housebuilder, a courier, a tenant farmer, / a hunter, one who lives by hawking, and a defiler of maidens;

16.205.s:
hiṃsro vṛṣalaputraśca gaṇānāṃ caiva yājakaḥ ..
ācārahīnaḥ klībaśca nityayājanakastathā .. 7.1.205.70 ..
16.205.d:
हिंस्रो वृषलपुत्रश्च गणानां चैव याजकः ..
आचारहीनः क्लीबश्च नित्ययाजनकस्तथा .. 7.1.205.70 ..
16.205.m: a violent man, the son of a Śūdra woman, a priest for guilds [or multitudes], / one devoid of right conduct, a eunuch, and one who constantly officiates at sacrifices for anyone;

16.205.s:
kṛṣijīvī ślīpadī ca sadbhirnindita eva ca ..
aurabhriko māhiṣikaḥ parapūrvā patistathā ..
pretaniryātakāścaiva varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 71 ..
16.205.d:
कृषिजीवी श्लीपदी च सद्भिर्निन्दित एव च ..
औरभ्रिको माहिषिकः परपूर्वा पतिस्तथा ..
प्रेतनिर्यातकाश्चैव वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः .. 71 ..
16.205.m: one who lives by agriculture, one suffering from elephantiasis, one censured by the virtuous, / a keeper of sheep, a keeper of buffaloes, the husband of a previously married woman, / and carriers of dead bodies—these must be avoided with great effort.

16.205.s:
etānvai garhitācārānapāṃkteyāndvijādhamān ..
dvijānāṃ sati lābhe tū bhayatraiva vivarjayet .. 72 ..
16.205.d:
एतान्वै गर्हिताचारानपांक्तेयान्द्विजाधमान् ..
द्विजानां सति लाभे तू भयत्रैव विवर्जयेत् .. 72 ..
16.205.m: Indeed, these base twice-born of despised conduct, unfit to sit in a dining line— / when other twice-born are available, one must shun them in both [rites for gods and ancestors].

16.205.s:
vīkṣāṃdho vaikataḥ kāṇaḥ kuṣṭhī ca vṛṣalīpatiḥ ..
pāparogī sahasrasya dāturnāśayate phalam .. 73 ..
16.205.d:
वीक्षांधो वैकतः काणः कुष्ठी च वृषलीपतिः ..
पापरोगी सहस्रस्य दातुर्नाशयते फलम् .. 73 ..
16.205.m: A squint-eyed man, a one-eyed man, a leper, the husband of a Śūdra woman, / and one afflicted with a sinful disease destroy the donor's fruit of a thousand [offerings].

16.205.s:
yāvadbhiḥ saṃspṛśatyaṅgairbrāhmaṇāñchrūdrayājakaḥ ..
tāvatāṃ na bhavetpretya dāturvā tasya paitrikam .. 74 ..
16.205.d:
यावद्भिः संस्पृशत्यङ्गैर्ब्राह्मणाञ्छ्रूद्रयाजकः ..
तावतां न भवेत्प्रेत्य दातुर्वा तस्य पैत्रिकम् .. 74 ..
16.205.m: With as many limbs as a priest officiating for a Śūdra touches brahmins, / for that many [ancestors] in the hereafter, or for that donor, the ancestral rite bears no fruit.

16.205.s:
ādau māhiṣakaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhye ca vṛṣalīpatim ..
ante vārdhuṣikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ .. 75 ..
16.205.d:
आदौ माहिषकं दृष्ट्वा मध्ये च वृषलीपतिम् ..
अन्ते वार्धुषिकं दृष्ट्वा निराशाः पितरो गताः .. 75 ..
16.205.m: Seeing a keeper of buffaloes at the beginning, the husband of a Śūdra woman in the middle, / and a usurer at the end, the ancestors depart hopeless.

16.205.s:
mahiṣī procyate bhāryā sā vaidhavye'bhicāriṇī ..
tasyāṃ yaḥ kṣapate doṣāṃ sa vai māhiṣikaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 76 ..
16.205.d:
महिषी प्रोच्यते भार्या सा वैधव्येऽभिचारिणी ..
तस्यां यः क्षपते दोषां स वै माहिषिकः स्मृतः .. 76 ..
16.205.m: A wife is called a mahiṣī; if she is unfaithful in her widowhood, / he who endures her faults is remembered as a māhiṣika.

16.205.s:
vṛṣalītyucyate śūdrī tasyā yaśca patirbhavet ..
tadoṣṭhalālāsaṃsargātpatito vṛṣalīpatiḥ .. .. 77 ..
16.205.d:
वृषलीत्युच्यते शूद्री तस्या यश्च पतिर्भवेत् ..
तदोष्ठलालासंसर्गात्पतितो वृषलीपतिः .. .. 77 ..
16.205.m: A Śūdra woman is called a vṛṣalī; he who becomes her husband / is fallen through contact with her saliva and lips, becoming a vṛṣalīpati.

16.205.s:
svaṃ vṛṣaṃ tu parityaktvā pareṇa tu vṛṣāyate ..
vṛṣalī sā tu vijñeyā na śūdrī vṛṣalī bhavet .. 78 ..
16.205.d:
स्वं वृषं तु परित्यक्त्वा परेण तु वृषायते ..
वृषली सा तु विज्ञेया न शूद्री वृषली भवेत् .. 78 ..
16.205.m: Abandoning her own lawful husband, she who lusts after another— / she is to be known as a vṛṣalī; a Śūdra woman by birth alone is not necessarily a vṛṣalī.

16.205.s:
caṇḍālī baṃdhakī veśyā rajaḥsthā yā ca kanyakā ..
kuṭilā ca svagotrā ca vṛṣalyaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ .. 79 ..
16.205.d:
चण्डाली बंधकी वेश्या रजःस्था या च कन्यका ..
कुटिला च स्वगोत्रा च वृषल्यः सप्त कीर्तिताः .. 79 ..
16.205.m: A Caṇḍāla woman, an unchaste woman, a prostitute, a girl who has attained puberty, / a deceitful woman, and a woman of one's own gotra—these seven are proclaimed as vṛṣalīs.

16.205.s:
piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā ..
patitāḥ pitarastasyāḥ kanyā sā vṛṣalī bhavet .. 7.1.205.80 ..
16.205.d:
पितुर्गेहे तु या कन्या रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता ..
पतिताः पितरस्तस्याः कन्या सा वृषली भवेत् .. 7.1.205.80 ..
16.205.m: The maiden who sees her menstrual flow in her father's house while unbetrothed / causes her ancestors to fall; that girl becomes a vṛṣalī.

16.205.s:
yastu tāṃ varayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo jñānapūrvataḥ ..
aśrāddheyamapāṃkteyaṃ taṃ vidyādvṛṣalīpatim .. 81 ..
16.205.d:
यस्तु तां वरयेत्कन्यां ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानपूर्वतः ..
अश्राद्धेयमपांक्तेयं तं विद्याद्वृषलीपतिम् .. 81 ..
16.205.m: The brahmin who consciously weds such a girl— / one should know him to be a vṛṣalīpati, unfit for a śrāddha and excluded from the dining line.

16.205.s:
gaurī kanyā pradhānā vai madhyamā kanyakā matā ..
rohiṇī tatsamā jñeyā adhamā ca rajasvalā .. 82 ..
16.205.d:
गौरी कन्या प्रधाना वै मध्यमा कन्यका मता ..
रोहिणी तत्समा ज्ञेया अधमा च रजस्वला .. 82 ..
16.205.m: A gaurī girl is indeed the foremost; a kanyakā is considered middling; / a rohiṇī should be known as equal to that, while one who has menstruated is base.

16.205.s:
aprāpte rajasi gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī ..
avyaṃjanakṛtā kanyā kucahīnā tu nagnikā .. 83 ..
16.205.d:
अप्राप्ते रजसि गौरी प्राप्ते रजसि रोहिणी ..
अव्यंजनकृता कन्या कुचहीना तु नग्निका .. 83 ..
16.205.m: Before menstruation arrives, she is a gaurī; when menstruation has arrived, she is a rohiṇī; / one without manifested bodily marks and devoid of breasts is a nagnikā.

16.205.s:
saptavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu nagnikā ..
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā hyata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā .. 84 ..
16.205.d:
सप्तवर्षा भवेद्गौरी नववर्षा तु नग्निका ..
दशवर्षा भवेत्कन्या ह्यत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला .. 84 ..
16.205.m: At seven years she is a gaurī; at nine years she is a nagnikā; / at ten years she is a kanyā; beyond that she is rajasvalā (menstruating).

16.205.s:
vyaṃjanairhanti vai putrānkulaṃ hanyātpayodharā ..
gatimiṣṭāṃ tathā lokānhaṃti sā rajasā pituḥ .. 85 ..
16.205.d:
व्यंजनैर्हन्ति वै पुत्रान्कुलं हन्यात्पयोधरा ..
गतिमिष्टां तथा लोकान्हंति सा रजसा पितुः .. 85 ..
16.205.m: With developed marks she destroys sons; with breasts she destroys the lineage; / and by her menstrual flow she destroys her father's desirable destination and worlds.

16.205.s: ya udvahedrajoyuktāṃ sa jñeyo vṛṣalīpatiḥ .. 86 ..
16.205.d: य उद्वहेद्रजोयुक्तां स ज्ञेयो वृषलीपतिः .. 86 ..
16.205.m: He who marries one who has menstruated should be known as a vṛṣalīpati.

16.205.s:
yatkarotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanāddvijaḥ ..
tadbhaikṣyabhugjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati .. 87 ..
16.205.d:
यत्करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद्द्विजः ..
तद्भैक्ष्यभुग्जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर्व्यपोहति .. 87 ..
16.205.m: The sin that a twice-born incurs in a single night by serving a vṛṣalī, / he removes in three years, eating only begged food and constantly reciting mantras.

16.205.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhānarhabrāhmaṇaparīkṣaṇakathanaṃnāma pañcottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 205 ..
16.205.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्राद्धकल्पे श्राद्धानर्हब्राह्मणपरीक्षणकथनंनाम पञ्चोत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 205 ..
16.205.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Examination of Brahmins Unfit for Śrāddha in the Rules of Śrāddha," in the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the first section of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the great Purāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.

16.206.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
atha śrāddhavidhiṃ vakṣye pārvaṇasya vidhānataḥ ..
yathākramaṃ mahādevi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye .. 1 ..
16.206.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथ श्राद्धविधिं वक्ष्ये पार्वणस्य विधानतः ..
यथाक्रमं महादेवि शृणुष्वैकमनाः प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.206.m: Īśvara said: / Now I shall declare the rules of śrāddha according to the ordinance of the pārvaṇa rite. / Listen with single-minded attention in proper order, O great goddess, my beloved! 1

16.206.s:
kṛtvāpasavyaṃ pūrvedyuḥ pitṛpūrvaṃ nimaṃtrayet ..
bhavadbhiḥ pitṛkāryaṃ naḥ saṃpādyaṃ ca prasīdatha .. 2 ..
16.206.d:
कृत्वापसव्यं पूर्वेद्युः पितृपूर्वं निमंत्रयेत् ..
भवद्भिः पितृकार्यं नः संपाद्यं च प्रसीदथ .. 2 ..
16.206.m: Having placed the sacred thread over the right shoulder on the previous day, one should first invite the ancestors [saying]: / "May you perform our ancestral rite and be pleased." 2

16.206.s: savarṇānpreṣayedāptāndvijānāmupamantraṇe .. 3 ..
16.206.d: सवर्णान्प्रेषयेदाप्तान्द्विजानामुपमन्त्रणे .. 3 ..
16.206.m: One should send trustworthy men of equal caste to invite the twice-born. 3

16.206.s:
abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyādyairnimantritaiḥ ..
tathaiva brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇena nimantritauḥ .. 4 ..
16.206.d:
अभोज्यं ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं क्षत्रियाद्यैर्निमन्त्रितैः ..
तथैव ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं ब्राह्मणेन निमन्त्रितौः .. 4 ..
16.206.m: A brahmin's food is not to be eaten when invited by Kṣatriyas and others; / likewise, a brahmin's food [is proper] when invited by a brahmin. 4

16.206.s:
brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadecchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadet ..
ubhāvetāvabhojyānnau bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 5 ..
16.206.d:
ब्राह्मणान्नं ददेच्छूद्रः शूद्रान्नं ब्राह्मणो ददेत् ..
उभावेतावभोज्यान्नौ भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् .. 5 ..
16.206.m: If a Śūdra gives food to a brahmin, or a brahmin gives food to a Śūdra, / both of these have food unfit to be eaten; having eaten it, one must perform the cāndrāyaṇa penance. 5

16.206.s:
upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ yaḥ paceddvijaḥ ..
abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ patedadhaḥ .. 6 ..
16.206.d:
उपनिक्षेपधर्मेण शूद्रान्नं यः पचेद्द्विजः ..
अभोज्यं तद्भवेदन्नं स च विप्रः पतेदधः .. 6 ..
16.206.m: If a twice-born cooks the food of a Śūdra through the manner of a deposited trust, / that food becomes unfit to eat, and that brahmin falls downward. 6

16.206.s:
śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaḥ śūdreṇa ca sahāsanam ..
śūdrājjñānāgamaścaiva jvalaṃtamapi pātayet .. 7 ..
16.206.d:
शूद्रान्नं शूद्रसंपर्कः शूद्रेण च सहासनम् ..
शूद्राज्ज्ञानागमश्चैव ज्वलंतमपि पातयेत् .. 7 ..
16.206.m: A Śūdra's food, contact with a Śūdra, sitting together with a Śūdra, / and the acquisition of knowledge from a Śūdra cause even a blazing [sage] to fall. 7

16.206.s:
śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ ..
kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ ..8..
16.206.d:
शूद्रान्नोपहता विप्रा विह्वला रतिलालसाः ..
कुपिताः किं करिष्यंति निर्विषा इव पन्नगाः ..8..
16.206.m: Brahmins ruined by a Śūdra's food, agitated and longing for sexual pleasure— / what will they do when angered, like serpents deprived of poison? 8

16.206.s:
nagnaḥ syānmalavadvāsā nagnaḥ kaupīnavastradhṛk ..
dvikaccho'nuttarīyaśca vikaccho'vastra eva ca ..9..
16.206.d:
नग्नः स्यान्मलवद्वासा नग्नः कौपीनवस्त्रधृक् ..
द्विकच्छोऽनुत्तरीयश्च विकच्छोऽवस्त्र एव च ..9..
16.206.m: One wearing dirty clothes is [considered] naked; one wearing only a loincloth is naked; / one with two tucks and no upper garment is [considered] unclothed, and one without tucks is without clothes. 9

16.206.s:
nagnaḥ kāṣāyavastraḥ syānnagnaścārdhapaṭaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
acchinnāgraṃ tu yadvastraṃ mṛdā prakṣālitaṃ tu yat .. 7.1.206.10 ..
16.206.d:
नग्नः काषायवस्त्रः स्यान्नग्नश्चार्धपटः स्मृतः ..
अच्छिन्नाग्रं तु यद्वस्त्रं मृदा प्रक्षालितं तु यत् .. 7.1.206.10 ..
16.206.m: One wearing ochre robes is [considered] naked, and one with half a cloth is remembered as naked. / But cloth whose edge is uncut and which is washed with clay, 10

16.206.s:
ahataṃ dhāturaktaṃ vā tatpavitramiti sthitam ..
agrato vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ .. 11 ..
16.206.d:
अहतं धातुरक्तं वा तत्पवित्रमिति स्थितम् ..
अग्रतो वसते मूर्खो दूरे चास्य गुणान्वितः .. 11 ..
16.206.m: whether unworn or dyed with mineral dye, is established as pure. / If a fool lives nearby and an endowed [worthy man] is far away, 11

16.206.s:
guṇānvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhe vyatikramaḥ ..
yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte ..
dūrasthaṃ pūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyaṃ narakaṃ vrajet .. 12 ..
16.206.d:
गुणान्विते च दातव्यं नास्ति मूर्खे व्यतिक्रमः ..
यस्त्वासन्नमतिक्रम्य ब्राह्मणं पतितादृते ..
दूरस्थं पूजयेन्मूढो गुणाढ्यं नरकं व्रजेत् .. 12 ..
16.206.m: the gift should be given to the one endowed with virtues; there is no offense toward the fool. / But that deluded man who, bypassing a nearby brahmin who is not fallen, / worships one residing far away though rich in virtues, goes to hell. 12

16.206.s:
vedavidyāvratasnāte śrotriye gṛhamāgate ..
krīḍantyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim..13..
16.206.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाते श्रोत्रिये गृहमागते ..
क्रीडन्त्योषधयः सर्वा यास्यामः परमां गतिम्..13..
16.206.m: When a learned vedic scholar who has bathed at the end of his vow of Vedic study arrives at the house, / all the medicinal herbs rejoice, [thinking:] "We shall attain the highest state!" 13

16.206.s:
saṃdhyayorubhayorjāpye bhojane daṃtadhāvane..
pitṛkārye ca daive ca tathā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ..
gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau dāne yoge caiva viśeṣataḥ ..
eteṣu maunamātiṣṭhansvargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 15 ..
16.206.d:
संध्ययोरुभयोर्जाप्ये भोजने दंतधावने..
पितृकार्ये च दैवे च तथा मूत्रपुरीषयोः..
गुरूणां संनिधौ दाने योगे चैव विशेषतः ..
एतेषु मौनमातिष्ठन्स्वर्गं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 15 ..
16.206.m: At both twilights, during recitation of prayers, while eating, while brushing teeth, / in ancestral rites, in divine rites, as well as while passing urine and feces, / in the presence of teachers, during giving of gifts, and especially in yoga— / observing silence in these, a person attains heaven. 15

16.206.s:
yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syājjapādiṣu kathaṃcana ..
vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam .. 16 ..
16.206.d:
यदि वाग्यमलोपः स्याज्जपादिषु कथंचन ..
व्याहरेद्वैष्णवं मंत्रं स्मरेद्वा विष्णुमव्ययम् .. 16 ..
16.206.m: If there should somehow be a breach of the restraint of speech during recitation and the like, / one should utter a Vaiṣṇava mantra or remember the imperishable Viṣṇu. 16

16.206.s:
dāne snāne jape home bhojane devatārcane ..
devānāmṛjavo darbhāḥ pitṝṇāṃ dviguṇāstathā .. 17 ..
16.206.d:
दाने स्नाने जपे होमे भोजने देवतार्चने ..
देवानामृजवो दर्भाः पितॄणां द्विगुणास्तथा .. 17 ..
16.206.m: In giving gifts, bathing, recitation, oblation, eating, and worshiping deities, / darbha grasses are single [and straight] for the gods, and doubled for the ancestors. 17

16.206.s:
udaṅmukhastu devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
agninā bhasmanā vāpi yavenāpyudakena vā ..
dvārasaṃkramaṇenāpi paṃktidoṣo na vidyate .. 18 ..
16.206.d:
उदङ्मुखस्तु देवानां पितॄणां दक्षिणामुखः ..
अग्निना भस्मना वापि यवेनाप्युदकेन वा ..
द्वारसंक्रमणेनापि पंक्तिदोषो न विद्यते .. 18 ..
16.206.m: One faces north for the gods, but faces south for the ancestors. / By means of fire, ash, barley, water, / or the partition of a doorway, no fault of the dining line exists. 18

16.206.s:
iṣṭaśrāddhe kraturdakṣo vṛddhau satyavasū smṛtau ..
naimittike kālakāmau kāmye cādhvavirocanau .. 19 ..
16.206.d:
इष्टश्राद्धे क्रतुर्दक्षो वृद्धौ सत्यवसू स्मृतौ ..
नैमित्तिके कालकामौ काम्ये चाध्वविरोचनौ .. 19 ..
16.206.m:
In an iṣṭaśrāddha, Kratu and Dakṣa [are the Viśvedevas]; in a vṛddhiśrāddha, Satya and Vasu are remembered;
in an occasional rite, Kāla and Kāma; and in an optional rite, Adhva and Virocana.

16.206.s:
purūravā ārdravaśca pārvaṇe samudāhṛtau ..
puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ ca nyagrodhe buddhiṃ prajñāṃ dhṛtiṃ smṛtim .. 7.1.206.20 ..
16.206.d:
पुरूरवा आर्द्रवश्च पार्वणे समुदाहृतौ ..
पुष्टिं प्रजां च न्यग्रोधे बुद्धिं प्रज्ञां धृतिं स्मृतिम् .. 7.1.206.20 ..
16.206.m: Purūravas and Ārdrava are proclaimed for the pārvaṇa rite. / [One gains] nourishment and progeny through [a vessel of] nyagrodha; intellect, wisdom, resolve, and memory [through one of other woods].

16.206.s:
rakṣoghnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kāśmīryaṃ pātramucyate ..
saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke madhūke samudāhṛtam .. 21 ..
16.206.d:
रक्षोघ्नं च यशस्यं च काश्मीर्यं पात्रमुच्यते ..
सौभाग्यमुत्तमं लोके मधूके समुदाहृतम् .. 21 ..
16.206.m: A vessel of kāśmīrya is said to destroy demons and bring renown; / supreme good fortune in the world is declared [from one of] madhūka.

16.206.s:
phālgunapātre tu kurvāṇaḥ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt ..
parāṃ dyutimathārke tu prākāśyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 22 ..
16.206.d:
फाल्गुनपात्रे तु कुर्वाणः सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् ..
परां द्युतिमथार्के तु प्राकाश्यं च विशेषतः .. 22 ..
16.206.m: One performing [the rite] with a vessel of phālguna obtains all desires; / with [one of] arka, supreme splendor and eminence in particular.

16.206.s:
bilve lakṣmīṃ tapo medhāṃ nityamāyuṣyameva ca ..
kṣetrārāmataḍāgeṣu sarvapātreṣu caiva hi .. 23 ..
16.206.d:
बिल्वे लक्ष्मीं तपो मेधां नित्यमायुष्यमेव च ..
क्षेत्रारामतडागेषु सर्वपात्रेषु चैव हि .. 23 ..
16.206.m: With [one of] bilva, [one obtains] prosperity, austerity, intelligence, and long life constantly, / as well as fields, gardens, and ponds—and indeed with all [such] vessels.

16.206.s:
varṣatyajasraṃ parjanye veṇupātreṣu kurvataḥ ..
eteṣāṃ labhyate puṇyaṃ suvarṇai rajataistathā .. 24 ..
16.206.d:
वर्षत्यजस्रं पर्जन्ये वेणुपात्रेषु कुर्वतः ..
एतेषां लभ्यते पुण्यं सुवर्णै रजतैस्तथा .. 24 ..
16.206.m: When Parjanya rains continuously, for one who performs [the rite] with bamboo vessels, / the merit of these is obtained as though through [vessels of] gold and silver.

16.206.s:
palāśaphalanyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṃkatāḥ ..
audumbarastathā bilvaṃ caṃdanaṃ yajñiyāśca ye .. 25 ..
16.206.d:
पलाशफलन्यग्रोधप्लक्षाश्वत्थविकंकताः ..
औदुम्बरस्तथा बिल्वं चंदनं यज्ञियाश्च ये .. 25 ..
16.206.m: Palāśa, breadfruit, nyagrodha, plakṣa, aśvattha, vikaṅkata, / udumbara, bilva, and sandalwood, and whichever trees are sacrificial;

16.206.s:
saralo devadāruśca śālāśca khadirāstathā ..
samidarthaṃ praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ .. 26 ..
16.206.d:
सरलो देवदारुश्च शालाश्च खदिरास्तथा ..
समिदर्थं प्रशस्ताः स्युरेते वृक्षा विशेषतः .. 26 ..
16.206.m: Sarala, devadāru, śāla, and khadira— / these trees are particularly recommended for sacrificial fuel.

16.206.s:
śleṣmātako naktamālyaḥ kapitthaḥ śālmalī tathā ..
niṃbo bibhītakaścaiva śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ ..27..
16.206.d:
श्लेष्मातको नक्तमाल्यः कपित्थः शाल्मली तथा ..
निंबो बिभीतकश्चैव श्राद्धकर्मणि गर्हिताः ..27..
16.206.m: Śleṣmātaka, naktamālya, kapittha, śālmalī, / neem, and bibhītaka are condemned in the ancestral rite.

16.206.s:
aniṣṭaśabdāṃ saṃkīrṇā rūkṣāṃ jantumatīmapi ..
pratigaṃdhāṃ tu tāṃ bhūmiṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi garhayet ..28..
16.206.d:
अनिष्टशब्दां संकीर्णा रूक्षां जन्तुमतीमपि ..
प्रतिगंधां तु तां भूमिं श्राद्धकर्मणि गर्हयेत् ..28..
16.206.m: Ground that has unpleasant noises, is cluttered, barren, full of vermin, / or has an offensive odor—one should avoid such ground in the ancestral rite.

16.206.s:
traiśaṃkavaṃ tyajeddeśaṃsarvadvādaśayojanam ..
uttareṇa mahānadyā dakṣiṇena ca kevalam .. 29 ..
16.206.d:
त्रैशंकवं त्यजेद्देशंसर्वद्वादशयोजनम् ..
उत्तरेण महानद्या दक्षिणेन च केवलम् .. 29 ..
16.206.m: One should avoid the region of Traiśaṅku for an entire twelve yojanas / to the north of the Mahānadī and strictly to the south.

16.206.s:
deśastraiśaṃ kavonāma varjitaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ..
kāraskārāḥ kaliṃgāśca siṃdhoruttarameva ca ..
praṇaṣṭāśramadharmāśca varjyā deśāḥ prayatnataḥ ..7.1.206.30..
16.206.d:
देशस्त्रैशं कवोनाम वर्जितः श्राद्धकर्मणि ..
कारस्काराः कलिंगाश्च सिंधोरुत्तरमेव च ..
प्रणष्टाश्रमधर्माश्च वर्ज्या देशाः प्रयत्नतः ..7.1.206.30..
16.206.m: The land named Traiśaṅkava is excluded in the ancestral rite. / Kāraskara, Kaliṅga, and the land north of the Sindhu, / and regions where the duties of the life-stages have vanished, should be avoided with effort.

16.206.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ tu kṛtaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ smṛtam ..
vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam ..31..
16.206.d:
ब्राह्मणं तु कृतं प्रोक्तं त्रेता तु क्षत्रियं स्मृतम् ..
वैश्यं द्वापरमित्याहुः शूद्रं कलियुगं स्मृतम् ..31..
16.206.m: The Kṛta age is declared brahminical, the Tretā is remembered as kṣatriya, / the Dvāpara they call vaiśya, and the Kali age is remembered as śūdra.

16.206.s:
kṛte tu pitaraḥ pūjyāstretāyāṃ ca surāstathā ..
munayo dvāpare nityaṃ pākhaṃḍāśca kalau yuge ..32..
16.206.d:
कृते तु पितरः पूज्यास्त्रेतायां च सुरास्तथा ..
मुनयो द्वापरे नित्यं पाखंडाश्च कलौ युगे ..32..
16.206.m: In the Kṛta, the ancestors are to be worshiped; in the Tretā, the gods; / in the Dvāpara, always the sages; and in the Kali age, the heretics.

16.206.s:
śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhṇe śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe'parāhne tu rauhiṇaṃ na vilaṃghayet ..33..
16.206.d:
शुक्लपक्षस्य पूर्वाह्णे श्राद्धं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ..
कृष्णपक्षेऽपराह्ने तु रौहिणं न विलंघयेत् ..33..
16.206.m: A wise man should perform the śrāddha in the forenoon during the bright fortnight; / during the dark fortnight, in the afternoon, and he must not let the Rauhiṇa [muhūrta] pass.

16.206.s:
ratnimātrapramāṇaṃ ca pitṛtīrthaṃ tu saṃskṛtam ..
upamūle tathā lūnāḥ prastarārthe kuśottamāḥ...
tathā śyāmākanīvārā dūrvāśca samudāhṛtāḥ ..
sva kīrtimatāṃ śreṣṭho bahukeśaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..35..
16.206.d:
रत्निमात्रप्रमाणं च पितृतीर्थं तु संस्कृतम् ..
उपमूले तथा लूनाः प्रस्तरार्थे कुशोत्तमाः...
तथा श्यामाकनीवारा दूर्वाश्च समुदाहृताः ..
स्व कीर्तिमतां श्रेष्ठो बहुकेशः प्रजापतिः ..35..
16.206.m: The pitṛtīrtha, prepared [there], is to measure only a cubit. / Superior kuśa grass cut near the root is for strewing, / and śyāmāka, nīvāra, and dūrvā are also prescribed. / Prajāpati, the foremost of the renowned, had abundant hair;

16.206.s:
tasya keśā nipatitā bhūmau kāśatvamāgatāḥ ..
tasmānmedhyāḥ sadā kāśāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitāḥ ..36..
16.206.d:
तस्य केशा निपतिता भूमौ काशत्वमागताः ..
तस्मान्मेध्याः सदा काशाः श्राद्धकर्मणि पूजिताः ..36..
16.206.m: His hair fell to the ground and became kāśa grass. / Therefore, kāśa is always pure and honored in the ancestral rite.

16.206.s:
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ teṣu kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā..
uṣṇamannaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ śraddhayā viniveśayet.. 37..
16.206.d:
पिण्डनिर्वपणं तेषु कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता..
उष्णमन्नं द्विजातिभ्यः श्रद्धया विनिवेशयेत्.. 37..
16.206.m: Upon them one who desires prosperity should make the offering of rice-balls. / With faith he should offer warm food to the twice-born.

16.206.s:
anyatra phalapuṣpebhyaḥ pānakebhyaśca paṇḍitaḥ..
haste dattvā tu vai snehāllavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca..
āyasena ca pātreṇa tadvai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate..
dvijapātreṣu dattvānnaṃ tūṣṇīṃ saṃkalpamācaret..39..
16.206.d:
अन्यत्र फलपुष्पेभ्यः पानकेभ्यश्च पण्डितः..
हस्ते दत्त्वा तु वै स्नेहाल्लवणं व्यञ्जनानि च..
आयसेन च पात्रेण तद्वै रक्षांसि भुञ्जते..
द्विजपात्रेषु दत्त्वान्नं तूष्णीं संकल्पमाचरेत्..39..
16.206.m: Except for fruits, flowers, and drinks, a wise man, / having placed salt and cooked dishes in the hand out of affection / or with an iron vessel—indeed, rakṣasas consume that. / Having placed the food in the vessels of the twice-born, he should quietly make the solemn resolve.

16.206.s:
darvyādisthena no teṣāṃ saṃbandho dṛśyate yataḥ ..
yaśca śūkaravadbhuṃkte yaśca pāṇitale dvijaḥ ..
na tadaśnaṃti pitaro yaḥ savācaṃ samaśnute .. 7.1.206.40 ..
16.206.d:
दर्व्यादिस्थेन नो तेषां संबन्धो दृश्यते यतः ..
यश्च शूकरवद्भुंक्ते यश्च पाणितले द्विजः ..
न तदश्नंति पितरो यः सवाचं समश्नुते .. 7.1.206.40 ..
16.206.m: Since no contact of theirs is seen when it remains in a ladle or the like; / and if a twice-born eats like a boar, or eats from the palm of his hand, / or eats speaking, the ancestors do not consume that.

16.206.s:
dvihāyanasya vatsasya viśaṃtyāsyaṃ yathā sukham ..
tathā kuryātpramāṇena piṇḍānvyāsena bhāṣitam .. 41 ..
16.206.d:
द्विहायनस्य वत्सस्य विशंत्यास्यं यथा सुखम् ..
तथा कुर्यात्प्रमाणेन पिण्डान्व्यासेन भाषितम् .. 41 ..
16.206.m: Of such size that they comfortably enter the mouth of a two-year-old calf, / one should make the rice-balls, as stated by Vyāsa.

16.206.s:
na strī pracālayettāni jñānahīno na cāvrataḥ ..
svayaṃ putro'thavā yasya vāñchedabhyudayaṃ param .. 42 ..
16.206.d:
न स्त्री प्रचालयेत्तानि ज्ञानहीनो न चाव्रतः ..
स्वयं पुत्रोऽथवा यस्य वाञ्छेदभ्युदयं परम् .. 42 ..
16.206.m: A woman should not move them, nor one devoid of knowledge, nor one without vows; / the son himself [should do so], or whoever desires supreme prosperity.

16.206.s:
bhājaneṣu ca tiṣṭhatsu svastiṃ kurvanti ye dvijāḥ ..
tadannamasurairbhuktaṃ nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ .. 43 ..
16.206.d:
भाजनेषु च तिष्ठत्सु स्वस्तिं कुर्वन्ति ये द्विजाः ..
तदन्नमसुरैर्भुक्तं निराशाः पितरो गताः .. 43 ..
16.206.m: While the dishes are still present, if the twice-born pronounce 'svasti', / that food is consumed by the asuras, and the ancestors depart hopeless.

16.206.s:
apsvekaṃ plāvayetpiṇḍamekaṃ patnyai nivedayet ..
ekaṃ vai juhuyādagnāveṣā tu trividhā gatiḥ .. 44 ..
16.206.d:
अप्स्वेकं प्लावयेत्पिण्डमेकं पत्न्यै निवेदयेत् ..
एकं वै जुहुयादग्नावेषा तु त्रिविधा गतिः .. 44 ..
16.206.m: One should immerse one ball in water; one he should present to his wife; / one he should offer into the fire: this is the threefold disposition.

16.206.s:
chandogaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe vaiśvadeve ca bahvṛcam ..
puṣṭikarmaṇyathādhvaryuṃ śāntikarmaṇyatharvaṇam .. 45 ..
16.206.d:
छन्दोगं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धे वैश्वदेवे च बह्वृचम् ..
पुष्टिकर्मण्यथाध्वर्युं शान्तिकर्मण्यथर्वणम् .. 45 ..
16.206.m: One should feed a Sāmaveda chanter at the śrāddha, and a Ṛgveda reciter at the Vaiśvadeva; / an Adhvaryu priest in rites for prosperity, and an Atharvaveda reciter in rites for appeasement.

16.206.s:
dvau deve'tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhau ca niveśayet ..
pitrye hyudaṅmukhānkuryādbahvṛcādhvaryusāmagān .. 46 ..
16.206.d:
द्वौ देवेऽथर्वणौ विप्रौ प्राङ्मुखौ च निवेशयेत् ..
पित्र्ये ह्युदङ्मुखान्कुर्याद्बह्वृचाध्वर्युसामगान् .. 46 ..
16.206.m: For the gods, one should seat two Atharvaveda brahmins facing east; / for the ancestors, one should make Ṛgveda, Yajurveda, and Sāmaveda priests face north.

16.206.s:
jātyaśca sarvā dātavyā mallikā śvetayūthikā ..
jalodbhavāni sarvāṇi kusumāni ca campakam.. 47 ..
16.206.d:
जात्यश्च सर्वा दातव्या मल्लिका श्वेतयूथिका ..
जलोद्भवानि सर्वाणि कुसुमानि च चम्पकम्.. 47 ..
16.206.m: All varieties of jasmine should be offered, [as well as] mallikā, white yūthikā, / all water-born flowers, and campaka.

16.206.s:
madhūkaṃ rāmaṭhaṃ caiva karpūraṃ maricaṃ guḍam ..
śrāddhakarmaṇi śastāni saiṃdhavaṃ trapusaṃ tathā .. 48..
16.206.d:
मधूकं रामठं चैव कर्पूरं मरिचं गुडम् ..
श्राद्धकर्मणि शस्तानि सैंधवं त्रपुसं तथा .. 48..
16.206.m: Madhūka, asafoetida, camphor, black pepper, jaggery, / rock salt, and cucumber are commendable in an ancestral rite.

16.206.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kambalo gāvaḥ sūryogniratithiśca vai ..
tilā darbhāśca kālaśca navaite kutapāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 49 ..
16.206.d:
ब्राह्मणः कम्बलो गावः सूर्योग्निरतिथिश्च वै ..
तिला दर्भाश्च कालश्च नवैते कुतपाः स्मृताः .. 49 ..
16.206.m: A brahmin, a blanket, cattle, the sun, fire, a guest, / sesamum seeds, darbha grass, and the proper time—these nine are known as kutapas.

16.206.s:
āpadyanagnau tīrthe ca caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā ..
nācaretsaṃgrahe caiva tathaivāstamupāgate .. 7.1.206.50 ..
16.206.d:
आपद्यनग्नौ तीर्थे च चंद्रसूर्यग्रहे तथा ..
नाचरेत्संग्रहे चैव तथैवास्तमुपागते .. 7.1.206.50 ..
16.206.m: In misfortune, when the sacred fire is absent, at a sacred ford, during an eclipse of the moon or sun, / at a planetary conjunction, and likewise when [the sun] has set, one should not perform [the ancestral offering].

16.206.s:
saṃśuddhā syāccaturthe'hni snātā nārī rajasvalā ..
daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śuddhyati .. 51 ..
16.206.d:
संशुद्धा स्याच्चतुर्थेऽह्नि स्नाता नारी रजस्वला ..
दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये च पञ्चमेऽहनि शुद्ध्यति .. 51 ..
16.206.m: A menstruating woman becomes purified on the fourth day after bathing; / for rites for the gods and ancestors, she becomes pure on the fifth day.

16.206.s:
dravyābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani ..
āmaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta yasya bhāryā rajasvalā .. 52 ..
16.206.d:
द्रव्याभावे द्विजाभावे प्रवासे पुत्रजन्मनि ..
आमश्राद्धं प्रकुर्वीत यस्य भार्या रजस्वला .. 52 ..
16.206.m: In the absence of materials, in the absence of twice-born men, while away from home, on the birth of a son, / or if one's wife is menstruating, one should perform an āmaśrāddha.

16.206.s:
sarpaviprahatānāṃ ca daṃṣṭriśṛṃgisarīsṛpaiḥ ..
ātmanastyāgināṃ caiva śrāddhameṣāṃ na kārayet .. 53 ..
16.206.d:
सर्पविप्रहतानां च दंष्ट्रिशृंगिसरीसृपैः ..
आत्मनस्त्यागिनां चैव श्राद्धमेषां न कारयेत् .. 53 ..
16.206.m: For those killed by snakes, brahmins, fanged beasts, horned animals, or reptiles, / and for suicides, one should not have a śrāddha performed.

16.206.s:
caṇḍālādudakātsarpādbrāhmaṇādvaidyutādapi ..
daṃṣṭribhyaśca paśubhyaśca maraṇaṃ pāpakarmaṇām .. 54 ..
16.206.d:
चण्डालादुदकात्सर्पाद्ब्राह्मणाद्वैद्युतादपि ..
दंष्ट्रिभ्यश्च पशुभ्यश्च मरणं पापकर्मणाम् .. 54 ..
16.206.m: Death at the hands of an outcaste, from water, from a snake, from a brahmin, from lightning, / and from fanged animals and beasts, is the lot of evil-doers.

16.206.s:
sarvairanumataṃ kṛtvā jyeṣṭhenaiva ca yatkṛtam ..
dravyeṇa ca vibhaktena sarvaireva kṛtaṃ bhavet .. .. 55 ..
16.206.d:
सर्वैरनुमतं कृत्वा ज्येष्ठेनैव च यत्कृतम् ..
द्रव्येण च विभक्तेन सर्वैरेव कृतं भवेत् .. .. 55 ..
16.206.m: Whatever is performed by the eldest with the consent of all / using undivided wealth, that is considered done by all.

16.206.s:
amāvāsyāṃ pitṛśrāddhe maṃthanaṃ yastu kārayet ..
tattakraṃ madirātulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ gomāṃsavatsmṛtam .. 56 ..
16.206.d:
अमावास्यां पितृश्राद्धे मंथनं यस्तु कारयेत् ..
तत्तक्रं मदिरातुल्यं घृतं गोमांसवत्स्मृतम् .. 56 ..
16.206.m: He who causes churning to be done on the new-moon day during an ancestral rite— / that buttermilk is equal to liquor, and the clarified butter is regarded as cow's flesh.

16.206.s:
bhuṃjaṃti kramaśaḥ pūrve tathā piṃḍāśiṣo 'pi ca ..
nimaṃtrito dvijaḥ śrāddhe na śayīta striyā saha .. 57 ..
16.206.d:
भुंजंति क्रमशः पूर्वे तथा पिंडाशिषो ऽपि च ..
निमंत्रितो द्विजः श्राद्धे न शयीत स्त्रिया सह .. 57 ..
16.206.m: The ancestors consume in order, and so do the partakers of the rice-ball blessings. / An invited twice-born man must not sleep with a woman on the day of the śrāddha.

16.206.s:
śrādabhukprātarutthāya prakuryāddantadhāvanam ..
śrāddhakartā na kurvīta dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ budhaḥ .. 58 ..
16.206.d:
श्रादभुक्प्रातरुत्थाय प्रकुर्याद्दन्तधावनम् ..
श्राद्धकर्ता न कुर्वीत दन्तानां धावनं बुधः .. 58 ..
16.206.m: One who eats at a śrāddha should brush his teeth after rising in the morning; / a wise man who performs a śrāddha should not clean his teeth.

16.206.s:
varṣevarṣe tu yacchrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani ..
malamāse na kartavyaṃ vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 59 ..
16.206.d:
वर्षेवर्षे तु यच्छ्राद्धं मातापित्रोर्मृतेऽहनि ..
मलमासे न कर्तव्यं व्यासस्य वचनं यथा .. 59 ..
16.206.m: The śrāddha performed year after year on the day of the parents' death / should not be performed during an intercalary month, according to the word of Vyāsa.

16.206.s:
garbhe vārdhuṣike prete bhṛtye māsānumāsike ..
ābdike ca tathā śrāddhe nādhimāso vidhīyate .. 7.1.206.60 ..
16.206.d:
गर्भे वार्धुषिके प्रेते भृत्ये मासानुमासिके ..
आब्दिके च तथा श्राद्धे नाधिमासो विधीयते .. 7.1.206.60 ..
16.206.m: In rites for pregnancy, usury rites, rites for the deceased, for servants, in monthly rites, / and in annual śrāddha, an intercalary month is not prescribed.

16.206.s:
vivāhādau smṛtaḥ sauro yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
ābdike pitṛkārye tu cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate .. 61 ..
16.206.d:
विवाहादौ स्मृतः सौरो यज्ञादौ सावनः स्मृतः ..
आब्दिके पितृकार्ये तु चान्द्रो मासः प्रशस्यते .. 61 ..
16.206.m: In marriage and similar rites, the solar month is taught; in sacrificial rites and the like, the civil month is taught. / But in the annual ancestral rite for the ancestors, the lunar month is commended. (61)

16.206.s:
yasminrāśau gate sūrye vipattiḥ syāddvijanmanaḥ ..
tadrāśāveva kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ mṛte'hani .. 62 ..
16.206.d:
यस्मिन्राशौ गते सूर्ये विपत्तिः स्याद्द्विजन्मनः ..
तद्राशावेव कर्तव्यं पितृकार्यं मृतेऽहनि .. 62 ..
16.206.m: In whichever zodiacal sign the sun was when the demise of the twice-born occurred, / precisely in that sign must the ancestral rite be performed on the day of death. (62)

16.206.s:
vaṣaṭkāraśca homaśca parva cāgrāyaṇaṃ tathā ..
malamāse'pi kartavyaṃ kāmyā iṣṭīrvivarjayet .. 63 ..
16.206.d:
वषट्कारश्च होमश्च पर्व चाग्रायणं तथा ..
मलमासेऽपि कर्तव्यं काम्या इष्टीर्विवर्जयेत् .. 63 ..
16.206.m: The vaṣaṭ-call, the fire-offering, the parvan-sacrifice, and likewise the first-fruits oblation / must be performed even in an intercalary month; one should avoid optional offerings. (63)

16.206.s:
agnyādhyeyaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca yajñadānavratāni ca ..
vedavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ .. 64 ..
16.206.d:
अग्न्याध्येयं प्रतिष्ठां च यज्ञदानव्रतानि च ..
वेदव्रतवृषोत्सर्गचूडाकरणमेखलाः .. 64 ..
16.206.m: Setting up the sacred fires, consecration, sacrifices, gifts, and observances, / Vedic vows, the release of a bull, the tonsure ceremony, the investiture with the girdle, (64)

16.206.s:
māṃgalyamabhiṣekaṃ ca malamāse vivarjayet ..
nityanaimittike kuryātprayataḥ sanmalimluce ..
tīrthe snānaṃ gaja cchāyāṃ pretaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 65 ..
16.206.d:
मांगल्यमभिषेकं च मलमासे विवर्जयेत् ..
नित्यनैमित्तिके कुर्यात्प्रयतः सन्मलिम्लुचे ..
तीर्थे स्नानं गज च्छायां प्रेतश्राद्धं तथैव च .. 65 ..
16.206.m: auspicious rites, and royal consecration must be avoided in an intercalary month. / In the intercalary month, one should perform regular and occasional rites while being restrained: / ritual ablution at a sacred ford, rites in the elephant's shadow, and likewise the funeral rite for the deceased spirit. (65)

16.206.s:
rasā yatra praśasyante bhoktāro baṃdhugotriṇaḥ ..
rājavārtādi saṃkraṃdo rakṣaḥśrāddhasya lakṣaṇam.. 66 ..
16.206.d:
रसा यत्र प्रशस्यन्ते भोक्तारो बंधुगोत्रिणः ..
राजवार्तादि संक्रंदो रक्षःश्राद्धस्य लक्षणम्.. 66 ..
16.206.m: Where tastes are praised, where the eaters are kinsmen and gotra members, / and there is clamour about political news and the like—this is the mark of a demoniacal ancestral rite. (66)

16.206.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā paraśrāddhe yastu bhuṃkte ca vihvalaḥ ..
pataṃti pitarastasya luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ ..67..
16.206.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा परश्राद्धे यस्तु भुंक्ते च विह्वलः ..
पतंति पितरस्तस्य लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः ..67..
16.206.m: He who, having performed an ancestral rite, agitatingly eats at another's ancestral rite— / his ancestors fall, deprived of the rites of rice-balls and water. (67)

16.206.s:
tailamudvartanaṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanameva ca ..
klṛptaromanakhebhyaśca dadyādgatvāpare'hani .. 68 ..
16.206.d:
तैलमुद्वर्तनं स्नानं दन्तधावनमेव च ..
क्लृप्तरोमनखेभ्यश्च दद्याद्गत्वापरेऽहनि .. 68 ..
16.206.m: On the next day, having approached them, he should give oil, unguent, a bath, / and tooth-twigs to those whose hair and nails have been trimmed. (68)

16.206.s:
nimantritā yathānyāyaṃ havye kavye dvijottamāḥ ..
kathaṃcidapyatikrāmetpāpaḥ śūkaratāṃ vrajet .. 69 ..
16.206.d:
निमन्त्रिता यथान्यायं हव्ये कव्ये द्विजोत्तमाः ..
कथंचिदप्यतिक्रामेत्पापः शूकरतां व्रजेत् .. 69 ..
16.206.m: If best of brahmins properly invited to offerings for the gods or ancestors / fail to attend in any way, being sinful, they will become hogs. (69)

16.206.s:
daive ca pitṛ śrāddhe cāpyāśaucaṃ jāyate yadā ..
āśaucānte'thavā tatra tebhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ pradīyate .. 7.1.206.70 ..
16.206.d:
दैवे च पितृ श्राद्धे चाप्याशौचं जायते यदा ..
आशौचान्तेऽथवा तत्र तेभ्यः श्राद्धं प्रदीयते .. 7.1.206.70 ..
16.206.m: When ritual impurity occurs during a rite for the gods or for the ancestors, / then at the end of the ritual impurity the ancestral rite is offered to them. (70)

16.206.s:
atha śrāddhāvasāne tu āśiṣastatra dāpayet ..
dīrghā nāgāstathā nadyo viṣṇostrīṇi padāni ca ..
evameṣāṃ pramāṇena dīrghamāyuravāpnuyām .. 71 ..
16.206.d:
अथ श्राद्धावसाने तु आशिषस्तत्र दापयेत् ..
दीर्घा नागास्तथा नद्यो विष्णोस्त्रीणि पदानि च ..
एवमेषां प्रमाणेन दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयाम् .. 71 ..
16.206.m: Then, at the conclusion of the ancestral rite, he should have blessings pronounced there: / 'Long are the serpents, and likewise the rivers, and the three strides of Viṣṇu; / by the measure of these, may I attain a long life!' (71)

16.206.s:
apāṃ madhye sthitā devāḥ sarvamapsu pratiṣṭhitam ..
brāhmaṇasya kare nyastāḥ śivā āpo bhavantu naḥ .. 72..
16.206.d:
अपां मध्ये स्थिता देवाः सर्वमप्सु प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
ब्राह्मणस्य करे न्यस्ताः शिवा आपो भवन्तु नः .. 72..
16.206.m: 'The gods abide within the waters; everything is established in the waters. / Placed in the hand of the brahmin, may the waters be auspicious for us!' (72)

16.206.s:
lakṣmīrvasati puṣpeṣu lakṣmīrvasati puṣkare ..
lakṣmīrvasatu vāse me saumanasyaṃ dadātu me .. 73 ..
16.206.d:
लक्ष्मीर्वसति पुष्पेषु लक्ष्मीर्वसति पुष्करे ..
लक्ष्मीर्वसतु वासे मे सौमनस्यं ददातु मे .. 73 ..
16.206.m: 'Lakṣmī dwells in flowers; Lakṣmī dwells in the lotus. / May Lakṣmī dwell in my abode; may she grant me gladness of mind!' (73)

16.206.s:
akṣataṃ cā'stu me puṇyaṃ śāṃtiḥ puṣṭirdhṛtiśca me ..
yadyacchreyaskaraṃ loke tattadastu sadā mama .. 74 ..
16.206.d:
अक्षतं चाऽस्तु मे पुण्यं शांतिः पुष्टिर्धृतिश्च मे ..
यद्यच्छ्रेयस्करं लोके तत्तदस्तु सदा मम .. 74 ..
16.206.m: 'May my religious merit be unbroken, and may I have peace, nourishment, and resolve! / Whatever brings welfare in the world, may that ever be mine!' (74)

16.206.s:
dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu sarvatra bahudeyaṃ tathāstu naḥ ..
evamastviti tairvācyaṃ mūrdhnā grāhyaṃ ca tena tat ..75 ..
16.206.d:
दक्षिणायां तु सर्वत्र बहुदेयं तथास्तु नः ..
एवमस्त्विति तैर्वाच्यं मूर्ध्ना ग्राह्यं च तेन तत् ..75 ..
16.206.m: Regarding the priestly gift everywhere: 'May we have much to give!' / 'So be it,' they should say, and he must receive that upon his head. (75)

16.206.s:
piṃḍamagnau sadā deyādbhogārthī satataṃ naraḥ ..
prajārthaṃ patnyai vai dadyānmadhyamaṃ maṃtrapūrvakam .. 76 ..
16.206.d:
पिंडमग्नौ सदा देयाद्भोगार्थी सततं नरः ..
प्रजार्थं पत्न्यै वै दद्यान्मध्यमं मंत्रपूर्वकम् .. 76 ..
16.206.m: A man seeking enjoyment should always offer a ball of rice into the fire; / for offspring, he should give the middle one to his wife, preceded by a mantra. (76)

16.206.s:
uttamāṃ dyutimavicchangoṣu nityaṃ pradāpayet ..
ājñāmicchedyaśaḥ kīrtimapsu nityaṃ praveśayet .. 77 ..
16.206.d:
उत्तमां द्युतिमविच्छन्गोषु नित्यं प्रदापयेत् ..
आज्ञामिच्छेद्यशः कीर्तिमप्सु नित्यं प्रवेशयेत् .. 77 ..
16.206.m: Desiring supreme radiance, he should always present it to cows; / if he desires authority, renown, and fame, he should always throw it into the waters. (77)

16.206.s:
prārthayandīrghamāyuśca vāyasebhyaḥ pradāpayet ..
kumāralokamanvicchankukkuṭebhyaḥ pradāpayet .. 78 ..
16.206.d:
प्रार्थयन्दीर्घमायुश्च वायसेभ्यः प्रदापयेत् ..
कुमारलोकमन्विच्छन्कुक्कुटेभ्यः प्रदापयेत् .. 78 ..
16.206.m: Praying for a long life, he should give it to crows; / seeking the world of Kumāra, he should give it to roosters. (78)

16.206.s:
ākāśe prakṣipedvāpi sthito vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ sthānamākāśaṃ dakṣiṇā caiva diktathā .. 79 ..
16.206.d:
आकाशे प्रक्षिपेद्वापि स्थितो वा दक्षिणामुखः ..
पितॄणां स्थानमाकाशं दक्षिणा चैव दिक्तथा .. 79 ..
16.206.m: Or standing facing south, he should cast it into the air; / the air is the abode of the ancestors, and so too is the southern direction. (79)

16.206.s:
naktaṃ tu varjayecchrāddhaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt ..
sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ kṣipraṃ vai rāhudarśanāt .. 7.1.206.80 ..
16.206.d:
नक्तं तु वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धं राहोरन्यत्र दर्शनात् ..
सर्वस्वेनापि कर्तव्यं क्षिप्रं वै राहुदर्शनात् .. 7.1.206.80 ..
16.206.m: One should avoid an ancestral rite at night, except during the sight of Rāhu [an eclipse]; / at the sight of Rāhu, it must be performed quickly, even with one's entire wealth. (80)

16.206.s:
uparāge na kuryādyaḥ paṃke gauriva sīdati ..
kurvāṇastu taretpāpaṃ sā ca nauriva sāgare .. 81 ..
16.206.d:
उपरागे न कुर्याद्यः पंके गौरिव सीदति ..
कुर्वाणस्तु तरेत्पापं सा च नौरिव सागरे .. 81 ..
16.206.m: He who does not perform it during an eclipse sinks like a cow in the mud; / but he who performs it crosses over sin like a ship on the ocean. (81)

16.206.s:
kṛṣṇamāṣāstilāścaiva śreṣṭhāḥ syuryavaśālayaḥ ..
mahāyavā vrīhiyavāstathaiva ca masūrikāḥ .. 82 ..
16.206.d:
कृष्णमाषास्तिलाश्चैव श्रेष्ठाः स्युर्यवशालयः ..
महायवा व्रीहियवास्तथैव च मसूरिकाः .. 82 ..
16.206.m: Black kidney beans and sesame seeds are excellent, as are barley and rice, / great barley, paddy-barley, and lentils. (82)

16.206.s:
kṛṣṇāḥ śvetāśca vā grāhyāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi sarvadā ..
bilvāmalakamṛdvīkaṃ panasāmrātadāḍimam .. 83 ..
16.206.d:
कृष्णाः श्वेताश्च वा ग्राह्याः श्राद्धकर्मणि सर्वदा ..
बिल्वामलकमृद्वीकं पनसाम्रातदाडिमम् .. 83 ..
16.206.m: Black or white [grains] are always to be used in ancestral rites; / bilva, āmalaka, grapes, jackfruit, hog plum, pomegranate, (83)

16.206.s:
bhavyaṃ pārāpataṃ caiva kharjūraṃ karamarddakam ..
sakorakā badaryaśca tālakaṃdaṃ tathā bisam .. 84 ..
16.206.d:
भव्यं पारापतं चैव खर्जूरं करमर्द्दकम् ..
सकोरका बदर्यश्च तालकंदं तथा बिसम् .. 84 ..
16.206.m: bhavya fruit, pigeon plum, dates, karamarda, / jujube with calyxes, palmyra root, and lotus root, (84)

16.206.s:
tamālāsanakaṃdaṃ ca māvellaṃ śatakaṃdalī ..
kāleyaṃ kālaśākaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ ca suvarcalam..85..
16.206.d:
तमालासनकंदं च मावेल्लं शतकंदली ..
कालेयं कालशाकं च मुद्गान्नं च सुवर्चलम्..85..
16.206.m: tamāla, asana bulb, māvella, śatakandalī, / kāleya, kālaśāka, cooked mung bean, and suvarcala, (85)

16.206.s:
māṃsaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi śākaṃ vyoṣaṃ vetrāṃkurastathā ..
kaṭphalaṃ vajrakaṃ drākṣāṃ lakucaṃ mocameva ca .. .. 86 ..
16.206.d:
मांसं क्षीरं दधि शाकं व्योषं वेत्रांकुरस्तथा ..
कट्फलं वज्रकं द्राक्षां लकुचं मोचमेव च .. .. 86 ..
16.206.m: meat, milk, curd, leafy vegetables, the three pungents, reed shoots, / kaṭphala, vajraka, grapes, lakuca, and banana, (86)

16.206.s:
priyāmalakadurgrīvaṃ tiṃḍukaṃ madhusāhvayam ..
vaikaṃkataṃ nālikeraṃ śṛṅgāṭakaparūṣakam .. 87 ..
16.206.d:
प्रियामलकदुर्ग्रीवं तिंडुकं मधुसाह्वयम् ..
वैकंकतं नालिकेरं शृङ्गाटकपरूषकम् .. 87 ..
16.206.m: priyāmalaka, durgrīva, tinduka, madhusāhvaya, / vaikaṅkata, coconut, water chestnut, parūṣaka, (87)

16.206.s:
pippalīmaricaṃ caiva paṭolī bṛhatīphalam..
ārāmasya tu sīmā'ntaḥ saṃbhavaṃ sarvameva tu ..88..
16.206.d:
पिप्पलीमरिचं चैव पटोली बृहतीफलम्..
आरामस्य तु सीमाऽन्तः संभवं सर्वमेव तु ..88..
16.206.m: long pepper, black pepper, paṭolī, and bṛhatī fruit; / indeed everything grown within the boundary of an orchard. (88)

16.206.s:
evamādīni cānyāni puṣpāṇi śrāddhakarmaṇi..
masūrāḥ śatapuṣpyāśca kusumaṃ śrīniketanam ..89..
16.206.d:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि पुष्पाणि श्राद्धकर्मणि..
मसूराः शतपुष्प्याश्च कुसुमं श्रीनिकेतनम् ..89..
16.206.m: These and other flowers are used in the ancestral rites: / lentils, śatapuṣpī, and the śrīniketana blossom, (89)

16.206.s:
varyā svātiyavā nityaṃ tathā vṛṣayavāsakau ..
vaṃśā karīrā surasā mārjitā bhūtṛṇāni ca .. 7.1.206.90 ..
16.206.d:
वर्या स्वातियवा नित्यं तथा वृषयवासकौ ..
वंशा करीरा सुरसा मार्जिता भूतृणानि च .. 7.1.206.90 ..
16.206.m: the superior svāti barley always, and likewise vṛṣa and yavāsa, / bamboo shoots, karīra, holy basil, cleansers, and bhūtṛṇa grasses. (90)

16.206.s:
varjanīyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ ..
laśunaṃ gṛṃjanaṃ caiva palāṃḍuṃ piṇḍamūlakam ..
mogaraṃ cātra vaidehaṃ dīrghamūlakameva ca .. 91 ..
16.206.d:
वर्जनीयानि वक्ष्यामि श्राद्धकर्मणि नित्यशः ..
लशुनं गृंजनं चैव पलांडुं पिण्डमूलकम् ..
मोगरं चात्र वैदेहं दीर्घमूलकमेव च .. 91 ..
16.206.m: I shall declare what is constantly to be avoided in ancestral rites: / garlic, turnip, onion, spherical radish, / mogara, vaideha, and long radish. (91)

16.206.s:
divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhūte divākare ..
āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṛṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate .. 92 ..
16.206.d:
दिवसस्याष्टमे भागे मन्दीभूते दिवाकरे ..
आसुरं तद्भवेच्छ्राद्धं पितृणां नोपतिष्ठते .. 92 ..
16.206.m: In the eighth part of the day, when the sun has grown dim, / that ancestral rite becomes demoniacal; it does not reach the ancestors. (92)

16.206.s:
caturthe prahare prāpte yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
vṛthā śrāddhamavāpnoti dātā ca narakaṃ vrajet .. 93 ..
16.206.d:
चतुर्थे प्रहरे प्राप्ते यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
वृथा श्राद्धमवाप्नोति दाता च नरकं व्रजेत् .. 93 ..
16.206.m: A man who performs an ancestral rite when the fourth watch has arrived / gains an ancestral rite in vain, and the giver goes to hell. (93)

16.206.s:
lekhāprabhṛtyathāditye muhūrtāstraya eva ca ..
prātastasyottaraṃ kālaṃ bhagamāhurvipaścitaḥ .. 94 ..
16.206.d:
लेखाप्रभृत्यथादित्ये मुहूर्तास्त्रय एव च ..
प्रातस्तस्योत्तरं कालं भगमाहुर्विपश्चितः .. 94 ..
16.206.m: Beginning from sunrise, there are three muhūrtas / termed morning; the wise call the time after that bhaga. (94)

16.206.s:
saṃgavastrimuhūrto'yaṃ madhyāhnastu samantataḥ ..
tataśca trimuhūrtāśca aparāhṇo vidhīyate .. 95 ..
16.206.d:
संगवस्त्रिमुहूर्तोऽयं मध्याह्नस्तु समन्ततः ..
ततश्च त्रिमुहूर्ताश्च अपराह्णो विधीयते .. 95 ..
16.206.m: The period of three muhūrtas is saṃgava; midday covers all around [three muhūrtas]; / and after that, a period of three muhūrtas is ordained as afternoon. (95)

16.206.s: pañcamo'tha dināṃśo yaḥ sa sāyāhna iti smṛtaḥ .. 96 ..
16.206.d: पञ्चमोऽथ दिनांशो यः स सायाह्न इति स्मृतः .. 96 ..
