cirāyureṣa vai prokto hyamībhiścābhivāditaiḥ .. 33 ..
16.209.d:
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन दैवयोगात्पितामह ..
चिरायुरेष वै प्रोक्तो ह्यमीभिश्चाभिवादितैः .. 33 ..
16.209.m: in the course of a pilgrimage through the workings of fate, O Grandfather; / and when saluted, he was addressed by them: 'Be long-lived!' indeed.

16.209.s:
tvatsakāśaṃ samānītastvayā caivamudāhṛtaḥ ..
kathaṃ vāganṛtā deva hyasmākaṃ bhavatā saha .. 34 ..
16.209.d:
त्वत्सकाशं समानीतस्त्वया चैवमुदाहृतः ..
कथं वागनृता देव ह्यस्माकं भवता सह .. 34 ..
16.209.m: He was brought into your presence, and by you also the same was spoken. / How, O lord, could the word of ours together with yours be untrue?"

16.209.s:
uvāca bālamuddiśya prahasanpadmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
matsamānāyuṣo bālo mārkaṇḍeyo bhaviṣyati .. 35 ..
16.209.d:
उवाच बालमुद्दिश्य प्रहसन्पद्मसंभवः ..
मत्समानायुषो बालो मार्कण्डेयो भविष्यति .. 35 ..
16.209.m: The lotus-born [god], smiling, spoke concerning the boy: / "The boy Mārkaṇḍeya shall have a lifespan equal to mine.

16.209.s:
kalpasyādau tathā cānte sahāyo me bhaviṣyati ..
tatastu munayaḥ prītā gṛhītvā munidārakam ..
tasminneva pradeśe tu mumucuśceṣṭitaṃ yataḥ .. 36 ..
16.209.d:
कल्पस्यादौ तथा चान्ते सहायो मे भविष्यति ..
ततस्तु मुनयः प्रीता गृहीत्वा मुनिदारकम् ..
तस्मिन्नेव प्रदेशे तु मुमुचुश्चेष्टितं यतः .. 36 ..
16.209.m: At the beginning of a kalpa and likewise at its end, he shall be my companion." / Then the sages, pleased, took the sage's child / and released him in that very region from which he had set out.

16.209.s:
tīrthayātrāṃ gatā viprā mārkaṇḍeyo gṛhaṃ yayau ..
gatvā gṛhamathovāca mṛkaṇḍaṃ munisattamam .. 37 ..
16.209.d:
तीर्थयात्रां गता विप्रा मार्कण्डेयो गृहं ययौ ..
गत्वा गृहमथोवाच मृकण्डं मुनिसत्तमम् .. 37 ..
16.209.m: The brahmins departed on their pilgrimage; Mārkaṇḍeya went home. / Having gone home, he then spoke to Mṛkaṇḍa, the best of sages:

16.209.s:
brahmalokamahaṃ nīto munibhistāta saptabhiḥ ..
ukto'yaṃ brahmaṇā kalpasyādau cānte ca me sakhā .. 38 ..
16.209.d:
ब्रह्मलोकमहं नीतो मुनिभिस्तात सप्तभिः ..
उक्तोऽयं ब्रह्मणा कल्पस्यादौ चान्ते च मे सखा .. 38 ..
16.209.m: "Father, I was taken to the world of Brahmā by the seven sages. / He was told by Brahmā: 'At the beginning and at the end of a kalpa, he [shall be] my companion;

16.209.s:
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho matsamāyuśca bālakaḥ ..
tatastaiḥ punarānīto muktaścaivāśramaṃ prati .. 39 ..
16.209.d:
भविष्यति न संदेहो मत्समायुश्च बालकः ..
ततस्तैः पुनरानीतो मुक्तश्चैवाश्रमं प्रति .. 39 ..
16.209.m: the boy will have a lifespan equal to mine, there is no doubt.' / Then I was brought back by them and released toward the hermitage.

16.209.s:
matkṛte hi dvijaśreṣṭha yātu te manaso jvaraḥ ..
mārkaṇḍeyavacaḥ śrutvā mṛkaṇḍo munisattamaḥ ..
jagāma paramaṃ harṣaṃ kṣaṇamekaṃ suduḥsaham .. 7.1.209.40 ..
16.209.d:
मत्कृते हि द्विजश्रेष्ठ यातु ते मनसो ज्वरः ..
मार्कण्डेयवचः श्रुत्वा मृकण्डो मुनिसत्तमः ..
जगाम परमं हर्षं क्षणमेकं सुदुःसहम् .. 7.1.209.40 ..
16.209.m: On my account, O best of the twice-born, let the fever of your mind depart!" / Having heard Mārkaṇḍeya's words, Mṛkaṇḍa, the best of sages, / attained supreme joy after a single, utterly unbearable moment.

16.209.s: tatau dhairyaṃ samāsthāya vākyametaduvāca ha .. 41 ..
16.209.d: ततौ धैर्यं समास्थाय वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 41 ..
16.209.m: Then, having regained his composure, he spoke this word:

16.209.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ..
yattvayā me suputreṇa dṛṣṭo lokapitāmahaḥ .. 42 ..
16.209.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् ..
यत्त्वया मे सुपुत्रेण दृष्टो लोकपितामहः .. 42 ..
16.209.m: "Today my birth has become fruitful, and my life is well-lived, / since by you, my good son, the Grandfather of the worlds has been seen!

16.209.s:
vājapeyasahasreṇa rājasūyaśatena ca ..
yaṃ na paśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ sa tvayā līlayā suta .. 43 ..
16.209.d:
वाजपेयसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च ..
यं न पश्यन्ति विद्वांसः स त्वया लीलया सुत .. 43 ..
16.209.m: He whom the learned do not see by a thousand Vājapeya sacrifices / and by a hundred Rājasūya sacrifices, he, O son, effortlessly by you

16.209.s:
dṛṣṭaścirāyurapyevaṃ kṛtastenābjayoninā ..
divārātramahaṃ tāta tava duḥkhena dukhitaḥ ..
na nidrāmanugacchāmi tanmeduḥkhaṃ gataṃ mahat .. 44 ..
iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 209...
16.209.d:
दृष्टश्चिरायुरप्येवं कृतस्तेनाब्जयोनिना ..
दिवारात्रमहं तात तव दुःखेन दुखितः ..
न निद्रामनुगच्छामि तन्मेदुःखं गतं महत् .. 44 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मार्कण्डेयेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम नवोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 209...
16.209.m:
has been seen, and you have thus been made long-lived by the lotus-born [god]! / Day and night, O dear son, I was grieving with grief for you; / I could not find sleep. That great grief of mine has departed!"
Thus ends the two hundred and ninth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Mārkaṇḍeyeśvara', in the first Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya of the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.210.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi pulastyeśvaramuttamam ..
mārkaṃḍeyottere bhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.210.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुलस्त्येश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
मार्कंडेयोत्तेरे भागे धनुषां पञ्चके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.210.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Pulastyeśvara,
situated five bow-lengths to the north of Mārkaṇḍeya.

16.210.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
saptajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2 ..
16.210.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि पूजयित्वा विधानतः ..
सप्तजन्मार्जितात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 2 ..
16.210.m:
Having seen and worshipped it according to the injunctions, O goddess,
a human is freed from sins accumulated across seven births; of this there is no doubt.

16.210.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pulastyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 210 ..
16.210.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुलस्त्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम दशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 210 ..
16.210.m: Thus ends the two hundred and tenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Pulastyeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.211.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
pulastyeśvarāttato devi nairṛte dhanuṣāṣṭake ..
pulaheśvaranāmānaṃ taṃ ca bhaktyā prapūjayet .. 1 ..
16.211.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुलस्त्येश्वरात्ततो देवि नैरृते धनुषाष्टके ..
पुलहेश्वरनामानं तं च भक्त्या प्रपूजयेत् .. 1 ..
16.211.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O goddess, eight bow-lengths southwest of Pulastyeśvara,
one should worship with devotion the one named Pulaheśvara.
Having given a gift of gold, one indeed attains the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.211.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pulaheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 211 ..
16.211.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुलहेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकादशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 211 ..
16.211.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eleventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Pulaheśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.212.s:
īśvara uvāca .. ..
pulaheśvarāttato devi nairṛte dhanuṣāṣṭake ..
kratvīśvaretināmānaṃ mahākratuphalapradam ..1..
16.212.d:
ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पुलहेश्वरात्ततो देवि नैरृते धनुषाष्टके ..
क्रत्वीश्वरेतिनामानं महाक्रतुफलप्रदम् ..1..
16.212.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O goddess, eight bow-lengths southwest of Pulaheśvara,
[stands the liṅga] named Kratvīśvara, which bestows the fruit of a great Vedic sacrifice.

16.212.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ..
saptajanmani dāridryaṃ na duḥkhaṃ tatra jāyate ..2..
16.212.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि पौंडरीकफलं लभेत् ..
सप्तजन्मनि दारिद्र्यं न दुःखं तत्र जायते ..2..
16.212.m:
Having seen it, O goddess, a human obtains the fruit of the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice;
for seven births, poverty and distress do not arise for him.

16.212.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kratvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 212..
16.212.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये क्रत्वीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. 212..
16.212.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twelfth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kratvīśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.213.s:
īśvara uvāca..
kratvīśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanuḥṣoḍaśakāntare..
kaśyapeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.213.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
क्रत्वीशात्पूर्वदिग्भागे धनुःषोडशकान्तरे..
कश्यपेश्वरनामानं महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.213.m:
Īśvara said:
To the east of Kratvīśa, at a distance of sixteen bow-lengths,
[stands the liṅga] named Kaśyapeśvara, destroying great sins.

16.213.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi dhanavānputravānbhavet ..
sarvapātakayukto'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 2 ..
16.213.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि धनवान्पुत्रवान्भवेत् ..
सर्वपातकयुक्तोऽपि मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 2 ..
16.213.m:
Having seen it, O goddess, a human becomes wealthy and blessed with sons;
even though tainted with all manner of sins, he is liberated; of this there is no doubt.

16.213.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaśyapeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 213 .. ..
16.213.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कश्यपेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 213 .. ..
16.213.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kaśyapeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.214.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dhanuṣāmaṣṭabhistasmādīśāne kaśyapeśvarāt ..
kauśakeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.214.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
धनुषामष्टभिस्तस्मादीशाने कश्यपेश्वरात् ..
कौशकेश्वरनामानं महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.214.m:
Īśvara said:
Eight bow-lengths northeast from that Kaśyapeśvara,
[stands the liṅga] named Kauśikeśvara, destroying great sins.

16.214.s:
vasiṣṭhatanayānhatvā tatra kauśikasattamaḥ ..
sthāpayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ muktapāpastato'bhavat .. 2 ..
16.214.d:
वसिष्ठतनयान्हत्वा तत्र कौशिकसत्तमः ..
स्थापयामास तल्लिंगं मुक्तपापस्ततोऽभवत् .. 2 ..
16.214.m:
Having slain the sons of Vasiṣṭha, Kauśika, the best of men, established that liṅga there,
and thereupon became freed from sin.

16.214.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā tu labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam..3..
16.214.d: तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा तु लभते वाञ्छितं फलम्..3..
16.214.m: Having seen and worshipped it, one attains the desired fruit.

16.214.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kauśikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmacaturdaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ.. .. 214 ..
16.214.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कौशिकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामचतुर्दशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः.. .. 214 ..
16.214.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fourteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kauśikeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.215.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kumāreśvaramuttamam ..
mārkaṇḍeśvarato devi dakṣiṇe nātidūrataḥ ..
dhanurviṃśatibhistatra sthitaṃ svāmipratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.215.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कुमारेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
मार्कण्डेश्वरतो देवि दक्षिणे नातिदूरतः ..
धनुर्विंशतिभिस्तत्र स्थितं स्वामिप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.215.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Kumāreśvara,
situated not far to the south of Mārkaṇḍeśvara, O goddess,
twenty bow-lengths away, consecrated by the Lord [Kumāra].

16.215.s:
tataḥ kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ kārttikeyena bhābhini ..
paradārāpahārotthapāpānāṃ nāśahetave .. 2 ..
16.215.d:
ततः कृत्वा तपो घोरं कार्त्तिकेयेन भाभिनि ..
परदारापहारोत्थपापानां नाशहेतवे .. 2 ..
16.215.m:
Then, having performed severe austerity, O radiant lady, Kārttikeya,
in order to destroy the sins arising from taking another's wife,

16.215.s:
liṃgaṃ sthāpitavāṃstatra sa muktaḥ kilviṣāttataḥ ..
vairāgyādyauvanaṃ tyaktvā kaumāraṃ punarādade .. 3 ..
16.215.d:
लिंगं स्थापितवांस्तत्र स मुक्तः किल्विषात्ततः ..
वैराग्याद्यौवनं त्यक्त्वा कौमारं पुनराददे .. 3 ..
16.215.m:
installed the liṅga there and was freed from defilement.
Having abandoned his youth out of detachment, he assumed bachelorhood once more.

16.215.s:
pitṝnhatvā sumālī ca tamārādhitavānpurā ..
so'pi mukto'bhavaddevi pāpātpitṛvadhodbhavāt .. 4 ..
16.215.d:
पितॄन्हत्वा सुमाली च तमाराधितवान्पुरा ..
सोऽपि मुक्तोऽभवद्देवि पापात्पितृवधोद्भवात् .. 4 ..
16.215.m:
Having slain his fathers, Sumālī also worshipped it formerly;
he too became freed, O goddess, from the sin arising from the murder of his fathers.

16.215.s:
kumāreśvaranāmaitatpūjitaṃ vai surāsuraiḥ ..
tasyāgrataḥ kumārasya kūpastiṣṭhati bhāmini .. 5 ..
16.215.d:
कुमारेश्वरनामैतत्पूजितं वै सुरासुरैः ..
तस्याग्रतः कुमारस्य कूपस्तिष्ठति भामिनि .. 5 ..
16.215.m:
This is named Kumāreśvara, worshipped by gods and asuras.
In front of that [liṅga of] Kumāra stands a well, O radiant lady.

16.215.s:
tatra snātvā pūjayedyaḥ śūlinaṃ svāmipūjitam ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchetsvāmipuraṃ mahat .. 6 ..
16.215.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा पूजयेद्यः शूलिनं स्वामिपूजितम् ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्गच्छेत्स्वामिपुरं महत् .. 6 ..
16.215.m:
Having bathed there, whoever worships the Trident-bearer revered by the Lord [Kumāra]
is freed from all sins and goes to the great realm of the Lord.

16.215.s:
śātakauṃbhamayaṃ yastu tāmracūḍaṃ dvijātaye ..
dadyātsvāminamuddiśya sa tu yātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 7 ..
16.215.d:
शातकौंभमयं यस्तु ताम्रचूडं द्विजातये ..
दद्यात्स्वामिनमुद्दिश्य स तु यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 7 ..
16.215.m:
And whoever gives a golden rooster to a twice-born person
in honor of the Lord obtains the fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.215.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kumāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 215 .. ..
16.215.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुमारेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चदशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 215 .. ..
16.215.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fifteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kumāreśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.216.s:
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
mārkaṇḍeśvarato devi uttare liṃgamuttamam..
dhanuṣāṃ pañcadaśabhirgautameśvaranāmakam .. 1 ..
16.216.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
मार्कण्डेश्वरतो देवि उत्तरे लिंगमुत्तमम्..
धनुषां पञ्चदशभिर्गौतमेश्वरनामकम् .. 1 ..
16.216.m:
Īśvara said:
To the north of Mārkaṇḍeśvara, O goddess, fifteen bow-lengths away,
is the excellent liṅga named Gautameśvara.

16.216.s:
guruṃ hatvā purā devi gautamaḥ pāpaduḥkhitaḥ ..
tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasmātpāpādvyamucyata .. 2 ..
16.216.d:
गुरुं हत्वा पुरा देवि गौतमः पापदुःखितः ..
तत्र लिंगं प्रतिष्ठाप्य तस्मात्पापाद्व्यमुच्यत .. 2 ..
16.216.m:
Formerly, having killed his guru, O goddess, Gautama was afflicted by sin;
installing a liṅga there, he was freed from that sin.

16.216.s:
yastatra kapilāṃ dadyātsnātvā nadyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ ..3..
16.216.d:
यस्तत्र कपिलां दद्यात्स्नात्वा नद्यां विधानतः ..
संपूज्य विधिवल्लिंगं मुच्यते पञ्चपातकैः ..3..
16.216.m:
Whoever gives a tawny cow there, having bathed properly in the river
and worshipped the liṅga according to the injunctions, is freed from the five [great] sins.

16.216.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..216.. ..
16.216.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गौतमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..216.. ..
16.216.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gautameśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.217.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
gautameśvarato devi paścime nātidūrataḥ ..
dhanuḥṣoḍaśabhirdevi devarājeśvaraḥ sthitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.217.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
गौतमेश्वरतो देवि पश्चिमे नातिदूरतः ..
धनुःषोडशभिर्देवि देवराजेश्वरः स्थितः .. 1 ..
16.217.m:
Īśvara said:
Not far to the west of Gautameśvara, O goddess,
sixteen bow-lengths away, stands Devarājeśvara.

16.217.s:
liṃgaṃ sa sthāpayāmāsa tataḥ pāpairvyamucyata ..
yastaṃ samāhitamanāḥ pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ ..
sa ca mānavasaṃbhūtātpātakātsaṃpramokṣyati .. 2 ..
16.217.d:
लिंगं स स्थापयामास ततः पापैर्व्यमुच्यत ..
यस्तं समाहितमनाः पूजयिष्यति मानवः ..
स च मानवसंभूतात्पातकात्संप्रमोक्ष्यति .. 2 ..
16.217.m:
He established that liṅga and was thereupon freed from sins.
Whatever human worships it with a collected mind
shall be completely liberated from sins born of humans.

16.217.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devarājeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..217..
16.217.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये देवराजेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..217..
16.217.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventeenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Devarājeśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.218.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva mānavaṃ liṃgaṃ manunā saṃpratiṣṭhitam ..
pūrvaṃ hatvā sutaṃ devi manuḥ pāpasamanvitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.218.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव मानवं लिंगं मनुना संप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
पूर्वं हत्वा सुतं देवि मनुः पापसमन्वितः .. 1 ..
16.218.m:
Īśvara said:
In that very place is the liṅga of Manu, consecrated by Manu.
Formerly, having slain his son, O goddess, Manu was accompanied by sin.

Knowing the sacred field to remove sins, he established Īśvara there
and was freed indeed from that sin arising from the murder of his son.
Whatever human worships it becomes freed from sins.

16.218.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mānaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..218.. ..
16.218.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मानवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..218.. ..
16.218.m: Thus ends the two hundred and eighteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Mānaveśvara', in the first [part], the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
